
===== src\proxy.ts =====
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";

import { ROLE_HOME, canAccessPath } from "@/config/roles";

import { decrypt } from "@/app/lib/session";

/**
 * Request proxy. In Next.js 16 this file replaces `middleware.ts` —
 * the convention was renamed and the export must be `proxy`.
 *
 * OPTIMISTIC gate only: keeps users out of the wrong namespace and off login
 * screens when already signed in. Trivially bypassable, so every page
 * re-checks through the DAL and every Server Action re-authorizes on its own.
 * Server Functions POST to the route they live on, so a matcher change here
 * can silently drop coverage — never rely on this alone.
 */

/** Reachable without a session — one per principal type, plus recovery. */
const PUBLIC_PATHS = [
  "/login",
  "/employee-login",
  "/agent-login",
  "/forgot-password",
  "/reset-password",
];

/** Reachable while `must_change_password` is set, and nothing else. */
const PASSWORD_ROTATION_PATH = "/set-password";

function isPublic(pathname: string): boolean {
  return PUBLIC_PATHS.some((p) => pathname === p || pathname.startsWith(`${p}/`));
}

export async function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
  const { pathname } = request.nextUrl;

  // Biometric terminals authenticate by device token, not a user session.
  if (pathname.startsWith("/kiosk")) {
    return NextResponse.next();
  }

  const session = await decrypt(request.cookies.get("dhwarsh_session")?.value);

  if (!session) {
    if (isPublic(pathname)) {
      return NextResponse.next();
    }

    // Staff login is the default door; the footer links cover the others.
    const loginUrl = new URL("/login", request.url);
    if (pathname !== "/") {
      loginUrl.searchParams.set("next", pathname);
    }
    return NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl);
  }

  const home = ROLE_HOME[session.role];

  // Pin a flagged session to the rotation screen until it completes.
  if (session.mustChangePassword) {
    return pathname === PASSWORD_ROTATION_PATH
      ? NextResponse.next()
      : NextResponse.redirect(new URL(PASSWORD_ROTATION_PATH, request.url));
  }

  // Already signed in — no reason to sit on a login screen.
  if (isPublic(pathname) || pathname === "/" || pathname === PASSWORD_ROTATION_PATH) {
    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(home, request.url));
  }

  // Wrong namespace: an EMPLOYEE poking at /payroll/runs lands back home.
  if (!canAccessPath(session.role, pathname)) {
    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(home, request.url));
  }

  return NextResponse.next();
}

export const config = {
  // Excludes static assets, image optimization and public files, so auth
  // redirects never swallow CSS, JS or images.
  matcher: [
    "/((?!api|_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|.*\\.(?:svg|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp|ico)$).*)",
  ],
};

===== src\app\error.tsx =====
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

/**
 * Global error boundary — the fallback for anything outside the portal shell
 * (the sign-in screens, the kiosk) and for failures in the portal layout
 * itself. Route errors inside the shell are handled by `(portal)/error.tsx`,
 * which keeps the navigation usable.
 *
 * Uses the icon font directly rather than <Icon> so the boundary has as few
 * dependencies as possible — a component that only renders when something has
 * already broken should not be able to break in turn.
 */
export default function GlobalError({
  error,
  reset,
}: {
  error: Error & { digest?: string };
  reset: () => void;
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    console.error("Unhandled application error:", error);
  }, [error]);

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-dvh flex-col items-center justify-center bg-background p-6 text-center sm:p-8">
      <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[32px] text-error">
        error
      </span>

      <h1 className="mt-3 font-display-greeting text-lg text-on-surface sm:text-display-greeting">
        Something went wrong
      </h1>

      {/* The raw message is withheld on purpose: in production it is a generic
          placeholder, and in development it can carry a stack or internal
          detail that is not useful — or safe — to show a user. */}
      <p className="mt-2 max-w-md font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">
        The page couldn&rsquo;t be displayed. Try again, and if it keeps
        happening let your administrator know.
      </p>

      {error.digest ? (
        <p className="mt-3 font-mono text-[10px] text-outline">
          Reference: {error.digest}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={reset}
        className="mt-6 h-10 rounded-lg bg-navy px-5 font-body-md text-body-md font-bold text-white transition-opacity hover:opacity-90 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/40"
      >
        Try again
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\app\layout.tsx =====
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { Be_Vietnam_Pro } from "next/font/google";

import { siteConfig } from "@/config/site";

import { Providers } from "./providers";
import "./globals.css";

/**
 * Be Vietnam Pro, self-hosted by next/font. The Stitch export pulls this from
 * the Google Fonts CDN; serving it from our own origin removes a render-
 * blocking third-party request and the layout shift that comes with it.
 *
 * Weights match those the Stitch type scale actually uses (400/500/600/700).
 */
const beVietnamPro = Be_Vietnam_Pro({
  variable: "--font-be-vietnam-pro",
  subsets: ["latin"],
  weight: ["400", "500", "600", "700"],
  display: "swap",
});

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: {
    default: siteConfig.name,
    template: `%s · ${siteConfig.shortName}`,
  },
  description: siteConfig.description,
};

export default function RootLayout({ children }: LayoutProps<"/">) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" className={`light ${beVietnamPro.variable} h-full`}>
      <head>
        {/* Material Symbols is an icon font with no next/font loader, so it
            stays a CDN link. Preconnect first to cut the handshake cost. */}
        <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
        <link
          rel="preconnect"
          href="https://fonts.gstatic.com"
          crossOrigin="anonymous"
        />
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-page-custom-font --
            the rule warns about fonts added outside pages/_document.js, which
            does not apply here: this is the App Router root layout, so the
            stylesheet is emitted on every page, not one. */}
        <link
          rel="stylesheet"
          href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Material+Symbols+Outlined:wght,FILL@100..700,0..1&display=swap"
        />
      </head>
      <body className="min-h-full antialiased">
        <Providers>{children}</Providers>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}

===== src\app\page.tsx =====
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { ROLE_HOME } from "@/config/roles";
import { getOptionalSession } from "@/app/lib/dal";

/**
 * Root. Sends a signed-in user to their role's dashboard and everyone else to
 * staff login. proxy.ts normally handles this first; this covers the case
 * where the matcher does not run.
 */
export default async function RootPage() {
  const session = await getOptionalSession();
  redirect(session ? ROLE_HOME[session.role] : "/login");
}

===== src\app\providers.tsx =====
"use client";

import { useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import {
  QueryClient,
  QueryClientProvider,
  isServer,
} from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Toaster } from "@/components/ui/toaster";

function makeQueryClient() {
  return new QueryClient({
    defaultOptions: {
      queries: {
        // Payroll and attendance data is request-scoped; a short stale window
        // avoids refetch storms without serving genuinely old figures.
        staleTime: 30 * 1000,
        gcTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
        refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
        retry: (failureCount, error) => {
          // Never retry an auth/permission failure — it will not recover.
          const status = (error as { status?: number })?.status;
          if (status === 401 || status === 403 || status === 404) return false;
          return failureCount < 2;
        },
      },
      mutations: {
        retry: false,
      },
    },
  });
}

let browserQueryClient: QueryClient | undefined;

function getQueryClient() {
  if (isServer) {
    // Always a fresh client on the server so one request never sees another's data.
    return makeQueryClient();
  }
  browserQueryClient ??= makeQueryClient();
  return browserQueryClient;
}

export function Providers({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [queryClient] = useState(getQueryClient);

  return (
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
      {children}
      <Toaster />
    </QueryClientProvider>
  );
}

===== src\app\(auth)\agent-login\page.tsx =====
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";

import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { BrandMark } from "@/components/shared/brand-logo";
import { AgentLoginForm } from "@/components/features/auth/agent-login-form";

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Agent Portal Login",

/**
 * Agent portal sign-in. Entry point for the AGENT role, which lands in the
 * /agent namespace.
 *
 * Agents are a distinct principal — external suppliers of outsourced staff
 * (employees.agent_id), billed via service charge and VAT rather than payroll.
 * Hence the separate door and the orange brand treatment.
 */
export default function AgentLoginPage() {
  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-dvh w-full bg-background font-body-md text-on-surface">
      <main className="flex min-h-dvh w-full flex-col md:flex-row">
        {/* ------------------------------------------- LEFT: brand panel */}
        <section className="bg-orange-gradient relative hidden flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden p-12 text-on-primary md:flex md:w-[45%] lg:w-[40%]">
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute right-[-10%] top-[-10%] h-[120%] w-[120%] opacity-20">

              viewBox="0 0 100 100"
              xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"

===== src\app\(portal)\error.tsx =====
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useEffect } from "react";

import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";

/**
 * Route-level error boundary for the portal shell.
 *
 * Rendered inside the shell, so a failed page leaves the rail and top bar
 * intact — the user can navigate somewhere else instead of hitting a dead end.
 *
 * `error.message` is deliberately NOT shown. In production Next.js replaces it
 * with a generic string anyway, and in development a raw stack or a leaked
 * query fragment is not something to put in front of an HR user. The `digest`
 * is shown instead: it is the value that correlates with the server log, which
 * is what support actually needs.
 */
export default function PortalError({
  error,
  reset,
}: {
  error: Error & { digest?: string };
  reset: () => void;
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    // Wire to the real reporter when one exists.
    console.error("Portal route error:", error);
  }, [error]);

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-[60vh] flex-col items-center justify-center px-4 text-center">
      <span className="mb-4 flex size-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-error-container/40">
        <Icon name="error" className="text-[28px] text-error" />
      </span>

      <h1 className="font-display-greeting text-lg text-on-surface sm:text-display-greeting">
        This page didn&rsquo;t load
      </h1>

      <p className="mt-2 max-w-md font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">
        Something went wrong on our side. Your data is safe — nothing was
        changed by this error.
      </p>

      {error.digest ? (
        <p className="mt-3 font-mono text-[10px] text-outline">
          Reference: {error.digest}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <div className="mt-6 flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row">
        <button
          type="button"
          data-live=""
          onClick={reset}
          className="flex h-10 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-primary px-5 font-body-md text-body-md font-semibold text-on-primary shadow-ambient-1 transition-colors hover:bg-primary-container focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/40"
        >
          <Icon name="refresh" className="text-[18px]" />
          Try again
        </button>

        {/* Escape hatch: retrying a page that is deterministically broken just
            reproduces the error, so offer a way out of it. */}
        <Link
          href="/"
          className="flex h-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-outline-variant px-5 font-body-md text-body-md font-semibold text-on-surface transition-colors hover:bg-surface-container-low"
        >
          Go to dashboard
        </Link>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\app\(portal)\layout.tsx =====
import { cookies } from "next/headers";

import { AppRail } from "@/components/layout/app-rail";
import { NavProvider, SIDEBAR_COOKIE } from "@/components/layout/nav-context";
import { StubActionBridge } from "@/components/layout/stub-action-bridge";
import { Topbar } from "@/components/layout/topbar";
import { getCurrentUser } from "@/app/lib/dal";

/**
 * Protected shell for all 9 role portals.
 *
 * `getCurrentUser()` calls `verifySession()`, which redirects to /login when
 * there is no valid session and to /set-password when
 * `users.must_change_password` is set. This is the real gate — `proxy.ts` is
 * only an optimistic pre-filter.
 *
 * The rail is built from the session role, so a user never sees navigation for
 * a namespace they cannot enter.
 *
 * Layout: full-bleed. The shell owns the whole viewport — the rail and the
 * content column are the only two children of a single flex row, so expanding
 * the rail pushes the content instead of covering it. `min-w-0` on the content
 * column is load-bearing: without it a wide table sets the flex item's minimum
 * size and the rail animation shoves the page sideways instead of reflowing it.
 *
 * `max-w-content` caps the reading column on ultrawide displays. Full-bleed
 * means the chrome reaches the edges; it does not mean a 3440px line length.
 */
export default async function PortalLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const [user, cookieStore] = await Promise.all([getCurrentUser(), cookies()]);

  // Picked on the server so the first paint is already the right width — a
  // client-side read would flash the collapsed rail on every navigation.
  const expanded = cookieStore.get(SIDEBAR_COOKIE)?.value === "1";

  return (
    <NavProvider defaultExpanded={expanded}>
      <StubActionBridge />
      <div className="flex h-dvh w-full overflow-hidden bg-surface-bright">
        {/* Chrome is interactive by construction — exempt from the stub net. */}
        <div data-live-region className="contents">
          <AppRail role={user.role} />
        </div>

        <main className="relative z-0 flex h-full min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col overflow-hidden">
          <Topbar user={user} />

          <div className="no-scrollbar flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 pb-8 pt-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-container-margin">
            <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-content">{children}</div>
          </div>
        </main>
      </div>
    </NavProvider>
  );
}

===== src\app\(portal)\loading.tsx =====
/**
 * Route-level loading state for the portal shell.
 *
 * Rendered inside the shell (the top bar and rail stay put) while a route's
 * server components stream in, so navigation reads as "content loading" rather
 * than "the app just crashed". The shape mirrors a typical list screen: a page
 * header, a row of KPI tiles, then a table — so the first paint is as close to
 * the final layout as a skeleton can get.
 */
export default function PortalLoading() {
  return (
    <div className="animate-pulse motion-reduce:animate-none" role="status">
      <span className="sr-only">Loading page…</span>

      <div className="mb-6 space-y-2">
        <div className="h-7 w-48 rounded-md bg-surface-container-high sm:w-64" />
        <div className="h-4 w-72 max-w-full rounded-md bg-surface-container-high/70" />
      </div>

      <div className="mb-gutter grid grid-cols-2 gap-gutter lg:grid-cols-4">
        {Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, i) => (
          <div
            key={i}
            className="h-28 rounded-card bg-surface-container-lowest shadow-ambient-1"
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-card bg-surface-container-lowest p-4 shadow-ambient-1 sm:p-card-padding">
        <div className="mb-6 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="h-5 w-40 rounded-md bg-surface-container-high" />
          <div className="hidden gap-2 sm:flex">
            <div className="h-9 w-24 rounded-lg bg-surface-container-high" />
            <div className="h-9 w-24 rounded-lg bg-surface-container-high" />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, i) => (
            <div
              key={i}
              className="h-10 rounded-lg bg-surface-container-high/60"
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

}

===== src\app\(portal)\admin\agents\page.tsx =====
import Link from "next/link";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { ApiError } from "@/app/lib/api-error";
import { requirePermission } from "@/app/lib/dal";
import { BentoCard } from "@/components/shared/bento-card";
import { DataUnavailable } from "@/components/shared/data-unavailable";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/shared/empty-state";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/shared/status-badge";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { getAgents } from "@/lib/api/agent";
import { formatMoney, formatNumber, formatPercent, initials } from "@/lib/format";
import type { AgentResponse, ChargeType } from "@/types";

/**
 * Labour agents directory.
 *
 * Every figure on this screen comes from `GET /agents`, which returns the whole
 * table as `List<AgentResponse>` — there is no paging, so there are no page
 * controls either.
 *
 * Two tiles the Stitch brief asks for are absent rather than faked:
 * "Pending Commissions" and a month-over-month agent delta. Neither has a
 * source in the schema or the API — `agent_payroll_summaries` holds commission
 * only once a payroll run has produced it, and nothing tracks an agent
 * creation trend. An invented number on a financial screen is worse than no
 * number, so the layout drops them and keeps what is real.
 */

const CHARGE_TYPE_LABEL: Record<ChargeType, string> = {
  PER_EMPLOYEE: "Per Employee",
  PERCENTAGE_OF_GROSS: "% of Gross",
  FIXED_MONTHLY: "Fixed Monthly",
  CUSTOM: "Custom",
};

const CHARGE_TYPE_CHIP: Record<ChargeType, string> = {
  PER_EMPLOYEE: "bg-blue-soft text-primary-container",
  PERCENTAGE_OF_GROSS: "bg-tertiary-container/10 text-tertiary-container",
  FIXED_MONTHLY: "bg-surface-container-low text-on-surface-variant",
  CUSTOM: "bg-surface-container-low text-on-surface-variant",
};

/** Renders whichever of the two charge columns actually carries this agent's rate. */
function chargeLabel(agent: AgentResponse): string {
  switch (agent.chargeType) {
    case "PERCENTAGE_OF_GROSS":
      // Two decimals: the column is DECIMAL(5,2) and a commission rate rounded
      // to a whole percent would misstate the contract.
      return agent.chargePercentage === null
        ? "—"
        : `${formatPercent(agent.chargePercentage, 2)} of gross`;
    case "PER_EMPLOYEE":
    case "FIXED_MONTHLY":
      return agent.chargeAmount === null
        ? "—"
        : formatMoney(agent.chargeAmount);
    case "CUSTOM":
      return "Per contract";
  }
}

/**
 * Agent detail: contract terms and the staff that agent has deployed.
 *
 * Both reads exist today — `GET /agents/{id}` and `GET /employees/by-agent/{id}`
 * — so the roster and every contract field are live.
 *
 * Gated on `agent:read`, not `agent:write`: the backend opens this record to
 * PAYROLL_OFFICER as well, and a read page that bounces a role the API admits
 * is a bug in the gate, not in the API. The write controls are gated
 * individually instead, because the two writes have *different* audiences —
 * `PUT /agents/{id}` accepts ADMIN, `PUT /agents/{id}/deactivate` is
 * SUPER_ADMIN only.
 *
 * Two cards the placeholder carried are gone rather than stubbed: **outstanding
 * advances** (there is no agent-advance read on this endpoint and no
 * `/agent-advances` client module yet) and **invoice history** (no invoice
 * endpoint, and the placeholder linked into `/manager/*`, a namespace that does
 * not exist in this app).
 */

const CHARGE_TYPE_LABEL: Record<ChargeType, string> = {
  PER_EMPLOYEE: "Per Employee",
  PERCENTAGE_OF_GROSS: "Percentage of Gross",
  FIXED_MONTHLY: "Fixed Monthly",
  CUSTOM: "Custom",
};

/** The rate, read off whichever column the charge type actually uses. */
function chargeValue(agent: AgentResponse): string {
  switch (agent.chargeType) {
    case "PERCENTAGE_OF_GROSS":
      return agent.chargePercentage === null
        ? "—"
        : `${agent.chargePercentage.toFixed(2)}%`;
    case "PER_EMPLOYEE":
    case "FIXED_MONTHLY":
      return formatMoney(agent.chargeAmount);
    case "CUSTOM":
      return "Per contract";
  }
}

export default async function AgentDetailPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  await requirePermission("agent:read");

  const { id } = await params;
  const agentId = Number(id);

  if (!Number.isInteger(agentId) || agentId <= 0) notFound();

  const viewer = await getCurrentUser();

  let agent: AgentResponse;
  let staff: EmployeeSummaryResponse[];

  try {
    [agent, staff] = await Promise.all([
      getAgent(agentId),
      getAgentStaff(agentId),
    ]);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.isUnauthorized) redirect("/login");
    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.isNotFound) notFound();

    return (
      <DataUnavailable
        title="Labour Agent"
        description="Contract terms and deployed staff."
        subject="This agent"
        reason={error instanceof ApiError ? error.message : undefined}
      />
    );
  }

  const canEdit = viewer.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" || viewer.role === "ADMIN";
  const canDeactivate = viewer.role === "SUPER_ADMIN";

import Link from "next/link";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { ApiError } from "@/app/lib/api-error";
import { requirePermission } from "@/app/lib/dal";
import { AttendanceFilters } from "@/components/features/attendance/attendance-filters";
import { LiveAttendanceBoard } from "@/components/features/attendance/live-attendance-board";
import { BentoCard } from "@/components/shared/bento-card";
import { FilterTabs, type FilterTab } from "@/components/shared/filter-tabs";
import { CountPill, PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/shared/status-badge";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import {
  getAttendanceActivity,
  getAttendanceDevices,
  getAttendanceRecords,
  getAttendanceSummary,
  getAttendanceSyncFailures,
} from "@/lib/api/attendance";
import {
  formatDate,
  formatHours,
  formatNumber,
  formatPercent,
  formatRelativeTime,
  formatTime,
  initials,
} from "@/lib/format";
import type {
  AttendanceActivityItem,
  AttendanceDashboardSummary,
  AttendanceDeviceItem,
  AttendanceRecordItem,
  AttendanceSource,
  AttendanceSyncFailure,
  Paginated,
} from "@/types";

/**
 * Company-wide attendance board for SUPER_ADMIN and ADMIN.
 *
 * This is the screen the biometric chain was built for: an employee
 * fingerprints at a branch terminal, HrpayrollDesktop pushes the event to
 * `POST /attendance/biometric/sync`, and it surfaces here — the tiles and the
 * activity feed live (see `LiveAttendanceBoard`), the records table and the
 * device fleet on the server-rendered pass.
 *
 * Read-only by design. Corrections, manual entries and device enrolment belong
 * on the HR surfaces; an admin console that silently wrote attendance rows
 * would be a second source of truth for the same table.
 *
 * Every figure comes from `controller/attendance/AttendanceDashboardController`.
 * Nothing here is placeholder data.
 */

/** Mirrors the icon map on the HR attendance screen. */
const SOURCE_ICON: Record<AttendanceSource, string> = {
  BIOMETRIC: "fingerprint",
  MANUAL: "badge",
  MOBILE: "smartphone",
  WEB: "language",
};

/**
 * Only two tabs, because the backend exposes one boolean: `openOnly`.
 * A "Completed" tab would have to filter the current page in the browser, which
 * lies as soon as the results are paginated.
 */
const RECORD_TABS: readonly FilterTab[] = [
  { label: "All records" },
  { label: "On site now", value: "open" },
];

const RECORD_PAGE_SIZE = 25;

function first(value: string | string[] | undefined): string | undefined {
  return Array.isArray(value) ? value[0] : value;
}

function parseBranchId(value: string | undefined): number | undefined {
  if (!value) return undefined;
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isInteger(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : undefined;
}

/** `yyyy-MM-dd` only. The backend rejects anything else with a 400. */
function parseDate(value: string | undefined): string | undefined {
  return value && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value) ? value : undefined;
}

function parsePage(value: string | undefined): number {
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isInteger(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : 0;
}

/** Rebuilds the query string for a records-table page link. */
function pageHref(
  page: number,
  filters: { branchId?: number; date?: string; filter?: string },
): string {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (filters.branchId) params.set("branchId", String(filters.branchId));
  if (filters.date) params.set("date", filters.date);
  if (filters.filter) params.set("filter", filters.filter);
  if (page > 0) params.set("page", String(page));

  const query = params.toString();
  return query ? `/admin/attendance?${query}` : "/admin/attendance";
}

type BoardData = {
  summary: AttendanceDashboardSummary;
  activity: AttendanceActivityItem[];
  records: Paginated<AttendanceRecordItem>;
  devices: AttendanceDeviceItem[];
  syncFailures: AttendanceSyncFailure[];
};

/**
 * All five reads in one round trip.
 *
 * `sync-failures` is restricted to ADMIN_ROLES on the backend while the other
 * four are open to VIEW_ROLES — which is the same set here, because this route
 * only ever renders for SUPER_ADMIN and ADMIN. If that ever diverges, this is
 * the call that starts throwing 403 and takes the whole board down with it.
 */
async function loadBoard(filters: {
  date?: string;
  branchId?: number;
  openOnly: boolean;
  page: number;
}): Promise<BoardData> {
  const { date, branchId, openOnly, page } = filters;

  const [summary, activity, records, devices, syncFailures] = await Promise.all([
    getAttendanceSummary({ date, branchId }),
    getAttendanceActivity({ branchId, limit: 50 }),
    getAttendanceRecords({
      branchId,
      // Omitted when no date is chosen, which tells the backend "today" in the
      // company timezone rather than in the browser's.
      start: date,
      end: date,
      openOnly,
      page,
      size: RECORD_PAGE_SIZE,
    }),
    getAttendanceDevices({ branchId }),
    getAttendanceSyncFailures(),
  ]);

  return { summary, activity, records, devices, syncFailures };
}

export default async function AdminAttendancePage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{
    branchId?: string;
    date?: string;
    filter?: string;
    page?: string;
  }>;
}) {
  // SUPER_ADMIN and ADMIN both hold `attendance:read`; anyone else is bounced
  // to their own namespace before a single figure renders.
  await requirePermission("attendance:read");

  // searchParams is a Promise in Next.js 16 — it must be awaited.
  const params = await searchParams;

  const branchId = parseBranchId(first(params.branchId));
  const date = parseDate(first(params.date));
  const filter = first(params.filter);
  const openOnly = filter === "open";
  const page = parsePage(first(params.page));

  let data: BoardData;

  try {
    data = await loadBoard({ date, branchId, openOnly, page });
  } catch (error) {
    // A spent session is a session, not an error page. `api-client` has already
    // tried the refresh once, so a 401 here means the refresh token is gone too.
    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.isUnauthorized) {
      redirect("/login");
    }

    // Anything else — the backend being down is the common case — keeps the
    // page chrome and says what actually went wrong. The portal error boundary
    // deliberately hides `message`, which is the wrong trade for a dev-stage
    // service that is simply not running.
    const message =
      error instanceof ApiError
        ? error.message
        : "Unable to reach the attendance service.";

    return <LoadFailure message={message} />;
  }

  const { summary, activity, records, devices, syncFailures } = data;
  // Always page 1: "full log" means "start from the top", not "reopen whichever
  // page the records table happens to be on".
  const recordsHref = pageHref(0, { branchId, date });
  const activeRate = summary.attendanceRatePercent;

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Attendance"
        description="Live biometric clock-in and clock-out activity across every branch."
        pill={
          <CountPill
            label={`${formatPercent(activeRate)} reported`}
            tone={
              activeRate >= 85 ? "success" : activeRate > 0 ? "warning" : "neutral"
            }
          />
        }
        actions={
          <AttendanceFilters
            branches={summary.branches}
            branchId={branchId}
            date={date ?? summary.date}
            filter={filter}
          />
        }
      />

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-gutter">
        <LiveAttendanceBoard
          initialSnapshot={{
            summary,
            activity,
            fetchedAt: summary.generatedAt,
          }}
          branchId={branchId}
          recordsHref={recordsHref}
        />

        <div className="grid grid-cols-12 gap-gutter">
          {/* ───────────────────────────── main column ───────────────────── */}
          <div className="col-span-12 flex flex-col gap-gutter lg:col-span-8">
            <BentoCard
              title={
                <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Icon name="table_view" className="text-[18px] text-on-surface-variant" />
                  {openOnly ? "On site now" : "Attendance records"}
                </span>
              }
              subtitle={`${formatDate(summary.date)} · ${formatNumber(records.totalElements)} ${
                records.totalElements === 1 ? "record" : "records"
              }`}
              action={
                <FilterTabs
                  tabs={RECORD_TABS}
                  active={filter}
                  basePath="/admin/attendance"
                  preserve={{
                    branchId: branchId ? String(branchId) : undefined,
                    date,
                  }}
                />
              }
            >
              {records.content.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="rounded-card border border-dashed border-outline-variant px-4 py-12 text-center">
                  <Icon
                    name="event_busy"
                    className="text-[40px] text-outline-variant"
                  />
                  <p className="mt-2 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">
                    {openOnly
                      ? "Nobody is clocked in right now."
                      : "No attendance recorded for this day."}
                  </p>
                  {/* The likeliest reason on a fresh install is that the
                      terminal has nothing to report with, not that nobody
                      showed up. */}
                  <p className="mx-auto mt-1 max-w-md text-[11px] text-outline">
                    Biometric events only reach this table once the branch
                    terminal is registered under Devices and each employee has
                    enrolled a fingerprint on it.
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="data-table w-full border-collapse text-left">
                    <thead>
                      <tr>
                        <th className="pb-3 pl-2 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                          Employee
                        </th>
                        <th className="pb-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                          Branch
                        </th>
                        <th className="pb-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                          Position
                        </th>
                        <th className="pb-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                          Clock In
                        </th>
                        <th className="pb-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                          Clock Out
                        </th>
                        <th className="pb-3 text-right font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                          Hours
                        </th>
                        <th className="pb-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                          Source
                        </th>
                        <th className="pb-3 pr-2 text-right font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                          Status
                        </th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>

                    <tbody className="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface">
                      {records.content.map((record) => (
                        <tr key={record.id} className="transition-colors">
                          <td className="py-3 pl-2">
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-3">
                              <span
                                aria-hidden
                                className="flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary-container text-[11px] font-bold text-on-primary"
                              >
                                {initials(record.employeeName)}
                              </span>
                              <span className="min-w-0">
                                <span className="block truncate font-medium">
                                  {record.employeeName ?? "Unknown employee"}
                                </span>
                                <span className="block text-[10px] text-outline">
                                  {record.employeeNumber ?? "—"}
                                </span>
                              </span>
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3 text-on-surface-variant">
                            {record.branchName ?? "—"}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3 text-on-surface-variant">
                            {record.position ?? "—"}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3 tabular-nums">
                            {formatTime(record.clockIn)}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3 tabular-nums text-outline">
                            {formatTime(record.clockOut)}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                            {formatHours(record.hoursWorked)}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3">
                            <span
                              className="flex items-center gap-1 text-outline"
                              title={record.source.toLowerCase()}
                            >
                              <Icon
                                name={SOURCE_ICON[record.source]}
                                className="text-[18px]"
                              />
                              <span className="sr-only">
                                {record.source.toLowerCase()}
                              </span>
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3 pr-2 text-right">
                            <StatusBadge status={record.status} />
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>

                  {/* Pagination is links, not buttons: the page number belongs
                      in the URL like every other filter on this screen. */}
                  {records.totalPages > 1 ? (
                    <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-outline-variant/40 pt-4 text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant">
                      <span>
                        Page {formatNumber(records.pageNumber + 1)} of{" "}
                        {formatNumber(records.totalPages)}
                      </span>

                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        {records.pageNumber > 0 ? (
                          <Link
                            href={pageHref(records.pageNumber - 1, {
                              branchId,
                              date,
                              filter,
                            })}
                            className="rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 transition-colors hover:bg-surface-container-low"
                          >
                            Previous
                          </Link>
                        ) : null}

                        {!records.last ? (
                          <Link
                            href={pageHref(records.pageNumber + 1, {
                              branchId,
                              date,
                              filter,
                            })}
                            className="rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 transition-colors hover:bg-surface-container-low"
                          >
                            Next
                          </Link>
                        ) : null}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
              )}
            </BentoCard>
          </div>

          {/* ──────────────────────────── side column ────────────────────── */}
          <div className="col-span-12 flex flex-col gap-gutter lg:col-span-4">
            <BentoCard
              title={
                <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Icon name="dns" className="text-[18px] text-on-surface-variant" />
                  Terminals
                </span>
              }
              subtitle={`${formatNumber(summary.devicesOnline)} of ${formatNumber(summary.devicesTotal)} reporting`}
            >
              {devices.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="py-6 text-center font-body-md text-body-md text-outline">
                  No terminals registered for this branch yet.
                </p>
              ) : (
                <ul className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                  {devices.map((device) => (
                    <li
                      key={device.id}
                      className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"
                    >
                      <span className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2.5">
                        <span
                          aria-hidden
                          className={`size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full ${
                            device.online ? "bg-green-main" : "bg-outline-variant"
                          }`}
                        />
                        <span className="min-w-0">
                          <span className="block truncate font-mono text-[11px] text-on-surface">
                            {device.deviceSerial}
                          </span>
                          <span className="block truncate text-[10px] text-outline">
                            {device.branchName ?? "Unassigned"}
                          </span>
                        </span>
                      </span>

                      <span className="shrink-0 text-right text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant">
                        {device.online ? (
                          <span className="font-semibold text-green-main">
                            Online
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          formatRelativeTime(device.lastSyncAt)
                        )}
                      </span>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              )}
            </BentoCard>

            <BentoCard
              title={
                <span
                  className={
                    syncFailures.length > 0
                      ? "flex items-center gap-2 text-error"
                      : "flex items-center gap-2 text-on-surface"
                  }
                >
                  <Icon name="sync_problem" className="text-[18px]" />
                  Rejected Scans
                </span>
              }
              subtitle="Scans the backend refused"
            >
              {syncFailures.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="py-6 text-center font-body-md text-body-md text-outline">
                  No rejected scans.
                </p>
              ) : (
                <ul className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                  {syncFailures.slice(0, 8).map((failure) => (
                    <li
                      key={failure.id}
                      className="rounded-lg border border-error/20 bg-error/5 p-3"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                        <span className="min-w-0 truncate text-[11px] font-semibold text-on-surface">
                          {failure.employeeName ??
                            failure.deviceSerial ??
                            "Unknown terminal"}
                        </span>
                        <span className="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-outline">
                          {formatRelativeTime(failure.createdAt)}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-error">
                        {failure.reason}
                      </p>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              )}

              {syncFailures.length > 0 ? (
                <p className="mt-3 text-[10px] text-outline">
                  A rejected scan leaves no attendance row. Reprovision the
                  employee on the terminal, then have them scan again.
                </p>
              ) : null}
            </BentoCard>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * Shown when the API cannot be reached at all.
 *
 * Deliberately keeps the page header's slot empty rather than rendering a
 * half-populated board: a dashboard that shows zeros because the backend is
 * down reads exactly like a dashboard that shows zeros because nobody came to
 * work, and an administrator will act on the second reading.
 */
function LoadFailure({ message }: { message: string }) {
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Attendance"
        description="Live biometric clock-in and clock-out activity across every branch."
      />

      <div className="rounded-card border border-dashed border-error/40 bg-error/5 p-8 text-center">
        <Icon name="cloud_off" className="text-[40px] text-error" />
        <p className="mt-3 font-body-md text-body-md font-semibold text-on-surface">
          Attendance could not be loaded
        </p>
        <p className="mx-auto mt-1 max-w-md font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">
          {message}
        </p>
        <p className="mx-auto mt-3 max-w-md text-[11px] text-outline">
          Check that the backend is running and that <code>API_BASE_URL</code> in{" "}
          <code>.env.local</code> matches the port it listens on.
        </p>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

                              {event.actorIcon ? <Icon name={event.actorIcon} className="text-[14px]" /> : event.actorInitials}
                            </div>
                          )}
                          <div className="flex flex-col">

                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono text-[11px] text-outline">{event.ip}</td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                        <span
                          className={
                            event.result === "SUCCESS"
                              ? "inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-tertiary-container/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-tertiary"
                              : "inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-error-container/50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-error"
                          }
                        >
                          {event.result === "SUCCESS" ? "Success" : "Failure"}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </BentoCard>
        </div>

        {/* ────────────────────────────── side column ──────────────────── */}
        <div className="col-span-12 flex flex-col gap-gutter xl:col-span-4">
          <BentoCard title="Events by Module" subtitle="Volume distribution last 30 days">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
              {MODULE_SHARE.map((item) => (
                <div key={item.label}>
                  <div className="mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1 font-body-md text-[11px] font-medium text-on-surface">
                      <Icon name={item.icon} className={`text-[14px] ${item.colorClassName.replace("bg-", "text-")}`} />
                      {item.label}
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-body-md text-[11px] font-bold text-on-surface">{item.percent}%</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="h-1.5 w-full rounded-full bg-surface-container-high">
                    <div className={`h-1.5 rounded-full ${item.colorClassName}`} style={{ width: `${item.percent}%` }} />
                  </div>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-right text-[9px] text-on-surface-variant">{formatNumber(item.count)} events</p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <button className="mt-6 flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-surface-container-low py-2 font-body-md text-[11px] font-semibold text-primary transition-colors hover:bg-primary-container/10">
              View Detailed Analytics
              <Icon name="arrow_forward" className="text-sm" />
            </button>
          </BentoCard>

          <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-card bg-primary p-card-padding text-on-primary shadow-md">
            <div className="absolute -right-10 -top-10 size-32 rounded-full bg-on-primary/10 blur-xl" />
            <div className="relative z-10">
              <h3 className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 font-body-md text-body-md font-bold">
                <Icon name="security" />
                Security Alert
              </h3>
              <p className="mb-4 text-[11px] text-on-primary/80">
                Unusual number of failed login attempts detected in the last 24 hours.
              </p>
              <button className="w-full rounded-lg bg-on-primary px-4 py-2 font-body-md text-[11px] font-bold text-primary transition-colors hover:bg-surface-container-low">
                Investigate Now
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { ApiError } from "@/app/lib/api-error";
import { requirePermission } from "@/app/lib/dal";
import { BentoCard } from "@/components/shared/bento-card";
import { DonutChart } from "@/components/shared/charts";
import { DataUnavailable } from "@/components/shared/data-unavailable";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/shared/empty-state";
import { FilterTabs, type FilterTab } from "@/components/shared/filter-tabs";
import { CountPill, PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { SegmentStrip } from "@/components/shared/segment-strip";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/shared/status-badge";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { getBranches } from "@/lib/api/branch";
import { getEmployeesByBranch } from "@/lib/api/employee";
import { formatNumber } from "@/lib/format";
import type { BranchResponse } from "@/types";

/**
 * Branch directory.
 *
 * `GET /branches` returns `List<BranchResponse>` — the bare entity, with no
 * aggregates. Three columns the Stitch brief asks for therefore have no source
 * and are gone rather than invented: **region** (there is no such column on
 * `branches`), **attendance %** and **payroll total** (neither is projected
 * onto this endpoint; both would need a dashboard-style aggregate the backend
 * does not serve today).
 *
 * Headcount is the exception, and it is real: the backend has no
 * count-per-branch projection either, but it does expose
 * `GET /employees/by-branch/{id}`, so the page fans out one call per branch and
 * counts the result. That is O(branches) requests — acceptable at seven, and
 * flagged here because it would not be at seventy. The fix at that size is a
 * `employeeCount` field on `BranchResponse`, not a bigger fan-out.
 */

const STATUS_TABS: readonly FilterTab[] = [
  { label: "All Branches" },
  { label: "Active", value: "ACTIVE" },
  { label: "Inactive", value: "INACTIVE" },
];

/** Shared palette for the headcount donut; cycles if there are more branches. */
const DONUT_COLORS = [
  "var(--color-blue)",
  "var(--color-green-main)",
  "var(--color-amber-main)",
  "var(--color-chart-track)",
];

export default async function BranchesPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ status?: string }>;
}) {
  await requirePermission("branch:read");

  // searchParams is a Promise in Next.js 16 — it must be awaited.
  const { status } = await searchParams;

  let branches: BranchResponse[];

  try {
    branches = await getBranches();
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.isUnauthorized) redirect("/login");

    return (
      <DataUnavailable
        title="Branches"
        description="Manage organization locations and regional performance."
        subject="The branch directory"
        reason={error instanceof ApiError ? error.message : undefined}
      />
    );
  }

  // Headcounts are a second, independent read. `allSettled` so one failing
  // branch does not blank a page whose primary data loaded fine — a missing
  // count renders as "—", which is honest, where losing the directory is not.
  const counts = await Promise.allSettled(
    branches.map((branch) => getEmployeesByBranch(branch.id)),
  );

  const headcount = new Map<number, number | null>(
    branches.map((branch, index) => {
      const result = counts[index];
      return [
        branch.id,
        result && result.status === "fulfilled" ? result.value.length : null,
      ];
    }),
  );

  const rows = status
    ? branches.filter((branch) => branch.status === status)
    : branches;

  const active = branches.filter((branch) => branch.status === "ACTIVE").length;
  const unmanaged = branches.filter((branch) => branch.managerName === null);
  const counted = [...headcount.values()].filter(
    (value): value is number => value !== null,
  );
  const totalEmployees = counted.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Branches"
        description="Manage organization locations and regional performance."
        pill={<CountPill label={`${active} Active`} />}
        actions={
          <button
            type="button"
            className="bento-shadow flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-primary px-5 py-2.5 font-body-md text-body-md font-bold text-on-primary transition-colors hover:bg-on-primary-fixed-variant"
          >
            <Icon name="add" className="text-[18px]" />
            Add Branch
          </button>
        }
      />

      <div className="grid grid-cols-12 gap-gutter">
        {/* ─────────────────────────────── main column ─────────────────── */}
        <div className="col-span-12 flex flex-col gap-gutter lg:col-span-8">
          <div className="bento-shadow flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-card bg-surface-container-lowest p-3">
            <FilterTabs
              tabs={STATUS_TABS}
              active={status}
              param="status"
              basePath="/admin/branches"
            />
          </div>

          <BentoCard
            title={status ? `${status === "ACTIVE" ? "Active" : "Inactive"} branches` : "All branches"}
            subtitle={`${formatNumber(rows.length)} shown · ${formatNumber(totalEmployees)} employees`}
          >
            {rows.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                symbol="location_off"
                title="No branches to show"
                description={
                  status
                    ? "No branch currently holds this status."
                    : "Branches appear here once they have been created."
                }
              />
            ) : (
              <div className="w-full overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="data-table w-full border-collapse text-left">
                  <thead>
                    <tr>
                      <th className="pb-3 pl-2 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                        Branch
                      </th>
                      <th className="pb-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                        Manager
                      </th>
                      <th className="pb-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                        Contact
                      </th>
                      <th className="pb-3 text-right font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                        Employees
                      </th>
                      <th className="pb-3 pr-2 text-right font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                        Status
                      </th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>

                  <tbody className="font-body-md text-body-md">
                    {rows.map((branch) => {
                      const count = headcount.get(branch.id);

                      return (
                        <tr key={branch.id} className="group transition-colors">
                          <td className="py-3 pl-2">
                            <Link
                              href={`/admin/branches/${branch.id}`}
                              className="flex items-center gap-2"
                            >
                              <span className="flex size-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded bg-primary-container/10 text-primary-container">
                                <Icon name="location_city" className="text-sm" />
                              </span>
                              <span className="min-w-0">
                                <span className="block font-medium text-on-surface group-hover:text-primary-container">
                                  {branch.name}
                                </span>
                                <span className="block text-[10px] text-outline">
                                  {branch.code}
                                </span>
                              </span>
                            </Link>
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3 text-on-surface-variant">
                            {branch.managerName ?? (
                              <span className="text-amber-main">Unassigned</span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3 text-on-surface-variant">
                            {branch.phone ? (
                              <span className="block font-mono text-[11px]">
                                {branch.phone}
                              </span>
                            ) : null}
                            {branch.email ? (
                              <span className="block text-[10px] text-outline">
                                {branch.email}
                              </span>
                            ) : null}
                            {!branch.phone && !branch.email ? (
                              <span className="text-outline">—</span>
                            ) : null}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3 text-right tabular-nums text-on-surface-variant">
                            {count === null || count === undefined
                              ? "—"
                              : formatNumber(count)}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3 pr-2 text-right">
                            <StatusBadge status={branch.status} />
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
          </BentoCard>
        </div>

        {/* ────────────────────────────── side column ──────────────────── */}
        <div className="col-span-12 flex flex-col gap-gutter lg:col-span-4">
          <SegmentStrip
            segments={[
              { label: "Branches", value: formatNumber(branches.length) },
              { label: "Employees", value: formatNumber(totalEmployees) },
              {
                label: "Unassigned",
                value: formatNumber(unmanaged.length),
                tone: unmanaged.length > 0 ? "warning" : "default",
              },
            ]}
          />

          {counted.length > 0 ? (
            <BentoCard title="Headcount by branch">
              <DonutChart
                segments={branches
                  .filter((branch) => (headcount.get(branch.id) ?? 0) > 0)
                  .map((branch, index) => ({
                    label: branch.name,
                    value: headcount.get(branch.id) ?? 0,
                    color: DONUT_COLORS[index % DONUT_COLORS.length],
                  }))}
              />
            </BentoCard>
          ) : null}

          <BentoCard
            title="Needs attention"
            subtitle="Branches with no manager assigned"
          >
            {unmanaged.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="py-4 text-center font-body-md text-body-md text-outline">
                Every branch has a manager.
              </p>
            ) : (
              <ul className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                {unmanaged.map((branch) => (
                  <li key={branch.id}>
                    <Link
                      href={`/admin/branches/${branch.id}`}
                      className="group -mx-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg p-2 transition-colors hover:bg-surface-container"
                    >
                      <span className="min-w-0">
                        <span className="block truncate text-[11px] font-semibold text-on-surface group-hover:text-primary-container">
                          {branch.name}
                        </span>
                        <span className="block text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant">
                          {branch.code}
                        </span>
                      </span>
                      <span className="shrink-0 rounded bg-amber-main/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-main">
                        No manager
                      </span>
                    </Link>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </BentoCard>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { ApiError } from "@/app/lib/api-error";
import { getCurrentUser, requirePermission } from "@/app/lib/dal";
import { BentoCard } from "@/components/shared/bento-card";
import { DataUnavailable } from "@/components/shared/data-unavailable";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/shared/empty-state";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/shared/status-badge";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { getBranch } from "@/lib/api/branch";
import { getDevicesByBranch } from "@/lib/api/biometric";
import { getDepartmentsByBranch } from "@/lib/api/department";
import { getEmployeesByBranch } from "@/lib/api/employee";
import { formatNumber, formatRelativeTime, initials } from "@/lib/format";
import type {
  BiometricDeviceResponse,
  BranchResponse,
  DepartmentResponse,
  EmployeeSummaryResponse,
} from "@/types";

/**
 * Branch detail.
 *
 * Four concurrent reads, all of which exist today: the branch, its employees,
 * its departments, and its terminals. That is enough to make all three stat
 * tiles real counts rather than the literals the placeholder carried.
 *
 * Two things the placeholder showed have no source and are gone: the manager's
 * **email** (`BranchResponse` carries `managerName` only — the address would
 * need a join the endpoint does not do) and **"Manager since"** (`branches` has
 * no such column). A department's **staff count** is gone for the same reason:
 * `DepartmentResponse` has no employee count, and `EmployeeSummaryResponse`
 * carries no `departmentId` to count against. The fix for that last one is a
 * field on the response, not a client-side guess.
 */

/** A terminal that has not synced in this long reads as offline. */
const DEVICE_STALE_MINUTES = 60;

function isDeviceOnline(device: BiometricDeviceResponse): boolean {
  if (device.status !== "ACTIVE") return false;
  if (!device.lastSyncAt) return false;

  const ageMs = Date.now() - new Date(device.lastSyncAt).getTime();
  return ageMs <= DEVICE_STALE_MINUTES * 60_000;
}

export default async function BranchDetailPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  await requirePermission("branch:read");

  const { id } = await params;
  const branchId = Number(id);

  // A non-numeric segment is a bad URL, not a missing record.
  if (!Number.isInteger(branchId) || branchId <= 0) notFound();

  const viewer = await getCurrentUser();

  let branch: BranchResponse;
  let employees: EmployeeSummaryResponse[];
  let departments: DepartmentResponse[];
  let devices: BiometricDeviceResponse[];

  try {
    [branch, employees, departments, devices] = await Promise.all([
      getBranch(branchId),
      getEmployeesByBranch(branchId),
      getDepartmentsByBranch(branchId),
      getDevicesByBranch(branchId),
    ]);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.isUnauthorized) redirect("/login");
    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.isNotFound) notFound();

    return (
      <DataUnavailable
        title="Branch"
        description="Location detail, roster, departments and terminals."
        subject="This branch"
        reason={error instanceof ApiError ? error.message : undefined}
      />
    );
  }

  const onlineDevices = devices.filter(isDeviceOnline).length;

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title={
          <span className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Link
              href="/admin/branches"
              className="flex size-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-surface-container-lowest text-on-surface-variant shadow-ambient-1 transition-colors hover:text-primary"
            >
              <Icon name="arrow_back_ios_new" />
            </Link>
            {branch.name}
            <StatusBadge status={branch.status} />
          </span>
        }
        actions={
          <Link
            href="/admin/branches"
            className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-on-primary-fixed-variant px-6 py-2.5 font-body-md text-body-md font-semibold text-white shadow-ambient-1 transition-colors hover:bg-primary"
          >
            <Icon name="list" className="text-[18px]" />
            All Branches
          </Link>
        }
      />

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-gutter lg:grid-cols-12">
        {/* ───────────────────────────────── main column ─────────────────── */}
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-gutter lg:col-span-8">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-gutter sm:grid-cols-3">
            <BentoCard title={null} className="relative overflow-hidden">
              <div className="mb-2 flex items-start justify-between">
                <h3 className="font-body-md text-body-md font-semibold text-on-surface-variant">
                  Employees
                </h3>
                <span className="flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary-container/10 text-primary-container">
                  <Icon name="badge" className="text-[18px]" />
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="font-card-stat text-card-stat text-on-primary-fixed-variant">
                {formatNumber(employees.length)}
              </div>
            </BentoCard>

            <BentoCard title={null}>
              <div className="mb-2 flex items-start justify-between">
                <h3 className="font-body-md text-body-md font-semibold text-on-surface-variant">
                  Departments
                </h3>
                <span className="flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-blue-soft text-primary-container">
                  <Icon name="corporate_fare" className="text-[18px]" />
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="font-card-stat text-card-stat text-on-primary-fixed-variant">
                {formatNumber(departments.length)}
              </div>
            </BentoCard>

            <BentoCard title={null}>
              <div className="mb-2 flex items-start justify-between">
                <h3 className="font-body-md text-body-md font-semibold text-on-surface-variant">
                  Devices
                </h3>
                <span className="flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-tertiary-container/10 text-tertiary-container">
                  <Icon name="fingerprint" className="text-[18px]" />
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="font-card-stat text-card-stat text-on-primary-fixed-variant">
                {formatNumber(devices.length)}
              </div>
              <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant">
                {formatNumber(onlineDevices)} reporting

                        Name
                      </th>
                      <th className="pb-3 pr-2 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                        Head of Dept
                      </th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="font-body-md text-body-md">
                    {departments.map((dept) => (

                        <td className="py-3 pl-2 font-medium text-on-primary-fixed-variant">

                          {dept.headOfDepartmentName ? (

            )}
          </BentoCard>

          <BentoCard title="Contact Details">

                </dd>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                <dt className="text-on-surface-variant">Email</dt>
                <dd className="min-w-0 break-all text-right text-on-surface">
                  {branch.email ?? "—"}
                </dd>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                <dt className="text-on-surface-variant">Address</dt>
                <dd className="text-right text-on-surface">
                  {branch.address ?? "—"}
                </dd>
              </div>
            </dl>
          </BentoCard>

          <BentoCard
            title="Assigned Devices"
            action={
              <span className="rounded-full bg-surface-container px-2 py-1 font-label-rail text-label-rail text-on-surface-variant">
                {devices.length} Total
              </span>
            }
          >
            {devices.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                symbol="fingerprint"
                title="No terminals registered"
                description="Biometric terminals enrolled to this branch will appear here."
              />
            ) : (
              <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                {devices.map((device) => {
                  const online = isDeviceOnline(device);

                  return (
                    <li key={device.id}>
                      <div
                        className={
                          online
                            ? "flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-transparent p-3"
                            : "flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-error/20 bg-[#fff4f2] p-3"
                        }
                      >
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          <span
                            className={
                              online
                                ? "flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-surface-container text-primary"
                                : "flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-white text-error shadow-sm"
                            }
                          >
                            <Icon name={online ? "dns" : "warning"} />
                          </span>
                          <span>
                            <span
                              className={`block font-body-md text-body-md font-semibold ${
                                online
                                  ? "text-on-primary-fixed-variant"
                                  : "text-error"
                              }`}
                            >
                              {device.deviceSerial}
                            </span>
                            <span className="mt-0.5 block font-label-rail text-label-rail text-on-surface-variant">
                              {device.lastSyncAt
                                ? `Synced ${formatRelativeTime(device.lastSyncAt)}`
                                : "Never synced"}
                            </span>
                          </span>
                        </span>
                        <span
                          className={`size-2.5 rounded-full ${
                            online ? "bg-[#137333]" : "bg-error"
                          }`}
                        />
                      </div>
                    </li>
                  );
                })}
              </ul>
            )}

            {/* Deactivating a terminal is SUPER_ADMIN / ADMIN; the link to the
                fleet screen is shown to anyone who can read the branch. */}
            {viewer.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" || viewer.role === "ADMIN" ? (
              <div className="mt-2 border-t border-outline-variant/50 pt-3">
                <Link
                  href="/admin/devices"
                  className="block w-full py-1 text-center font-body-md text-body-md text-primary-container hover:underline"
                >
                  Manage Devices
                </Link>
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </BentoCard>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * Registered organization — singular, deliberately.
 *
 * The placeholder showed four fictional companies and a pager reading "of 42
 * entries". Neither is possible: `GET /company` is a singleton. This deployment
 * is single-tenant and the backend resolves the company itself, so there is no
 * company collection to list, page, or search. What renders instead is the one
 * registered entity with its real branch and employee counts.
 *
 * If the product is ever meant to administer several companies, that starts on
 * the backend with a company collection endpoint — and this page becomes a list
 * again at that point. Faking the list in the meantime would hide the gap.
 *
 * "Add Company" is gone with it: creating a tenant is not something this API
 * offers.
 */

export default async function CompaniesPage() {
  // Read gate, not a write gate. ADMIN holds `company:read` but not
  // `company:write` (SUPER_ADMIN-only), so gating the list on the write
  // permission bounced ADMIN off a screen whose brief puts it in their rail.
  await requirePermission("company:read");

  let company: CompanyResponse;
  let branches: BranchResponse[];

  try {
    [company, branches] = await Promise.all([getCompany(), getBranches()]);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.isUnauthorized) redirect("/login");

    return (
      <DataUnavailable
        title="Companies"
        description="The registered organization on this platform."
        subject="The company record"
        reason={error instanceof ApiError ? error.message : undefined}
      />
    );
  }

  // Real headcount. `allSettled` so one unreachable branch degrades to "—"
  // rather than blanking the page.
  const counts = await Promise.allSettled(
    branches.map((branch) => getEmployeesByBranch(branch.id)),
  );

  const totalEmployees = counts
    .filter(
      (result): result is PromiseFulfilledResult<EmployeeSummaryResponse[]> =>
        result.status === "fulfilled",
    )
    .reduce((sum, result) => sum + result.value.length, 0);

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Companies"

/**
 * Company detail — the platform owner's view of the registered entity.
 *
 * The route keeps its `[id]` segment, but the id is decorative: this
 * deployment is single-tenant and `GET /company` resolves the company itself,
 * so there is no per-id read to make. The segment is validated and then

 * "Departments" is absent from the metric row: there is no company-wide
 * department count, and producing one would mean fanning out
 * `GET /departments/by-branch/{id}` over every branch on top of the employee
 * fan-out below. Two aggregate tiles that are real beat three where one is a

export default async function CompanyDetailPage({

  const { id } = await params;
  const companyId = Number(id);

  if (!Number.isInteger(companyId) || companyId <= 0) notFound();

  let company: CompanyResponse;
  let branches: BranchResponse[];

  try {
    [company, branches] = await Promise.all([getCompany(), getBranches()]);
  } catch (error) {
