import Link from "next/link";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { ApiError } from "@/app/lib/api-error";
import { requireAnyPermission } from "@/app/lib/dal";
import { AlertSpotlight } from "@/components/shared/alert-spotlight";
import { BentoCard } from "@/components/shared/bento-card";
import { DataUnavailable } from "@/components/shared/data-unavailable";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/shared/empty-state";
import { SegmentStrip } from "@/components/shared/segment-strip";
import { StatCard } from "@/components/shared/stat-card";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { getAgents } from "@/lib/api/agent";
import { getAttendanceDevices, getAttendanceSummary } from "@/lib/api/attendance";
import { getBranches } from "@/lib/api/branch";
import { getEmployeesByBranch } from "@/lib/api/employee";
import { formatNumber, formatPercent, formatRelativeTime } from "@/lib/format";
import type { AttendanceDeviceItem, BranchResponse } from "@/types";

/**
 * Admin dashboard. Serves SUPER_ADMIN and ADMIN — both own /admin.
 *
 * Everything here is a real read: branch directory, the attendance summary for
 * today, the agent list, the terminal fleet, and a per-branch employee count.
 *
 * Five widgets the placeholder carried are not here, because nothing in the
 * schema or the API can answer them:
 *
 *   · **Headcount Growth** — a seven-month series. Nothing records headcount
 *     over time; `employees` holds only the current row, so a trend line would
 *     have to be invented wholesale.
 *   · **Payroll Status** (disbursed / processed / pending on hold) — needs the
 *     payroll-run list, which the backend does not expose yet.
 *   · **Awaiting Approval** — the approval queues are scoped per role
 *     (`/leave/pending/manager` and friends); there is no company-wide pending
 *     queue to render for an administrator.
 *   · **Workforce Split** — the donut needs `employment_type`, which the
 *     `by-branch` list does not return. Only the single-employee read carries
 *     it, so a company-wide split would be one request per employee.
 *   · **Payroll KES** per branch — no per-branch payroll total exists.
 *
 * Each returns with the aggregate endpoint that supplies it. Until then an
 * empty slot is honest and a fabricated one is not — the figures above were
 * realistic enough to be believed, which is exactly what made them dangerous on
 * a screen an administrator uses to decide things.
 */

/** A terminal that has not synced in this long reads as not reporting. */
const DEVICE_STALE_MINUTES = 60;

function isDeviceStale(device: AttendanceDeviceItem): boolean {
  if (device.status !== "ACTIVE") return false;
  if (!device.lastSyncAt) return true;

  const ageMs = Date.now() - new Date(device.lastSyncAt).getTime();
  return ageMs > DEVICE_STALE_MINUTES * 60_000;
}

export default async function AdminDashboardPage() {
  // ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN both hold these; anyone else is bounced to their own
  // namespace before a single figure renders.
  await requireAnyPermission(["company:read", "branch:read"]);

  let branches: BranchResponse[];

  try {
    branches = await getBranches();
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.isUnauthorized) redirect("/login");

    return (
      <DataUnavailable
        title="Admin Dashboard"
        description="Company-wide overview across branches, staff and attendance."
        subject="The dashboard"
        reason={error instanceof ApiError ? error.message : undefined}
      />
    );
  }

  // Secondary reads are independent of each other and of the branch directory.
  // `allSettled` throughout: one unavailable panel must not blank the page, and
  // an empty slot is a truthful rendering of "could not read this".
  const [summaryResult, agentsResult, devicesResult] = await Promise.allSettled([
    getAttendanceSummary(),
    getAgents(),
    getAttendanceDevices(),
  ]);

  const countResults = await Promise.allSettled(
    branches.map((branch) => getEmployeesByBranch(branch.id)),
  );

  const summary =
    summaryResult.status === "fulfilled" ? summaryResult.value : null;
  const agents =
    agentsResult.status === "fulfilled" ? agentsResult.value : null;
  const devices =
    devicesResult.status === "fulfilled" ? devicesResult.value : null;

  const headcount = new Map<number, number | null>(
    branches.map((branch, index) => {
      const result = countResults[index];
      return [
        branch.id,
        result && result.status === "fulfilled" ? result.value.length : null,
      ];
    }),
  );

  const totalEmployees = [...headcount.values()]
    .filter((value): value is number => value !== null)
    .reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);

  const activeBranches = branches.filter((b) => b.status === "ACTIVE").length;
  const staleDevices = (devices ?? []).filter(isDeviceStale);

  /** Attendance rate for one branch, from the summary's per-branch roll-up. */
  const rateFor = (branchId: number): number | null => {
    const row = summary?.branches.find((b) => b.branchId === branchId);
    return row ? row.attendanceRatePercent : null;
  };

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-gutter md:grid-cols-12">
      {/* ───────────────────────────────── left column ─────────────────── */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-gutter md:col-span-8">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-gutter sm:grid-cols-3">
          <StatCard
            label="Total Employees"
            value={formatNumber(totalEmployees)}
            icon="group"
            badgeIcon="badge"
          />
          <StatCard
            label="Active Branches"
            value={formatNumber(activeBranches)}
            icon="corporate_fare"
            badgeIcon="storefront"
          />
          <StatCard
            label="Labour Agents"
            value={agents === null ? "—" : formatNumber(agents.length)}
            icon="engineering"
            badgeIcon="handshake"
          />
        </div>

        <BentoCard
          title="Branch Performance"
          subtitle="Headcount and today's attendance rate, per branch"
          action={
            <Link
              href="/admin/branches"
              className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded border border-outline-variant/40 px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant transition-colors hover:bg-surface-container"
            >
              <Icon name="arrow_forward" className="text-sm" />
              All Branches
            </Link>
          }
        >
          {branches.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              symbol="location_off"
              title="No branches yet"
              description="Branches appear here once they have been created."
            />
          ) : (
            <div className="w-full overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="data-table w-full border-collapse text-left">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th className="pb-3 pl-2 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                      Branch
                    </th>
                    <th className="pb-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                      Manager
                    </th>
                    <th className="pb-3 text-right font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                      Employees
                    </th>
                    <th className="pb-3 pr-2 text-right font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                      Attendance&nbsp;%
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>

                <tbody className="font-body-md text-body-md">
                  {branches.map((branch) => {
                    const count = headcount.get(branch.id);
                    const rate = rateFor(branch.id);

                    return (
                      <tr key={branch.id} className="group transition-colors">
                        <td className="py-3 pl-2">
                          <Link
                            href={`/admin/branches/${branch.id}`}
                            className="flex items-center gap-2"
                          >
                            <span className="flex size-6 items-center justify-center rounded bg-primary-container/10 text-primary-container">
                              <Icon name="location_city" className="text-sm" />
                            </span>
                            <span className="font-medium text-on-surface group-hover:text-primary-container">
                              {branch.name}
                            </span>
                          </Link>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 text-on-surface-variant">
                          {branch.managerName ?? (
                            <span className="text-amber-main">Unassigned</span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 text-right tabular-nums text-on-surface-variant">
                          {count === null || count === undefined
                            ? "—"
                            : formatNumber(count)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 pr-2 text-right tabular-nums text-on-surface-variant">
                          {rate === null ? "—" : formatPercent(rate)}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </BentoCard>
      </div>

      {/* ──────────────────────────────── right column ─────────────────── */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-gutter md:col-span-4">
        {summary ? (
          <SegmentStrip
            segments={[
              { label: "Expected", value: formatNumber(summary.expectedEmployees) },
              { label: "Reported", value: formatNumber(summary.reported) },
              {
                label: "Not Yet In",
                value: formatNumber(summary.notYetIn),
                tone: summary.notYetIn > 0 ? "warning" : "default",
              },
            ]}
          />
        ) : null}

        {staleDevices.length > 0 ? (
          <AlertSpotlight
            message={`${formatNumber(staleDevices.length)} ${
              staleDevices.length === 1 ? "terminal has" : "terminals have"
            } not synced in the last hour.`}
            href="/admin/devices"
          />
        ) : null}

        <BentoCard title="Attendance Today">
          {summary ? (
            <>
              <p className="font-card-stat text-card-stat tabular-nums text-on-surface">
                {formatPercent(summary.attendanceRatePercent, 1)}
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-outline">
                {formatNumber(summary.reported)} of{" "}
                {formatNumber(summary.expectedEmployees)} employees reported
              </p>
              <div className="mt-4 border-t border-outline-variant/40 pt-3 text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Currently in</span>
                  <span className="tabular-nums">
                    {formatNumber(summary.currentlyIn)}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-1.5 flex justify-between">
                  <span>Clocked out</span>
                  <span className="tabular-nums">
                    {formatNumber(summary.clockedOut)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <Link
                href="/admin/attendance"
                className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-primary-container hover:underline"
              >
                Attendance board
                <Icon name="arrow_forward" className="text-sm" />
              </Link>
            </>
          ) : (
            <p className="py-4 text-center font-body-md text-body-md text-outline">
              Attendance for today could not be read.
            </p>
          )}
        </BentoCard>

        <BentoCard title="Device Fleet">
          {devices ? (
            <>
              <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
                <span className="font-card-stat text-card-stat tabular-nums text-on-surface">
                  {formatNumber(summary?.devicesOnline ?? 0)}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant">
                  of {formatNumber(devices.length)} reporting
                </span>
              </div>

              {staleDevices.length > 0 ? (
                <ul className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-outline-variant/40 pt-3">
                  {staleDevices.slice(0, 4).map((device) => (
                    <li
                      key={device.id}
                      className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-[11px]"
                    >
                      <span className="min-w-0 truncate font-mono text-on-surface-variant">
                        {device.deviceSerial}
                      </span>
                      <span className="shrink-0 text-error">
                        {device.lastSyncAt
                          ? formatRelativeTime(device.lastSyncAt)
                          : "never"}
                      </span>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              ) : (
                <p className="mt-3 text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant">
                  Every active terminal has synced recently.
                </p>
              )}

              <Link
                href="/admin/devices"
                className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-primary-container hover:underline"
              >
                Manage devices
                <Icon name="arrow_forward" className="text-sm" />
              </Link>
            </>
          ) : (
            <p className="py-4 text-center font-body-md text-body-md text-outline">
              The device fleet could not be read.
            </p>
          )}
        </BentoCard>

        <BentoCard title="Labour Agents">
          <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
            <span className="font-card-stat text-card-stat tabular-nums text-on-surface">
              {agents === null ? "—" : formatNumber(agents.length)}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant">
              registered suppliers
            </span>
          </div>
          {agents && agents.length > 0 ? (
            <p className="mt-3 text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant">
              {formatNumber(
                agents.reduce((sum, a) => sum + (a.employeeCount ?? 0), 0),
              )}{" "}
              staff deployed across them.
            </p>
          ) : null}
          <Link
            href="/admin/agents"
            className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-primary-container hover:underline"
          >
            Agent directory
            <Icon name="arrow_forward" className="text-sm" />
          </Link>
        </BentoCard>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

              <span className="font-card-stat text-[32px] leading-none text-on-surface">{formatNumber(department.totalEmployees)}</span>

===== src\app\(portal)\admin\devices\page.tsx =====
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { ApiError } from "@/app/lib/api-error";
import { requirePermission } from "@/app/lib/dal";
import { BentoCard } from "@/components/shared/bento-card";
import { DataUnavailable } from "@/components/shared/data-unavailable";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/shared/empty-state";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import {
  getAttendanceDevices,
  getAttendanceSyncFailures,
} from "@/lib/api/attendance";
import { formatNumber, formatRelativeTime } from "@/lib/format";
import type { AttendanceDeviceItem, AttendanceSyncFailure } from "@/types";

/**
 * Biometric terminal fleet.
 *
 * Fully wired: `GET /attendance/dashboard/devices` for the fleet and
 * `GET /attendance/dashboard/sync-failures` for the refusal feed. `online` is
 * computed server-side against a 5-minute freshness window, so liveness is a
 * measurement rather than a stored flag.
 *
 * Three columns the placeholder showed have no column behind them and are gone:
 * device **name** (`biometric_devices` has only a serial), **IP address** and
 * **firmware version** (neither is stored). Device identity here is the serial,
 * which is what the terminal itself sends.
 *
 * The status vocabulary also shrank from three to two: the backend has no
 * `SYNCING` state — a terminal is `ACTIVE` or `INACTIVE`, and separately it is
 * inside or outside the freshness window. A "syncing" bucket would have been a
 * third thing that never occurs.
 *
 * Search is a plain GET form rather than a client-side filter: it works without
 * JavaScript, the query lands in the URL so a filtered fleet is shareable, and
 * it needs no client boundary.
 */

/** A terminal is one of three things, all derived from two real fields. */
type FleetState = "online" | "stale" | "inactive";

function fleetState(device: AttendanceDeviceItem): FleetState {
  if (device.status !== "ACTIVE") return "inactive";
  return device.online ? "online" : "stale";
}

const STATE_META: Record<FleetState, { label: string; dot: string; bar: string }> = {
  online: { label: "Online", dot: "bg-emerald-500", bar: "bg-emerald-500" },
  stale: { label: "Not reporting", dot: "bg-red-500", bar: "bg-red-500" },
  inactive: { label: "Deactivated", dot: "bg-slate-400", bar: "bg-slate-400" },
};

const STATE_ORDER: FleetState[] = ["online", "stale", "inactive"];

export default async function BiometricDevicesPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ q?: string }>;
}) {
  await requirePermission("biometric:device:manage");

  const { q } = await searchParams;
  const needle = q?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? "";

  let devices: AttendanceDeviceItem[];
  let failures: AttendanceSyncFailure[];

  try {
    [devices, failures] = await Promise.all([
      getAttendanceDevices(),
      getAttendanceSyncFailures(),
    ]);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.isUnauthorized) redirect("/login");

    return (
      <DataUnavailable
        title="Biometric Devices"
        description="Monitor and manage attendance terminal connectivity."
        subject="The device fleet"
        reason={error instanceof ApiError ? error.message : undefined}
      />
    );
  }

  const rows = needle
    ? devices.filter((device) =>
        [device.deviceSerial, device.branchName]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .some((field) => field!.toLowerCase().includes(needle)),
      )
    : devices;

  const counts: Record<FleetState, number> = {
    online: devices.filter((d) => fleetState(d) === "online").length,
    stale: devices.filter((d) => fleetState(d) === "stale").length,
    inactive: devices.filter((d) => fleetState(d) === "inactive").length,
  };
  const fleetTotal = devices.length || 1;

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Biometric Devices"
        description="Monitor and manage attendance terminal connectivity."
        actions={
          <button
            type="button"
            className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-primary px-4 py-2 font-body-md text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-on-primary-fixed-variant"
          >
            <Icon name="add" className="text-[18px]" />
            Register Device
          </button>
        }
      />

      <div className="grid grid-cols-12 gap-gutter">
        {/* ─────────────────────────────── main column ─────────────────── */}
        <div className="col-span-12 flex flex-col gap-gutter lg:col-span-8">
          <BentoCard
            title={
              <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Icon
                  name="dns"
                  className="text-[18px] text-on-surface-variant"
                />
                Registered Terminals
              </span>
            }
            action={
              <form action="/admin/devices" method="get">
                <div className="relative">
                  <Icon
                    name="search"
                    className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[18px] text-outline"
                  />
                  <input
                    type="search"
                    name="q"
                    defaultValue={q ?? ""}
                    placeholder="Search serial or branch..."
                    className="w-64 rounded-md border border-outline-variant/60 bg-surface py-1.5 pl-9 pr-4 text-sm focus:border-primary focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/20"
                  />
                </div>
              </form>
            }
          >
            {rows.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                symbol="devices_other"
                title={
                  devices.length === 0
                    ? "No terminals registered"
                    : "No terminals match that search"
                }
                description={
                  devices.length === 0
                    ? "Biometric terminals appear here once enrolled to a branch."
                    : "Try a different serial or branch name, or clear the search."
                }
              />
            ) : (
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full border-collapse text-left">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-outline-variant/60 text-on-surface-variant">
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase">
                        Terminal
                      </th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase">
                        Branch
                      </th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase">
                        Last Sync
                      </th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase">
                        Status
                      </th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {rows.map((device) => {
                      const state = fleetState(device);
                      const meta = STATE_META[state];

                      return (
                        <tr
                          key={device.id}
                          className="border-b border-outline-variant/60 transition-colors last:border-0 hover:bg-surface"
                        >
                          <td className="px-4 py-3">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                              <div className="flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded bg-primary/10 text-primary">
                                <Icon name="fingerprint" className="text-[18px]" />
                              </div>
                              <div>
                                <div className="font-mono text-sm font-semibold text-on-surface">
                                  {device.deviceSerial}
                                </div>
                                <div className="text-[10px] text-outline">
                                  Terminal #{device.id}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-sm">
                            {device.branchName ?? "—"}
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-sm text-on-surface-variant">
                            {device.lastSyncAt ? (
                              formatRelativeTime(device.lastSyncAt)
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-error">Never synced</span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3">
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-surface-container px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-on-surface-variant">
                              <span
                                className={`inline-block size-2 rounded-full ${meta.dot}`}
                              />
                              {meta.label}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-outline-variant/60 pt-4 text-xs text-on-surface-variant">
              <span>
                {formatNumber(rows.length)}{" "}
                {rows.length === 1 ? "terminal" : "terminals"}
                {needle ? ` matching “${q}”` : ""}
              </span>
              {needle ? (
                <a href="/admin/devices" className="hover:text-primary">
                  Clear search
                </a>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </BentoCard>
        </div>

        {/* ────────────────────────────── side column ──────────────────── */}
        <div className="col-span-12 flex flex-col gap-gutter lg:col-span-4">
          <BentoCard title="Fleet Status Overview">
            {devices.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="py-4 text-center font-body-md text-body-md text-outline">
                No terminals enrolled.
              </p>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className="mb-2 flex gap-0.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full">
                  {STATE_ORDER.map((state) => (
                    <div
                      key={state}
                      className={`h-2 ${STATE_META[state].bar}`}
                      style={{ width: `${(counts[state] / fleetTotal) * 100}%` }}
                    />
                  ))}
                </div>
                <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
                  {STATE_ORDER.map((state) => (
                    <div key={state} className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <span
                        className={`size-2 rounded-full ${STATE_META[state].dot}`}
                      />
                      <span className="text-on-surface-variant">
                        {STATE_META[state].label} ({formatNumber(counts[state])})
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </BentoCard>

          <BentoCard
            title={
              <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-error">
                <Icon name="sync_problem" className="text-[18px]" />
                Recent Sync Failures
              </span>
            }
            subtitle={
              failures.length > 0
                ? "Scans the backend refused — no attendance row was written."
                : undefined
            }
            flush
          >
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 p-card-padding pt-0">
              {failures.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="py-4 text-center font-body-md text-body-md text-outline">
                  No rejected scans.
                </p>
              ) : (
                failures.slice(0, 6).map((failure) => (
                  <div
                    key={failure.id}
                    className="flex flex-col gap-1 rounded-lg border border-red-100 bg-red-50/50 p-3"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                      <span className="min-w-0 truncate font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold text-on-surface">
                        {failure.deviceSerial ?? "Unknown terminal"}
                      </span>
                      <span className="shrink-0 rounded bg-white px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant shadow-sm">
                        {formatRelativeTime(failure.createdAt)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-xs text-error">{failure.reason}</span>
                    {failure.employeeName ? (
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant">
                        {failure.employeeName}
                      </span>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          </BentoCard>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

===== src\app\(portal)\admin\settings\page.tsx =====
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { ApiError } from "@/app/lib/api-error";
import { getCurrentUser, requirePermission } from "@/app/lib/dal";
import { BentoCard } from "@/components/shared/bento-card";
import { DataUnavailable } from "@/components/shared/data-unavailable";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { getCompany, getCompanySettings } from "@/lib/api/company";
import { formatPercent, humanizeEnum } from "@/lib/format";
import type { CompanyResponse, CompanySettingsResponse } from "@/types";

/**
 * Settings — company profile and payroll rules, read from the backend.
 *
 * Both reads exist: `GET /company` and `GET /company/settings`. Both are
 * rendered read-only.
 *
 * The placeholder form carried four fields that have no column behind them —
 * **cut-off day**, **rounding rule**, and the three **automation toggles**
 * (auto-recover advances, auto-recover loans, email payslips). `company_settings`
 * holds VAT rate, working hours, overtime multiplier, weekend days and payroll
 * period, and nothing else. They are gone rather than left as controls that
 * save into the void.
 *
 * Super-admin-only editing is real and is stated on the page: `PUT
 * /company/settings` is `hasRole('SUPER_ADMIN')` while ADMIN holds only
 * `company:settings` (read). The write form itself lands with the mutations
 * batch; showing an ADMIN an enabled Save button in the meantime would be a
 * lie, so an ADMIN gets a plain note instead.
 */

const SECTIONS = [
  { id: "profile", label: "Company Profile", icon: "apartment" },
  { id: "payroll", label: "Payroll Rules", icon: "payments" },
] as const;

function Row({
  label,
  value,
  hint,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  hint?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-6 border-b border-surface-variant py-3 last:border-0">
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <p className="font-body-md text-body-md font-medium text-on-surface">
          {label}
        </p>
        {hint ? (
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-on-surface-variant">{hint}</p>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      <p className="shrink-0 text-right font-body-md text-body-md tabular-nums text-on-surface-variant">
        {value}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

export default async function AdminSettingsPage() {
  // ADMIN holds `company:settings` but deliberately not `company:write` —
  // that one is SUPER_ADMIN-only (see ROLE_PERMISSIONS). Gating on
  // `company:write` bounced the administrator off their own settings screen.
  await requirePermission("company:settings");

  const viewer = await getCurrentUser();

  let company: CompanyResponse;
  let settings: CompanySettingsResponse;

  try {
    [company, settings] = await Promise.all([
      getCompany(),
      getCompanySettings(),
    ]);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.isUnauthorized) redirect("/login");

    return (
      <DataUnavailable
        title="Settings"
        description="Company profile and payroll rules."
        subject="Company settings"
        reason={error instanceof ApiError ? error.message : undefined}
      />
    );
  }

  const canWrite = viewer.role === "SUPER_ADMIN";

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Settings"
        description="Company profile and the rules payroll is calculated against."
      />

      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-6xl flex-col gap-gutter md:flex-row">
        {/* ───────────────────────────────── sub-nav ─────────────────── */}
        <div className="w-full flex-shrink-0 md:w-64">
          <div className="sticky top-24 rounded-card bg-surface-container-lowest p-4 shadow-ambient-1">
            <h2 className="mb-4 pl-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-on-surface-variant">
              Settings Menu
            </h2>
            <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1">
              {SECTIONS.map((section) => (
                <li key={section.id}>
                  <a
                    href={`#${section.id}`}
                    className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 font-medium text-on-surface transition-colors hover:bg-surface-container-low"
                  >
                    <Icon
                      name={section.icon}
                      className="text-lg text-outline"
                    />
                    {section.label}
                  </a>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ───────────────────────────────── panels ─────────────────── */}
        <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-gutter">
          <BentoCard
            title={
              <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Icon name="apartment" className="text-primary" />
                Company Profile
              </span>
            }
          >
            {/* `id` on an inner div because BentoCard owns the heading. */}
            <div id="profile">
              <Row label="Registered Name" value={company.name} />
              <Row label="KRA PIN" value={company.kraPin ?? "—"} />
              <Row label="NSSF Number" value={company.nssfNumber ?? "—"} />
              <Row label="SHIF Number" value={company.shifNumber ?? "—"} />
              <Row label="NITA Number" value={company.nitaNumber ?? "—"} />
              <Row label="Currency" value={company.currency ?? "—"} />
              <Row label="Timezone" value={company.timezone ?? "—"} />
              <Row label="Email" value={company.email ?? "—"} />
              <Row label="Phone" value={company.phone ?? "—"} />
              <Row label="Address" value={company.address ?? "—"} />
            </div>
          </BentoCard>

          <BentoCard
            title={
              <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Icon name="manage_accounts" className="text-primary" />
                Payroll Rules
              </span>
            }
          >
            <div id="payroll">
              <Row
                label="Payroll Period"
                value={humanizeEnum(settings.payrollPeriod)}
                hint="How often a payroll run is generated."
              />
              <Row
                label="VAT Rate"
                value={formatPercent(settings.vatRate, 2)}
                hint="Applied to agent invoices for VAT-registered suppliers."
              />
              <Row
                label="Overtime Multiplier"
                value={
                  settings.overtimeMultiplier === null
                    ? "—"
                    : `${settings.overtimeMultiplier.toFixed(2)}×`
                }
                hint="Hourly rate multiplier for approved overtime."
              />
              <Row
                label="Working Hours per Day"
                value={
                  settings.defaultWorkingHoursPerDay === null
                    ? "—"
                    : `${settings.defaultWorkingHoursPerDay.toFixed(2)} hrs`
                }
              />
              <Row
                label="Weekend Days"
                value={settings.weekendDays ?? "—"}
                hint="Excluded from working-day and absence calculations."
              />
            </div>
          </BentoCard>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-card bg-surface-container-lowest p-card-padding shadow-ambient-1">
            <span
              className={
                canWrite
                  ? "flex size-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-blue-soft text-primary-container"
                  : "flex size-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-surface-container text-on-surface-variant"
              }
            >
              <Icon name={canWrite ? "edit" : "lock"} className="text-lg" />
            </span>
            <p className="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">
              {canWrite ? (
                <>
                  These values are set by the platform owner. Editing them from
                  here is not wired yet.
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  Read-only. Payroll rules and statutory rates are changed by the
                  platform owner.
                </>
              )}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

===== src\app\(portal)\admin\users\page.tsx =====
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { ApiError } from "@/app/lib/api-error";
import { getCurrentUser, requirePermission } from "@/app/lib/dal";
import { BentoCard } from "@/components/shared/bento-card";
import { DonutChart } from "@/components/shared/charts";
import { DataUnavailable } from "@/components/shared/data-unavailable";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/shared/empty-state";
import { CountPill, PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { ROLE_LABEL, type Role } from "@/config/roles";
import { getBranches } from "@/lib/api/branch";
import { getUsers } from "@/lib/api/user";
import { formatNumber, initials } from "@/lib/format";
import type { BranchResponse, UserSummaryResponse } from "@/types";

/**
 * System users directory, read from `GET /users`.
 *
 * Two placeholder columns are gone because `users` has no column for them:
 * **Last Login** (`last_login_at` does not exist) and **MFA**
 * (`mfa_enabled` does not exist). The "MFA Enrollment" warning card went with
 * them — it reported a non-compliance count for a setting the system cannot
 * observe, which is the most misleading shape a fake metric can take: an
 * administrator would act on it. The avatar URLs were stock demo images and are
 * replaced with initials.
 *
 * "Invite User" is **SUPER_ADMIN only**. `POST /users` is
 * `hasRole('SUPER_ADMIN')` while `GET /users` admits ADMIN, so an ADMIN sees
 * the directory but not the invite control. Hiding it is deliberate: the
 * alternative is a button that 403s.
 */

const DONUT_COLORS = [
  "var(--color-primary)",
  "#b7f568",
  "#aec9eb",
  "#ffdad6",
  "var(--color-amber-main)",
  "var(--color-chart-track)",
];

export default async function SystemUsersPage() {
  await requirePermission("user:manage");

  const viewer = await getCurrentUser();

  let users: UserSummaryResponse[];
  let branches: BranchResponse[];

  try {
    [users, branches] = await Promise.all([getUsers(), getBranches()]);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.isUnauthorized) redirect("/login");

    return (
      <DataUnavailable
        title="Manage Users"
        description="View and manage system access for all personnel."
        subject="The user directory"
        reason={error instanceof ApiError ? error.message : undefined}
      />
    );
  }

  const branchName = new Map(branches.map((b) => [b.id, b.name]));
  const activeCount = users.filter((u) => u.active).length;

  // Real distribution, counted from the rows above rather than a literal.
  const byRole = new Map<Role, number>();
  for (const user of users) {
    byRole.set(user.role, (byRole.get(user.role) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  const roleBreakdown = [...byRole.entries()]
    .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
    .map(([role, count], index) => ({
      label: ROLE_LABEL[role],
      value: count,
      color: DONUT_COLORS[index % DONUT_COLORS.length],
    }));

  const canInvite = viewer.role === "SUPER_ADMIN";

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Manage Users"
        description="View and manage system access for all personnel."
        pill={<CountPill label={`${activeCount} Active`} />}
        actions={
          canInvite ? (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="bento-shadow flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-[#0B2A45] px-4 py-2.5 font-body-md text-body-md font-medium text-on-primary transition-colors hover:bg-primary"
            >
              <Icon name="add" className="text-[18px]" />
              Invite User
            </button>
          ) : undefined
        }
      />

      <div className="grid grid-cols-12 gap-gutter">
        {/* ─────────────────────────────── main column ─────────────────── */}
        <div className="col-span-12 flex flex-col gap-gutter xl:col-span-8">
          <BentoCard
            title="Active Personnel"
            subtitle={`${formatNumber(users.length)} ${
              users.length === 1 ? "account" : "accounts"
            } on this deployment`}
          >
            {users.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                symbol="person_off"
                title="No user accounts"
                description="Accounts appear here once they have been created."
              />
            ) : (
              <div className="w-full overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="data-table w-full border-collapse text-left">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-outline-variant/30 bg-surface/30">
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-on-surface-variant">
                        User
                      </th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-on-surface-variant">
                        Role
                      </th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-on-surface-variant">
                        Branch
                      </th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-on-surface-variant">
                        Status
                      </th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="font-body-md text-on-surface">
                    {users.map((user) => (
                      <tr
                        key={user.id}
                        className="border-b border-outline-variant/10 transition-colors last:border-0 hover:bg-surface/50"
                      >
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <div className="flex size-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary-container text-sm font-bold text-on-primary-container shadow-sm">
                              {initials(user.displayName ?? user.username)}
                            </div>
                            <div className="min-w-0">
                              <div className="truncate font-medium text-on-surface">
                                {user.displayName ?? "—"}
                              </div>
                              <div className="font-mono text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant">
                                {user.username}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-md bg-surface-container-highest px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-on-surface">
                            {ROLE_LABEL[user.role] ?? user.role}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-on-surface-variant">
                          {user.branchId === null
                            ? "—"
                            : (branchName.get(user.branchId) ??
                              `Branch #${user.branchId}`)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <span
                              className={`size-1.5 rounded-full ${
                                user.active ? "bg-tertiary-fixed-dim" : "bg-error"
                              }`}
                            />
                            <span
                              className={`text-[11px] font-medium ${
                                user.active
                                  ? "text-tertiary-fixed-dim"
                                  : "text-error"
                              }`}
                            >
                              {user.active ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
          </BentoCard>
        </div>

        {/* ────────────────────────────── side column ──────────────────── */}
        <div className="col-span-12 flex flex-col gap-gutter xl:col-span-4">
          <BentoCard title="Users by Role" subtitle="Distribution of system access">
            {roleBreakdown.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="py-4 text-center font-body-md text-body-md text-outline">
                No accounts to summarise.
              </p>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
                <DonutChart segments={roleBreakdown} centerLabel="Total" />
                <div className="mt-6 grid w-full grid-cols-2 gap-x-2 gap-y-3 font-body-md text-[11px]">
                  {roleBreakdown.map((segment) => (
                    <div key={segment.label} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <div
                        className="size-3 shrink-0 rounded"
                        style={{ backgroundColor: segment.color }}
                      />
                      <span className="min-w-0 truncate text-on-surface">
                        {segment.label} ({segment.value})
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </BentoCard>

          <BentoCard title="Account Status">
            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
              <span className="font-card-stat text-card-stat tabular-nums text-on-surface">
                {formatNumber(activeCount)}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant">
                of {formatNumber(users.length)} active
              </span>
            </div>
            {users.length - activeCount > 0 ? (
              <p className="mt-3 text-[11px] text-error">
                {formatNumber(users.length - activeCount)} deactivated — these
                accounts cannot sign in.
              </p>
            ) : (
              <p className="mt-3 text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant">
                Every account is active.
              </p>
            )}
            <p className="mt-4 border-t border-outline-variant/40 pt-3 text-[10px] text-outline">
              Deactivating an account is available to the platform owner only.
            </p>
          </BentoCard>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

 * DATA IS PLACEHOLDER — this maps to `POST /agent-advances` and
 * `GET /agent-advances/my-advances`, but the response shape for a list
 * view (with employee name/department) isn't documented. Swap for
 * `await api.get<Paginated<AgentAdvance>>("/agent-advances/my-advances")`

type AdvanceRow = {
  id: number;
  employeeName: string;
  department: string;
  amount: number;
  requestedDate: string;
  purpose: string;

            <button type="button" className="rounded px-2 py-1 hover:bg-surface-container-high">Next &gt;</button>
          </div>

  reference: "INV-2026-1042",

                <p key={line}>{line}</p>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-12 flex justify-between">
          <div>
            <h1 className="mb-2 text-4xl font-light text-primary">INVOICE</h1>
            <p className="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">
              Reference: <span className="font-semibold text-on-surface">{invoice.reference}</span>
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2 text-right">
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-4 font-body-md text-body-md">
              <span className="text-on-surface-variant">Date of Issue:</span>
              <span className="w-32 font-semibold text-on-surface">{formatDate(invoice.issueDate)}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-4 font-body-md text-body-md">
              <span className="text-on-surface-variant">Billing Period:</span>
              <span className="w-32 font-semibold text-on-surface">
                {formatDate(invoice.periodStart)} – {formatDate(invoice.periodEnd)}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-4 font-body-md text-body-md">
              <span className="text-on-surface-variant">Due Date:</span>
              <span className="w-32 font-semibold text-error">{formatDate(invoice.dueDate)}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-12 flex-1 overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full min-w-[520px] border-collapse text-left">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b-2 border-primary">
                <th className="px-2 py-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-primary">Employee</th>
                <th className="px-2 py-3 text-right font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-primary">Days Worked</th>
                <th className="px-2 py-3 text-right font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-primary">Daily Rate (KES)</th>
                <th className="px-2 py-3 text-right font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-primary">Amount (KES)</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-surface-variant font-body-md text-body-md">
              {LINE_ITEMS.map((item) => (
                <tr key={item.id}>
                  <td className="px-2 py-4">
                    <div className="font-semibold text-on-surface">{item.name}</div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant">{item.role}</div>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-2 py-4 text-right text-on-surface-variant">{item.days}</td>
                  <td className="px-2 py-4 text-right text-on-surface-variant">{formatMoney(item.rate, { showCurrency: false })}</td>
                  <td className="px-2 py-4 text-right font-semibold text-on-surface">
                    {formatMoney(item.days * item.rate, { showCurrency: false })}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-16 flex justify-end">
          <div className="w-1/2 lg:w-1/3">
            <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-surface-variant py-2 font-body-md text-body-md">
              <span className="text-on-surface-variant">Subtotal</span>
              <span className="font-semibold text-on-surface">{formatMoney(subtotal, { showCurrency: false })}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-surface-variant py-2 font-body-md text-body-md">
              <span className="text-on-surface-variant">VAT ({invoice.vatRate}%)</span>
              <span className="font-semibold text-on-surface">{formatMoney(vat, { showCurrency: false })}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-2 flex justify-between rounded-lg border border-primary-fixed bg-primary-fixed-dim/20 px-4 py-4">
              <span className="font-page-title text-page-title text-primary">Total Payable</span>
              <span className="font-page-title text-page-title font-bold text-primary">{formatMoney(total)}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-auto border-t border-surface-variant pt-6 text-center font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">
          <p className="mb-2">
            <strong className="text-on-surface">Payment Terms:</strong> {invoice.paymentTerms}
          </p>
          <p className="text-[10px]">Thank you for your continued partnership.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function actionBadgeClass(type: PayrollRow["actionType"]) {
  if (type === "Override") return "bg-error-container text-error";
  if (type === "Reversal") return "bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container";
  return "bg-surface-container text-on-surface";
}

            <div className="w-full overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="data-table w-full border-collapse text-left">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th className="py-3 pl-2 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase tracking-wider text-on-surface-variant">Run ID</th>
                    <th className="py-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase tracking-wider text-on-surface-variant">Actor</th>
                    <th className="py-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase tracking-wider text-on-surface-variant">Action</th>
                    <th className="py-3 text-right font-table-header text-table-header uppercase tracking-wider text-on-surface-variant">Amount Changed</th>
                    <th className="py-3 pr-2 text-right font-table-header text-table-header uppercase tracking-wider text-on-surface-variant">Timestamp</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="font-body-md text-body-md">
                  {ROWS.map((row) => (
                    <tr key={row.id} className="border-b border-surface-variant transition-colors last:border-0 hover:bg-surface-bright">
                      <td className="py-3 pl-2 font-medium text-on-surface">{row.runId}</td>
                      <td className="py-3 text-on-surface-variant">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          {row.isSystem ? (
                            <Icon name="settings_suggest" className="text-[16px] text-primary" />
                          ) : (
                            <span aria-hidden className="flex size-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-secondary-container text-[10px] font-bold text-on-secondary-container">
                              {row.actorInitials}
                            </span>
                          )}
                          {row.actor}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 text-on-surface-variant">{row.action}</td>
                      <td className="py-3 text-right">
                        {row.amountChanged ? (
                          <span className={`inline-flex items-center rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium ${row.significant ? "bg-error-container text-error" : "text-on-surface-variant"}`}>
                            {row.amountChanged}
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="font-medium text-on-surface-variant">—</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 pr-2 text-right text-on-surface-variant">{row.timestamp}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </BentoCard>
        </div>

        {/* ──────────────────────────────── side column ──────────────────── */}
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-gutter md:col-span-4">
          <SegmentStrip
            segments={[
              { label: "Reviewed", value: formatNumber(0) },
              { label: "Flagged", value: formatNumber(ROWS.filter((r) => r.significant).length), tone: "warning" },
              { label: "Pending", value: formatNumber(0) },
            ]}
          />

          <BentoCard title="Actions by Type">
            <ProgressRows rows={ACTIONS_BY_TYPE} />
          </BentoCard>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

function statusDot(status: TeamMember["status"]) {
  if (status === "Active") return "bg-tertiary";
  if (status === "On Leave") return "bg-error";
  return "bg-outline";
}

function typeChipClass(type: TeamMember["employmentType"]) {
  return type === "Full-time" ? "bg-secondary-container/50 text-on-secondary-container" : "bg-surface-container-high text-on-surface-variant";
}

import { requirePermission } from "@/app/lib/dal";

/**
 * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * DATA IS PLACEHOLDER — swap for `await api.get<RosterRow[]>("/branch/roster")`.
 * Drag-and-drop reassignment is NOT wired yet — chips are display-only.
 * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 */
type ShiftKind = "Morning" | "Evening" | "Night" | "Off";

interface Shift {
  kind: ShiftKind;
  time?: string;
}

interface RosterRow {
  employeeName: string;
  days: Shift[]; // 7 entries, Mon–Sun
}

const DAYS = ["MON 23", "TUE 24", "WED 25", "THU 26", "FRI 27", "SAT 28", "SUN 29"];

const ROSTER: RosterRow[] = [
  {
    employeeName: "Alice Johnson",
    days: [
      { kind: "Morning", time: "08:00 - 16:00" },
      { kind: "Morning", time: "08:00 - 16:00" },
      { kind: "Evening", time: "15:00 - 23:00" },
      { kind: "Off" },
      { kind: "Morning", time: "08:00 - 16:00" },
      { kind: "Off" },
      { kind: "Off" },
    ],
  },
  {
    employeeName: "Bob Smith",
    days: [
      { kind: "Evening", time: "15:00 - 23:00" },
      { kind: "Off" },
      { kind: "Morning", time: "08:00 - 16:00" },
      { kind: "Evening", time: "15:00 - 23:00" },
      { kind: "Evening", time: "15:00 - 23:00" },
      { kind: "Night", time: "23:00 - 07:00" },
      { kind: "Night", time: "23:00 - 07:00" },
    ],
  },
];

function chipClass(kind: ShiftKind) {
  switch (kind) {
    case "Morning":
      return "bg-primary-container/10 border-primary-container/20 text-on-primary-fixed-variant";
    case "Evening":
      return "bg-tertiary-container/10 border-tertiary-container/20 text-tertiary";
    case "Night":
      return "bg-secondary-container/30 border-secondary/20 text-secondary";
    default:
      return "bg-surface-variant/30 border-outline-variant/30 border-dashed text-on-surface-variant justify-center";
  }
}

        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md border border-outline-variant px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium transition hover:bg-surface-variant">
            <Icon name="chevron_left" className="text-sm" />
            Prev

            Next
            <Icon name="chevron_right" className="text-sm" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-ambient-1">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full border-collapse text-left">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-[#E9EFF5] bg-surface/50">
                <th className="sticky left-0 z-10 w-48 bg-surface/90 p-4 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase text-on-surface-variant backdrop-blur">
                  Employee
                </th>

                ))}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#E9EFF5] text-sm">
              {ROSTER.map((row) => (
                <tr key={row.employeeName} className="transition-colors hover:bg-surface-variant/20">

                        {shift.kind !== "Off" ? (
                          <>
                            <Icon name="drag_indicator" className="cursor-grab text-sm text-outline-variant" />
                            <div className="flex-1 text-center font-medium">
                              {shift.kind}
                              <br />
                              <span className="text-[10px] font-normal text-on-surface-variant">{shift.time}</span>
                            </div>
                          </>
                        ) : (

                        )}
                      </div>

export default async function FinanceDashboardPage() {
  await requirePermission("invoice:read");

  const trendMax = Math.max(...CASH_OUT_TREND.series2025, ...CASH_OUT_TREND.series2026);
  const toPoints = (series: readonly number[]) =>
    series
      .map((v, i) => {
        const x = (i / (series.length - 1)) * 100;
        const y = 100 - (v / trendMax) * 100;
        return `${x},${y}`;
      })
      .join(" ");

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-gutter lg:grid-cols-12">
      {/* ───────────────────────────────── main column ─────────────────── */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-gutter lg:col-span-8">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-gutter md:grid-cols-3">
          <MetricCard
            label="Disbursed This Month"
            value={formatMoneyCompact(KPI.disbursedThisMonth)}
            icon="payments"
            tone="primary"
          />
          <MetricCard
            label="Pending Invoices"
            value={formatNumber(KPI.pendingInvoices)}
            icon="receipt_long"
          />
          <MetricCard
            label="Statutory Due"
            value={formatMoneyCompact(KPI.statutoryDue)}
            icon="account_balance"
            tone="error"
            accent
          />
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-gutter md:grid-cols-2">
          <BentoCard
            title="Cash Out Trend"
            subtitle="2025 vs 2026"
            className="flex min-h-64 flex-col"
            bodyClassName="flex flex-1 flex-col"
          >
            <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col rounded-lg bg-surface-container-low/50 p-2">
              {/* `flex-1` rather than `h-full`: a percentage height needs a
                  definite parent, and this column's height comes from the card,
                  so `h-full` here resolves against nothing. */}
              <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" preserveAspectRatio="none" className="min-h-0 w-full flex-1">
                <polyline
                  points={toPoints(CASH_OUT_TREND.series2025)}
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="var(--color-outline-variant)"
                  strokeWidth="1.5"
                  vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke"
                />
                <polyline
                  points={toPoints(CASH_OUT_TREND.series2026)}
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="var(--color-primary)"
                  strokeWidth="1.5"
                  vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke"
                />
              </svg>
              <div className="mt-2 flex justify-between font-body-md text-[10px] text-outline">
                {CASH_OUT_TREND.months.map((m) => (
                  <span key={m}>{m}</span>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1 font-body-md text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-outline-variant" /> 2025
                </span>
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-primary" /> 2026
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </BentoCard>

          <BentoCard title="Disbursement Status" className="flex min-h-64 flex-col" bodyClassName="flex flex-1 flex-col justify-center">
            <DonutChart segments={DISBURSEMENT_STATUS} size={140} legend="value" centerLabel="Status" />

                  <th className="pb-3 text-right font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">Amount</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">Method</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 pr-2 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">Status</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="font-body-md text-body-md">
                {PENDING_DISBURSEMENTS.map((row) => (
                  <tr key={row.id} className="group transition-colors">

function statusBadge(status: DisbursementBatch["status"]) {
  switch (status) {
    case "Completed":
      return "bg-tertiary-fixed text-on-tertiary-fixed-variant";
    case "Processing":
      return "bg-primary-fixed text-on-primary-fixed-variant";
    case "Failed":
      return "bg-error-container text-on-error-container";
  }
}

                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td className={`px-6 py-4 font-mono ${p.status === "Failed" ? "text-error" : "text-on-surface-variant"}`}>{p.account}</td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-right font-medium">{p.amount}</td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4">
                    {p.status === "Succeeded" ? (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-tertiary-fixed-dim/20 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-tertiary">
                        <Icon name="check" className="text-[14px]" />
                        Succeeded
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-error-container px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-error">
                          <Icon name="close" className="text-[14px]" />
                          Failed
                        </span>
                        {p.failReason && <p className="mt-1 max-w-[150px] truncate text-[10px] text-error">{p.failReason}</p>}
                      </>
                    )}
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-right">
                    {p.status === "Succeeded" ? (
                      <button className="text-outline transition-colors hover:text-primary">
                        <Icon name="more_vert" className="text-[20px]" />
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      <button className="ml-auto flex items-center justify-end gap-1 text-sm font-medium text-primary-container transition-colors hover:text-primary">
                        <Icon name="refresh" className="text-[16px]" />
                        Retry
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-surface-variant bg-surface-bright p-4">
          <span className="text-sm text-on-surface-variant">Showing 1 to 3 of 145 entries</span>
          <div className="flex gap-1">
            <button className="flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded border border-surface-variant text-outline hover:bg-surface-container disabled:opacity-50" disabled>
              <Icon name="chevron_left" className="text-[18px]" />
            </button>
            <button className="flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded bg-primary-container text-sm font-medium text-white">1</button>
            <button className="flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded border border-surface-variant text-sm font-medium text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container">2</button>
            <button className="flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded border border-surface-variant text-sm font-medium text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container">3</button>
            <span className="flex size-8 items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant">...</span>
            <button className="flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded border border-surface-variant text-outline hover:bg-surface-container">
              <Icon name="chevron_right" className="text-[18px]" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function SummaryTile({
  label,
  icon,
  iconBg,
  iconColor,
  valueClass = "text-on-surface",
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  icon: string;
  iconBg: string;
  iconColor: string;
  valueClass?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white p-6 shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(11,42,69,.06)] transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-[0_8px_24px_rgba(11,42,69,.10)]">
      <div className="mb-4 flex items-start justify-between">
        <span className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-on-surface-variant">{label}</span>
        <div className={`flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full ${iconBg} ${iconColor}`}>
          <Icon name={icon} />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className={`flex items-baseline gap-1 text-2xl font-bold ${valueClass}`}>{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

function statusBadge(status: Invoice["status"]) {
  switch (status) {
    case "Pending":
      return "bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container border-secondary-container/50";
    case "Approved":
      return "bg-tertiary-fixed text-on-tertiary-fixed border-tertiary-fixed/50";
    case "Paid":
      return "bg-surface-container-high text-on-surface-variant border-surface-variant";
  }
}

function statusBadge(status: LoanRecord["status"]) {
  switch (status) {
    case "Active":
      return "bg-tertiary-fixed text-on-tertiary-fixed-variant border-tertiary-fixed-dim/50";
    case "At Risk":
      return "bg-error-container text-on-error-container border-error/20";
    case "Settled":
      return "bg-surface-variant text-on-surface-variant border-outline-variant/30";
  }
}

function MetricCard({
  label,
  value,
  icon,
  iconBg,
  iconColor,
  trend,
  trendIcon,
  trendColor,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  icon: string;
  iconBg: string;
  iconColor: string;
  trend: string;
  trendIcon: string;
  trendColor: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="col-span-12 flex h-full flex-col justify-between rounded-2xl border border-surface-container-highest bg-white p-6 shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(11,42,69,.06)] transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-[0_8px_24px_rgba(11,42,69,.10)] md:col-span-4">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
        <span className="text-sm text-on-surface-variant">{label}</span>
        <div className={`flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg ${iconBg} ${iconColor}`}>
          <Icon name={icon} className="text-[18px]" />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-4">
        <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-on-surface">{value}</div>
        <div className={`mt-1 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold ${trendColor}`}>
          <Icon name={trendIcon} className="text-[14px]" />
          {trend}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
