/**
 * Labour agents — HR's read-only view of the external staff suppliers.
 *
 * Read-only is not a design choice. `roles.ts` grants HR_MANAGER `agent:write`,
 * but no agent write endpoint admits the role: `POST` and `PUT /agents` are
 * SUPER_ADMIN/ADMIN, and `PUT /agents/{id}/deactivate` is SUPER_ADMIN alone. So
 * there is no Add/Edit/Deactivate control on this page — rendering one would be
 * a button that 403s.
 *
 * Two columns the old placeholder carried are gone because nothing can produce
 * them: "Outstanding" (agent advances are their own module with their own
 * status, not a per-agent total the API exposes) and "Active Contracts" (there
 * is no contract entity — an agent has one contract window, the start and end
 * dates on the row itself).
 */
export default async function LabourAgentsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ status?: string | string[] }>;
}) {
  await requirePermission("agent:read");

  const params = await searchParams;
  const statusFilter = first(params.status);

  let agents: AgentResponse[];

  try {
    agents = await getAgents();
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.isUnauthorized) {
      throw error;
    }

    return (
      <DataUnavailable
        title="Labour Agents"
        description="Suppliers of outsourced staff."
        subject="The agent list"
        reason={error instanceof ApiError ? error.message : undefined}
      />
    );
  }

  const visible =
    statusFilter === "ACTIVE" || statusFilter === "INACTIVE"
      ? agents.filter((agent) => agent.status === statusFilter)
      : agents;

  const byHeadcount = [...agents]
    .sort((a, b) => (b.employeeCount ?? 0) - (a.employeeCount ?? 0))
    .slice(0, 5);

  const chargeSplit = splitByChargeType(agents);

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Labour Agents"
        description="Suppliers of outsourced staff."
      />

      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <FilterChip label="All" count={agents.length} href="/hr/agents" active={!statusFilter} />
        <FilterChip
          label="Active"
          count={agents.filter((agent) => agent.status === "ACTIVE").length}
          href={buildHref("/hr/agents", { status: "ACTIVE" })}
          active={statusFilter === "ACTIVE"}
        />
        <FilterChip
          label="Inactive"
          count={agents.filter((agent) => agent.status === "INACTIVE").length}
          href={buildHref("/hr/agents", { status: "INACTIVE" })}
          active={statusFilter === "INACTIVE"}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-gutter lg:grid-cols-12">
        <div className="lg:col-span-8">
          <BentoCard
            title={
              <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Icon name="handshake" className="text-[20px] text-primary" />
                Agents
              </span>
            }
            action={
              <span className="font-body-md text-[11px] text-outline">
                {formatNumber(visible.length)}{" "}
                {visible.length === 1 ? "agent" : "agents"}
              </span>
            }
          >
            {visible.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                symbol="handshake"
                title={statusFilter ? `No ${statusFilter.toLowerCase()} agents` : "No agents"}
                description="Labour agents are created by an administrator; HR sees them but cannot add one."
              />
            ) : (
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-left font-body-md text-body-md">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-outline-variant/50 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                      <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Agent</th>
                      <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Contact</th>
                      <th className="pb-3 pr-4 text-center">Deployed</th>
                      <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Charge</th>
                      <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Contract</th>
                      <th className="pb-3">Status</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {visible.map((agent) => (
                      <tr
                        key={agent.id}
                        className="border-b border-outline-variant/25 last:border-0 hover:bg-surface-container-low/40"
                      >
                        <td className="py-3 pr-4">
                          <Link
                            href={`/hr/agents/${agent.id}`}
                            className="group flex items-center gap-3"
                          >
                            <span
                              aria-hidden
                              className="flex size-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary-container/20 text-[11px] font-bold text-primary"
                            >
                              {initials(agent.name)}
                            </span>
                            <span>
                              <span className="block font-semibold text-on-surface group-hover:text-primary">
                                {agent.name}
                              </span>
                              <span className="block text-[11px] text-outline">
                                {agent.kraPin ?? "No KRA PIN on file"}
                              </span>
                            </span>
                          </Link>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 pr-4 text-on-surface-variant">
                          <span className="block">
                            {agent.contactPerson ?? "—"}
                          </span>
                          <span className="block text-[11px] text-outline">
                            {agent.phone ?? agent.email ?? "No contact details"}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 pr-4 text-center tabular-nums text-on-surface-variant">
                          {agent.employeeCount === null
                            ? "—"
                            : formatNumber(agent.employeeCount)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 pr-4 text-on-surface-variant">
                          {describeCharge(agent)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 pr-4 text-[12px] text-on-surface-variant">
                          {agent.contractStartDate || agent.contractEndDate
                            ? `${agent.contractStartDate ? formatDate(agent.contractStartDate) : "—"} → ${
                                agent.contractEndDate ? formatDate(agent.contractEndDate) : "open"
                              }`
                            : "Not set"}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3">
                          <StatusBadge status={agent.status} />
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
          </BentoCard>

          <p className="mt-4 text-[11px] text-outline">
            Read-only. HR holds an <code>agent:write</code> permission in the
            frontend role config, but no agent write endpoint accepts the role —
            creating, editing and deactivating agents is an administrator task.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-gutter lg:col-span-4">
          <BentoCard
            title={
              <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Icon name="groups" className="text-[20px] text-primary" />
                Top by Headcount
              </span>
            }
          >
            {byHeadcount.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                symbol="groups"
                title="Nothing to rank"
                description="No agents are registered."
              />
            ) : (
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                {byHeadcount.map((agent) => (
                  <Link
                    key={agent.id}
                    href={`/hr/agents/${agent.id}`}
                    className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg p-2 transition-colors hover:bg-surface-container-low"
                  >
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <span
                        aria-hidden
                        className="flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-primary/10 text-[11px] font-bold text-primary"
                      >
                        {initials(agent.name)}
                      </span>
                      <span className="font-body-md text-body-md font-semibold text-on-surface">
                        {agent.name}
                      </span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="rounded bg-surface-container-low px-2 py-0.5 font-body-md text-body-md font-bold tabular-nums text-on-surface">
                      {agent.employeeCount === null
                        ? "—"
                        : formatNumber(agent.employeeCount)}
                    </span>
                  </Link>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </BentoCard>

          <BentoCard
            title={
              <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Icon name="donut_small" className="text-[20px] text-primary" />
                How Agents Charge
              </span>
            }
          >
            {chargeSplit.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                symbol="donut_small"
                title="No agents"
                description="The breakdown appears once an agent exists."
              />
            ) : (
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                {chargeSplit.map((row) => (
                  <div key={row.chargeType} className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-body-md text-body-md">
                      <span className="text-on-surface-variant">{row.label}</span>
                      <span className="font-semibold tabular-nums text-on-surface">
                        {formatNumber(row.count)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-surface-container-high">
                      <div
                        className="h-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary-container"
                        style={{ width: `${row.pct}%` }}
                      />

                  </div>
                ))}
                <p className="text-[11px] text-outline">
                  Counted from the {formatNumber(agents.length)}{" "}
                  {agents.length === 1 ? "agent" : "agents"} in the list, not

                </p>
              </div>
            )}

        </div>

    </>

function FilterChip({
  label,
  count,
  href,
  active,
}: {
  label: string;
  count: number;
  href: string;
  active: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <Link
      href={href}
      className={`rounded-full border px-3 py-1.5 font-body-md text-[12px] transition-colors ${
        active
          ? "border-primary-container bg-primary-container/10 font-semibold text-primary"
          : "border-outline-variant text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container"
      }`}
    >
      {label} ({formatNumber(count)})
    </Link>
  );
}

/**
 * `chargeType` decides which of the two amount columns is meaningful — the
 * backend allows both to be set at once, so the type is what makes the number
 * readable rather than the presence of a value.
 */
function describeCharge(agent: AgentResponse): string {
  if (agent.chargeType === "PERCENTAGE_OF_GROSS") {
    return agent.chargePercentage === null
      ? "Percentage — rate not set"
      : `${agent.chargePercentage}%`;
  }

  if (agent.chargeAmount === null) {
    return `${humanizeEnum(agent.chargeType)} — amount not set`;
  }

  return `${formatMoney(agent.chargeAmount)}${agent.chargeType === "PER_EMPLOYEE" ? "/employee" : ""}`;
}

function splitByChargeType(agents: AgentResponse[]) {
  const counts = new Map<ChargeType, number>();

  for (const agent of agents) {
    counts.set(agent.chargeType, (counts.get(agent.chargeType) ?? 0) + 1);
  }

  return [...counts.entries()]
    .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
    .map(([chargeType, count]) => ({
      chargeType,
      count,
      label: humanizeEnum(chargeType),
      pct: agents.length === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((count / agents.length) * 100),
    }));
}

/**
 * One labour agent, read-only.
 *
 * HR can read an agent but not write one — `POST`/`PUT /agents` are
 * SUPER_ADMIN/ADMIN and `PUT /agents/{id}/deactivate` is SUPER_ADMIN alone.
 * Contract terms are therefore labels, never inputs.
 *
 * The old placeholder's "Outstanding Advances" card and "Recent Invoices" list
 * are gone. Both were invented: advances and invoices are their own modules with
 * their own endpoints, and neither is exposed per-agent to HR, so there is
 * nothing to total. The side column shows the contact and banking details the
 * agent record actually carries instead.
 */
export default async function HrAgentDetailPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  await requirePermission("agent:read");

  const { id } = await params;
  const agentId = Number(id);

  if (!Number.isInteger(agentId) || agentId <= 0) {
    notFound();
  }

  let agent: AgentResponse;
  let staff: EmployeeSummaryResponse[];

  try {
    // Sequential rather than parallel: a 404 on the agent means the staff call
    // is pointless, and the staff read is the one that can 403 for a role that
    // may still read the agent itself.
    agent = await getAgent(agentId);
    staff = await getAgentStaff(agentId);

    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.isUnauthorized) {
      throw error;
    }

      notFound();
    }

    return (
      <DataUnavailable
        title="Labour Agent"
        description="One external staff supplier."
        subject="This agent"
        reason={error instanceof ApiError ? error.message : undefined}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title={
          <span className="flex items-center gap-3">
            {agent.name}
            <StatusBadge status={agent.status} />
          </span>
        }

          <Link

function ReadOnlyField({
  label,
  value,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
      <span className="font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
        {label}
      </span>
      <span className="rounded-lg border border-outline-variant/60 bg-surface-container-low px-3 py-2 font-body-md text-body-md font-medium text-on-surface">
        {value}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

function DetailRow({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string | null }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
      <dt className="font-body-md text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wide text-outline">
        {label}
      </dt>
      <dd className="text-right font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface">
        {value ?? "—"}
      </dd>
    </div>
  );
}

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { DataUnavailable } from "@/components/shared/data-unavailable";

import { CountPill, PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { Pagination } from "@/components/shared/pagination";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/shared/status-badge";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import {
  getAttendanceActivity,
  getAttendanceDevices,
  getAttendanceRecords,
  getAttendanceSummary,
  getAttendanceSyncFailures,
} from "@/lib/api/attendance";
import {
  buildHref,
  first,

  parsePage,

import {

  formatHours,
  formatNumber,
  formatPercent,
  formatRelativeTime,

  initials,
} from "@/lib/format";
import type {
  AttendanceActivityItem,
  AttendanceDashboardSummary,
  AttendanceDeviceItem,
  AttendanceRecordItem,
  AttendanceSource,
  AttendanceSyncFailure,
  Paginated,

/**
 * The HR attendance board.
 *
 * Same endpoints and the same live components as `/admin/attendance` — HR is in
 * the backend's `VIEW_ROLES` on the summary, activity, records and devices
 * mappings, and in `ADMIN_ROLES` on sync-failures. The only real difference is
 * `basePath`, so `AttendanceFilters`, `LiveAttendanceBoard` and the records
 * table are shared rather than copied.
 *
 * What this screen deliberately does **not** have is any way to *correct* an
 * attendance row. There is no manual-entry or edit endpoint in
 * `AttendanceController` — the only writes are the biometric sync and the
 * checkout, both of which belong to the terminal. A "Add manual entry" button
 * would have nothing to call.
 *
 * The biometric module itself (`/hr/biometric`) is out of scope on purpose: the
 * terminals are enrolled and operated from the branch manager's desktop app.
 */

/** Mirrors the map on the admin board. */
const SOURCE_ICON: Record<AttendanceSource, string> = {
  BIOMETRIC: "fingerprint",
  MANUAL: "badge",
  MOBILE: "smartphone",
  WEB: "language",
};

/**
 * Only two tabs, because `openOnly` is the only server-side filter the records
 * endpoint has. A status filter would have to sift the current page in the
 * browser, which lies as soon as the results are paginated.
 */
const RECORD_TABS: readonly FilterTab[] = [
  { label: "All records" },
  { label: "On site now", value: "open" },
];

const RECORD_PAGE_SIZE = 25;

type BoardData = {
  summary: AttendanceDashboardSummary;
  activity: AttendanceActivityItem[];
  records: Paginated<AttendanceRecordItem>;
  devices: AttendanceDeviceItem[];
  syncFailures: AttendanceSyncFailure[];
};

/**
 * All five reads in one round trip, and all five or none.
 *
 * Deliberately not `allSettled`: a half-loaded board would render a live ticker
 * beside a records table that silently stopped at page one, and there is no way
 * for the reader to tell which of the two is wrong.
 */
async function loadBoard(filters: {
  date?: string;
  branchId?: number;
  openOnly: boolean;
  page: number;
}): Promise<BoardData> {
  const { date, branchId, openOnly, page } = filters;

  const [summary, activity, records, devices, syncFailures] = await Promise.all([
    getAttendanceSummary({ date, branchId }),
    getAttendanceActivity({ branchId, limit: 50 }),
    getAttendanceRecords({
      branchId,
      // Omitted when no date is chosen, which tells the backend "today" in the
      // company timezone rather than in the browser's.
      start: date,
      end: date,
      openOnly,
      page,
      size: RECORD_PAGE_SIZE,
    }),
    getAttendanceDevices({ branchId }),
    getAttendanceSyncFailures(),
  ]);

  return { summary, activity, records, devices, syncFailures };
}

                  no row in the attendance table.
                </p>
              ) : (
                <ul className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                  {syncFailures.slice(0, 8).map((failure) => (
                    <li

                      </p>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              )}
            </BentoCard>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import {
  eachDayOfInterval,
  endOfMonth,
  endOfWeek,
  format,
  isSameMonth,
  parseISO,
  startOfWeek,
} from "date-fns";

import { ApiError } from "@/app/lib/api-error";
import { requirePermission } from "@/app/lib/dal";
import { BentoCard } from "@/components/shared/bento-card";
import { DataUnavailable } from "@/components/shared/data-unavailable";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { SegmentStrip, type Segment } from "@/components/shared/segment-strip";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/shared/status-badge";
import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button-variants";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { getAttendanceForEmployee } from "@/lib/api/attendance";
import { getEmployee } from "@/lib/api/employee";
import {
  formatDate,
  formatHours,
  formatNumber,
  formatTime,
  humanizeEnum,
  initials,
} from "@/lib/format";
import { first } from "@/lib/search-params";
import type { AttendanceResponse, EmployeeResponse } from "@/types";

/**
 * One employee's attendance history.
 *
 * `GET /attendance/employee/{id}` requires `start` **and** `end` as mandatory
 * query params — omitting either is a 400, not a defaulted range — so the month
 * being viewed is what supplies them. That is also why the month is a real
 * `?month=` search param rather than local state: the range is part of the
 * request, so it belongs in the URL.
 *
 * There is no "hours worked" field on `AttendanceResponse`, so the Hours column
 * is derived from clock-in against clock-out and shows nothing when either is
 * missing. The dashboard's own projection has a real `hoursWorked`; this
 * endpoint does not.
 */

/** Monday-first, matching the Kenyan working week. */
const WEEK_OPTIONS = { weekStartsOn: 1 } as const;

const WEEKDAYS = ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"] as const;

/**
 * How a single day reads in the grid. `off` is an in-month day with no record;
 * `outside` is padding from the adjacent month.
 */
type DayTone = "present" | "late" | "absent" | "leave" | "off" | "outside";

const TONE: Record<DayTone, { cell: string; swatch: string; label: string }> = {
  present: {
    cell: "border-tertiary-container/50 bg-tertiary-container/30 text-on-tertiary-fixed-variant",
    swatch: "border-tertiary-container bg-tertiary-container/40",
    label: "Present",
  },
  late: {
    cell: "border-amber-main/30 bg-amber-main/10 text-amber-main",
    swatch: "border-amber-main bg-amber-main/20",
    label: "Late",
  },
  absent: {
    cell: "border-error-container bg-error-container text-on-error-container",
    swatch: "border-error-container bg-error-container",
    label: "Absent",
  },
  leave: {
    cell: "border-primary-container/40 bg-primary-container/20 text-on-primary-fixed-variant",
    swatch: "border-primary-container bg-primary-container/20",
    label: "Leave",
  },
  off: {
    cell: "border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-lowest text-outline",
    swatch: "border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-lowest",
    label: "No record",
  },
  outside: {
    cell: "border-transparent bg-surface-container text-on-surface-variant opacity-50",
    swatch: "border-transparent bg-surface-container",
    label: "Other month",
  },
};

/** Legend order. Drawn from `TONE` so swatches can never drift from cells. */
const LEGEND: readonly DayTone[] = ["present", "late", "absent", "leave"];

/**
 * Status → tone. `HALF_DAY` and `HOLIDAY` are in the union but have no tone of
 * their own; they fall through to `off` rather than being coloured as something
 * they are not. An unrecognised status does the same — the column is a free
 * `String` and can carry `OVERTIME`, which is not in the union at all.
 */
function toneFor(status: string): DayTone {
  switch (status) {
    case "PRESENT":
      return "present";
    case "LATE":
      return "late";
    case "ABSENT":
      return "absent";
    case "ON_LEAVE":
      return "leave";
    default:
      return "off";
  }
}

/** `yyyy-MM` only. Anything else falls back to the current month. */
function parseMonth(value: string | undefined): Date {
  if (value && /^\d{4}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) {
    const parsed = parseISO(`${value}-01`);
    if (!Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) return parsed;
  }

  const now = new Date();
  return new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1);
}

function monthKey(date: Date): string {
  return format(date, "yyyy-MM");
}

/**
 * The month stepper's target. Built by hand rather than through `buildHref`,
 * because the employee id is a path segment here — `buildHref` only ever emits
 * a query string.
 */
function monthHref(employeeId: number, date: Date): string {
  return `/hr/attendance/${employeeId}?month=${monthKey(date)}`;
}

function minutesBetween(clockIn: string | null, clockOut: string | null): number | null {
  if (!clockIn || !clockOut) return null;

  const start = new Date(clockIn).getTime();
  const end = new Date(clockOut).getTime();

  if (Number.isNaN(start) || Number.isNaN(end) || end < start) return null;

  return Math.round((end - start) / 60_000);
}

/** Decimal hours, or `null` when the day is not a complete pair of scans. */
function hoursOf(record: AttendanceResponse): number | null {
  const minutes = minutesBetween(record.clockIn, record.clockOut);
  return minutes === null ? null : minutes / 60;
}

export default async function EmployeeAttendancePage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ employeeId: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<{ month?: string | string[] }>;
}) {
  await requirePermission("attendance:read");

  const { employeeId: rawEmployeeId } = await params;
  const employeeId = Number(rawEmployeeId);

  if (!Number.isInteger(employeeId) || employeeId <= 0) {
    notFound();
  }

  const search = await searchParams;
  const month = parseMonth(first(search.month));

  // Inclusive bounds, `yyyy-MM-dd` — the endpoint rejects anything else, and
  // rejects a missing bound outright.
  const start = format(startOfWeek(month, WEEK_OPTIONS), "yyyy-MM-dd");
  const end = format(endOfWeek(endOfMonth(month), WEEK_OPTIONS), "yyyy-MM-dd");

  let employee: EmployeeResponse;
  let records: AttendanceResponse[];

  try {
    [employee, records] = await Promise.all([
      getEmployee(employeeId),
      getAttendanceForEmployee(employeeId, { start, end }),
    ]);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.isUnauthorized) {
      throw error;
    }

    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.isNotFound) {
      notFound();
    }

    return (
      <DataUnavailable
        title="Employee Attendance"
        description="One employee's clock history."
        subject={`The attendance history for employee #${employeeId}`}
        reason={error instanceof ApiError ? error.message : undefined}
      />
    );
  }

  // One record per day per employee, newest first in the log.
  const byDate = new Map(
    records.map((record) => [record.attendanceDate, record]),
  );
  const log = [...records].sort((a, b) =>
    a.attendanceDate < b.attendanceDate ? 1 : -1,
  );

  const gridDays = eachDayOfInterval({
    start: startOfWeek(month, WEEK_OPTIONS),
    end: endOfWeek(endOfMonth(month), WEEK_OPTIONS),
  });

  const inMonth = records.filter((record) =>
    isSameMonth(parseISO(record.attendanceDate), month),
  );

  const counts = countByTone(inMonth);
  const summary: Segment[] = (["present", "late", "absent"] as const).map(
    (tone) => ({
      label: TONE[tone].label,
      value: formatNumber(counts[tone]),
      tone: tone === "present" ? "success" : tone === "late" ? "warning" : "error",
    }),
  );

  const totalMinutes = inMonth.reduce(
    (sum, record) => sum + (minutesBetween(record.clockIn, record.clockOut) ?? 0),
    0,
  );

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title={
          <span className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Link
              href="/hr/attendance"
              aria-label="Back to attendance board"
              className="text-on-surface-variant transition-colors hover:text-on-surface"
            >
              <Icon name="arrow_back" />
            </Link>
            <span
              aria-hidden
              className="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary-container text-[13px] font-bold text-on-primary"
            >
              {initials(employee.fullName)}
            </span>
            {employee.fullName} — Attendance
          </span>
        }
        description={`${employee.employeeNumber} · ${
          employee.position ?? "No position"
        } · ${employee.branchName ?? "No branch"}`}
        actions={
          <Link
            href={`/hr/employees/${employeeId}`}
            className={buttonVariants({ variant: "secondary" })}
          >
            <Icon name="person" className="text-[18px]" />
            View profile
          </Link>
        }
      />

      <div className="grid grid-cols-12 gap-gutter">
        <div className="col-span-12 flex flex-col gap-gutter lg:col-span-8">
          <BentoCard
            title={format(month, "MMMM yyyy")}
            action={
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <Link
                  href={monthHref(employeeId, addMonths(month, -1))}
                  aria-label={`Previous month — ${format(addMonths(month, -1), "MMMM yyyy")}`}
                  className="rounded bg-surface-container p-1 text-on-surface-variant transition-colors hover:bg-surface-container-high"
                >
                  <Icon name="chevron_left" className="text-[18px]" />
                </Link>
                <Link
                  href={monthHref(employeeId, addMonths(month, 1))}
                  aria-label={`Next month — ${format(addMonths(month, 1), "MMMM yyyy")}`}
                  className="rounded bg-surface-container p-1 text-on-surface-variant transition-colors hover:bg-surface-container-high"
                >
                  <Icon name="chevron_right" className="text-[18px]" />
                </Link>
              </div>
            }
          >
            <div className="mb-2 grid grid-cols-7 gap-1">
              {WEEKDAYS.map((day) => (
                <div
                  key={day}
                  className="py-1 text-center font-table-header text-[10px] uppercase text-outline"
                >
                  {day}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1">
              {gridDays.map((day) => {
                const key = format(day, "yyyy-MM-dd");
                const outside = !isSameMonth(day, month);
                const record = byDate.get(key);
                const tone: DayTone = outside
                  ? "outside"
                  : record
                    ? toneFor(record.status)
                    : "off";

                return (
                  <div
                    key={key}
                    title={
                      outside
                        ? undefined
                        : record
                          ? `${key} · ${humanizeEnum(record.status)} · ${
                              record.clockIn ? formatTime(record.clockIn) : "no clock-in"
                            }`
                          : `${key} · no record`
                    }
                    className={`flex aspect-square flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-lg border text-[11px] font-medium ${TONE[tone].cell}`}
                  >
                    <span className="tabular-nums">{format(day, "d")}</span>
                    {record && !outside ? (
                      <span className="mt-0.5 text-[9px] tabular-nums opacity-80">
                        {record.clockIn ? formatTime(record.clockIn) : "—"}
                      </span>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-4 border-t border-outline-variant/40 pt-4">
              {LEGEND.map((tone) => (
                <span key={tone} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className={`size-3 rounded-sm border ${TONE[tone].swatch}`} />
                  <span className="font-body-md text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant">
                    {TONE[tone].label}
                  </span>
                </span>
              ))}
              <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className={`size-3 rounded-sm border ${TONE.off.swatch}`} />
                <span className="font-body-md text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant">
                  No record
                </span>
              </span>
            </div>

            <p className="mt-4 text-[11px] text-outline">
              The grid covers the whole weeks the month falls in, so a few days
              either side of {format(month, "MMMM")} are fetched too. A day
              carried by neither a shift nor a scan simply has no record —
              nothing here infers absence.
            </p>
          </BentoCard>

          <BentoCard
            title="Daily Log"
            subtitle={`${formatNumber(log.length)} ${
              log.length === 1 ? "record" : "records"
            } in range`}
          >
            {log.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="rounded-card border border-dashed border-outline-variant px-4 py-12 text-center">
                <Icon name="event_busy" className="text-[40px] text-outline-variant" />
                <p className="mt-2 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">
                  No attendance recorded in this range.
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="data-table w-full border-collapse text-left">
                  <thead>
                    <tr>
                      <th className="pb-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                        Date
                      </th>
                      <th className="pb-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                        Clock In
                      </th>
                      <th className="pb-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                        Clock Out
                      </th>
                      <th className="pb-3 text-right font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                        Hours
                      </th>
                      <th className="pb-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                        Source
                      </th>
                      <th className="pb-3 text-right font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                        Status
                      </th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface">
                    {log.map((record) => (
                      <tr
                        key={record.id}
                        className="border-b border-outline-variant/20 last:border-0"
                      >
                        <td className="py-3 text-on-surface-variant">
                          {formatDate(record.attendanceDate)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 tabular-nums text-on-surface-variant">
                          {formatTime(record.clockIn)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 tabular-nums text-on-surface-variant">
                          {formatTime(record.clockOut)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 text-right tabular-nums text-on-surface-variant">
                          {formatHours(hoursOf(record))}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 text-on-surface-variant">
                          {humanizeEnum(record.source)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 text-right">
                          <StatusBadge status={record.status} />
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
          </BentoCard>
        </div>

        <div className="col-span-12 flex flex-col gap-gutter lg:col-span-4">
          <SegmentStrip segments={summary} />

          <BentoCard title="This Month">
            <dl className="flex flex-col gap-3">
              <Stat
                label="Days recorded"
                value={formatNumber(inMonth.length)}
              />
              <Stat
                label="Hours clocked"
                value={formatHours(totalMinutes / 60)}
              />
              <Stat
                label="Days with no record"
                value={formatNumber(
                  eachDayOfInterval({
                    start: month,
                    end: endOfMonth(month),
                  }).filter(
                    (day) =>
                      day.getDay() !== 0 &&
                      day.getDay() !== 6 &&
                      !byDate.has(format(day, "yyyy-MM-dd")),
                  ).length,
                )}
                hint="Weekdays only"
              />
            </dl>

            <p className="mt-5 border-t border-outline-variant/40 pt-4 text-[11px] text-outline">
              &ldquo;Days with no record&rdquo; counts weekdays the endpoint
              returned nothing for. It is a gap in the data, not a finding —
              nothing in this API says whether the employee was expected to work
              that day.
            </p>
          </BentoCard>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

function Stat({
  label,
  value,
  hint,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  hint?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-4">
      <dt className="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">
        {label}
        {hint ? (
          <span className="ml-1 text-[10px] text-outline">({hint})</span>
        ) : null}
      </dt>
      <dd className="font-body-md text-body-md font-semibold tabular-nums text-on-surface">
        {value}
      </dd>
    </div>
  );
}

function countByTone(records: AttendanceResponse[]): Record<DayTone, number> {
  const counts: Record<DayTone, number> = {
    present: 0,
    late: 0,
    absent: 0,
    leave: 0,
    off: 0,
    outside: 0,
  };

  for (const record of records) {
    counts[toneFor(record.status)] += 1;
  }

  return counts;
}

function addMonths(date: Date, delta: number): Date {
  return new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth() + delta, 1);
}

===== src\app\(portal)\hr\dashboard\page.tsx =====
import Link from "next/link";
import { differenceInCalendarDays, format, parseISO, subDays } from "date-fns";

import { ApiError } from "@/app/lib/api-error";
import { requirePermission } from "@/app/lib/dal";
import { AlertSpotlight } from "@/components/shared/alert-spotlight";
import { BarChart, type BarDatum } from "@/components/shared/bar-chart";
import { BentoCard } from "@/components/shared/bento-card";
import {
  DonutChart,
  ProgressRows,
  type StackSegment,
} from "@/components/shared/charts";
import { DataUnavailable } from "@/components/shared/data-unavailable";
import { MetricCard } from "@/components/shared/metric-card";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import {
  getAttendanceSummary,
  getAttendanceSyncFailures,
} from "@/lib/api/attendance";
import { getBranches } from "@/lib/api/branch";
import { getEmployeesByBranch } from "@/lib/api/employee";
import { getPendingHrApprovals } from "@/lib/api/leave";
import {
  formatDateRange,
  formatNumber,
  formatPercent,
  initials,
} from "@/lib/format";
import type {
  AttendanceDashboardSummary,
  AttendanceSyncFailure,
  BranchResponse,
  EmployeeSummaryResponse,
  LeaveRequestResponse,
} from "@/types";

/**
 * HR Manager dashboard.
 *
 * There is **no `/dashboard/hr`** on the Spring side, so every figure here is
 * composed from reads that do exist rather than from one aggregate call. That
 * has three consequences worth stating plainly, because they explain why this
 * screen does not look exactly like the Stitch brief:
 *
 *  - **Headcount, the branch split and status split are assembled branch by
 *    branch** via `GET /employees/by-branch/{id}`, the same way `/hr/employees`
 *    does it — there is no company-wide employee list.
 *  - **The 7-day trend is seven calls** to `/attendance/dashboard/summary`, one
 *    per day. The endpoint reports one business day at a time; there is no
 *    range form.
 *  - **Two briefed widgets have no source at all and are gone**, not faked.
 *    "Probation Ending" needs a `dateHired` and a `PROBATION` status —
 *    `EmployeeSummaryResponse` carries neither, and `PROBATION` is not one of
 *    the three employment statuses the backend defines. "Docs Expiring" needs an
 *    expiry date, and `employee_documents` has no such column. Loans are absent
 *    for the same reason: no `/loans` endpoint admits HR.
 *
 * Every number on the page therefore comes from Postgres. When
 * `docs/backend-patches/HR_MANAGER_MISSING_ENDPOINTS.md` and
 * `HR_MANAGER_READ_ACCESS.md` land, the branch fan-out can collapse into a
 * single `GET /employees` call — the widgets themselves do not change.
 *
 * Layout follows the later of Stitch's two takes: spotlight, trend, donut. The
 * KPI row follows the earlier one, whose tiles are HR's own work queue.
 */

const TREND_DAYS = 7;

/** One colour per branch slice; wraps if a company has more branches than this. */
const SLICE_COLORS = [
  "var(--color-primary-container)",
  "var(--color-blue)",
  "var(--color-secondary)",
  "var(--color-tertiary)",
  "var(--color-amber-main)",
  "var(--color-orange)",
] as const;

/** Employment statuses in the order HR reads them, green → amber → red. */
const STATUS_ORDER = ["ACTIVE", "INACTIVE", "TERMINATED"] as const;

const STATUS_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  ACTIVE: "var(--color-green-main)",
  INACTIVE: "var(--color-amber-main)",
  TERMINATED: "var(--color-error)",
};

/** Days a request covers, inclusive of both ends. */
function daysCovered(request: LeaveRequestResponse): number {
  const days =
    differenceInCalendarDays(
      parseISO(request.endDate),
      parseISO(request.startDate),
    ) + 1;

  return Number.isFinite(days) && days > 0 ? days : 0;
}

/**
 * Count by employment status.
 *
 * Keyed off whatever the rows actually carry rather than off the union:
 * `employmentStatus` is a plain String in the backend, so a value outside
 * `EMPLOYMENT_STATUSES` is possible and must show up in the totals rather than
 * be dropped for not being in the type.
 */
function countByStatus(employees: EmployeeSummaryResponse[]): Map<string, number> {
  const counts = new Map<string, number>();

  for (const employee of employees) {
    const key = employee.employmentStatus || "UNKNOWN";
    counts.set(key, (counts.get(key) ?? 0) + 1);
  }

  return counts;
}

/** Known statuses first, in `STATUS_ORDER`; anything else after, alphabetically. */
function orderedStatuses(counts: Map<string, number>): string[] {
  return [...counts.keys()].sort((a, b) => {
    const rankA = STATUS_ORDER.indexOf(a as (typeof STATUS_ORDER)[number]);
    const rankB = STATUS_ORDER.indexOf(b as (typeof STATUS_ORDER)[number]);
    return (rankA < 0 ? STATUS_ORDER.length : rankA) - (rankB < 0 ? STATUS_ORDER.length : rankB);
  });
}

export default async function HrDashboardPage() {
  await requirePermission("employee:read");

  // The trend runs oldest → newest, so the last element is today. Days are the
  // server's calendar days, not the company timezone's — the summary endpoint
  // resolves "today" itself when no date is passed, which is what the headline
  // tile uses. Across a midnight boundary the last bar and that tile can
  // disagree by one day; they cannot disagree about the figures.
  const days = Array.from({ length: TREND_DAYS }, (_, index) =>
    subDays(new Date(), TREND_DAYS - 1 - index),
  );

  let branches: BranchResponse[];
  let pendingLeave: LeaveRequestResponse[];
  let syncFailures: AttendanceSyncFailure[];
  let trend: AttendanceDashboardSummary[];

  try {
    [branches, pendingLeave, syncFailures, trend] = await Promise.all([
      getBranches(),
      getPendingHrApprovals(),
      getAttendanceSyncFailures(),
      Promise.all(
        days.map((day) =>
          getAttendanceSummary({ date: format(day, "yyyy-MM-dd") }),
        ),
      ),
    ]);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.isUnauthorized) {
      throw error;
    }

    return (
      <DataUnavailable
        title="HR Dashboard"
        description="Headcount, attendance and the HR approval queue."
        subject="The dashboard"
        reason={
          error instanceof ApiError && error.isForbidden
            ? "Your role cannot read /branches yet, and the headcount figures are assembled branch by branch. See docs/backend-patches/HR_MANAGER_READ_ACCESS.md."
            : error instanceof ApiError
              ? error.message
              : undefined
        }
      />
    );
  }

  // One read per branch, concurrently. A branch that fails contributes no rows
  // rather than hiding every other branch's staff — the same contract
  // `/hr/employees` documents.
  const branchResults = await Promise.allSettled(
    branches.map((branch) => getEmployeesByBranch(branch.id)),
  );

  const everyBranchFailed =
    branchResults.length > 0 &&
    branchResults.every((result) => result.status === "rejected");

  if (everyBranchFailed) {
    const first = branchResults[0];

    return (
      <DataUnavailable
        title="HR Dashboard"
        description="Headcount, attendance and the HR approval queue."
        subject="The employee list"
        reason={
          first.status === "rejected" && first.reason instanceof ApiError
            ? first.reason.message
            : undefined
        }
      />
    );
  }

  const employees: EmployeeSummaryResponse[] = branchResults.flatMap((result) =>
    result.status === "fulfilled" ? result.value : [],
  );

  const unreadBranches = branchResults.filter(
    (result) => result.status === "rejected",
  ).length;

  const headcount = employees.length;
  const today = trend[trend.length - 1];
  const hasAttendanceData = trend.some((day) => day.expectedEmployees > 0);

  const trendData: BarDatum[] = trend.map((day, index) => {
    const rate = Math.round(day.attendanceRatePercent);

    return {
      label: format(days[index], "EEE"),
      value: rate,
      tooltip: `${format(days[index], "d MMM")} · ${rate}% · ${day.reported} of ${day.expectedEmployees} reported`,
      highlight: index === trend.length - 1,
    };
  });

  const statusCounts = countByStatus(employees);
  const statusRows = orderedStatuses(statusCounts).map((status) => ({
    label: status === "UNKNOWN" ? "Not recorded" : status.charAt(0) + status.slice(1).toLowerCase(),
    value:
      headcount > 0
        ? Math.round(((statusCounts.get(status) ?? 0) / headcount) * 100)
        : 0,
    color: STATUS_COLORS[status] ?? "var(--color-outline)",
  }));

  // Branch slices, largest first, with everything past the palette grouped so
  // the legend stays readable on a company with more branches than colours.
  const byBranch = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const employee of employees) {
    const key = employee.branchName ?? "No branch";
    byBranch.set(key, (byBranch.get(key) ?? 0) + 1);
  }

  const ranked = [...byBranch.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
  const named = ranked.slice(0, SLICE_COLORS.length - 1);
  const rest = ranked.slice(SLICE_COLORS.length - 1);

  const branchSlices: StackSegment[] = [
    ...named.map(([label, value], index) => ({
      label,
      value,
      color: SLICE_COLORS[index],
    })),
    ...(rest.length > 0
      ? [
          {
            label: `Other (${formatNumber(rest.length)})`,
            value: rest.reduce((sum, [, value]) => sum + value, 0),
            color: SLICE_COLORS[SLICE_COLORS.length - 1],
          },
        ]
      : []),
  ];

  const queue = pendingLeave.slice(0, 5);

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-gutter lg:grid-cols-12">
      {/* ───────────────────────────────── main column ─────────────────── */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-gutter lg:col-span-8">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-gutter md:grid-cols-3">
          <MetricCard
            label="Pending Leave"
            value={formatNumber(pendingLeave.length)}
            icon="beach_access"
            tone="primary"
            accent={pendingLeave.length > 0}
            hint={
              pendingLeave.length > 0
                ? "Awaiting HR approval"
                : "Nothing in the queue"
            }
          />
          <MetricCard
            label="Headcount"
            value={formatNumber(headcount)}
            icon="groups"
            tone="tertiary"
            hint={
              unreadBranches > 0
                ? `${formatNumber(branches.length - unreadBranches)} of ${formatNumber(branches.length)} branches read`
                : `${formatNumber(branches.length)} ${branches.length === 1 ? "branch" : "branches"}`
            }
          />
          <MetricCard
            label="Attendance Today"
            value={formatPercent(today?.attendanceRatePercent ?? null)}
            icon="how_to_reg"
            tone="primary"
            hint={
              today
                ? `${formatNumber(today.reported)} of ${formatNumber(today.expectedEmployees)} reported`
                : "No data for today"
            }
          />
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-gutter md:grid-cols-2">
          <BentoCard
            title="Attendance Trend"
            subtitle={`Last ${TREND_DAYS} days`}
            action={
              <Link
                href="/hr/attendance"
                className="text-[10px] text-primary-container hover:underline"
              >
                View All
              </Link>
            }
            className="flex min-h-64 flex-col"
            bodyClassName="flex flex-1 flex-col rounded-lg bg-surface-container-low/50 p-2"
          >
            {hasAttendanceData ? (
              <BarChart
                data={trendData}
                max={100}
                axisLabels={["100", "66", "33", "0"]}
                tone="primary"
              />
            ) : (
              <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col items-center justify-center px-4 text-center">
                <Icon
                  name="event_busy"
                  className="text-[36px] text-outline-variant"
                />
                <p className="mt-2 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">
                  No attendance has been recorded in the last {TREND_DAYS} days.
                </p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-outline">
                  A percentage needs someone expected before it can be worked
                  out, so an empty company reports nothing rather than 0%.
                </p>
              </div>
            )}
          </BentoCard>

          <BentoCard
            title="Employment Status"
            subtitle="Share of headcount"
            action={
              <Link
                href="/hr/employees"
                className="text-[10px] text-primary-container hover:underline"
              >
                Details
              </Link>
            }
            className="flex min-h-64 flex-col"
            bodyClassName="flex flex-1 flex-col"
          >
            {headcount > 0 ? (
              <ProgressRows rows={statusRows} className="flex-1" />
            ) : (
              <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col items-center justify-center px-4 text-center">
                <Icon name="badge" className="text-[36px] text-outline-variant" />
                <p className="mt-2 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">
                  No employees on file yet.
                </p>
              </div>
            )}
          </BentoCard>
        </div>

        <BentoCard
          title="Leave Awaiting HR Approval"
          subtitle={
            pendingLeave.length > 0
              ? `${formatNumber(pendingLeave.length)} ${pendingLeave.length === 1 ? "request" : "requests"} cleared by a branch manager`
              : undefined
          }
          action={
            <Link
              href="/hr/leave"
              className="rounded px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-primary-container transition-colors hover:bg-blue-soft"
            >
              Review Queue
            </Link>
          }
        >
          {queue.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="rounded-card border border-dashed border-outline-variant px-4 py-10 text-center">
              <Icon
                name="check_circle"
                className="text-[36px] text-outline-variant"
              />
              <p className="mt-2 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">
                Nothing is waiting on HR.
              </p>
              <p className="mx-auto mt-1 max-w-md text-[11px] text-outline">
                A request only appears here once a branch manager has approved it
                — until then it is on their screen, and this queue is not the
                only place it can sit.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="w-full overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="data-table w-full border-collapse text-left">
                  <thead>
                    <tr>
                      <th className="pb-3 pl-2 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                        Employee
                      </th>
                      <th className="pb-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                        Type
                      </th>
                      <th className="pb-3 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                        Dates
                      </th>
                      <th className="pb-3 text-right font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                        Days
                      </th>
                      <th className="pb-3 pr-2 text-right font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                        Review
                      </th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>

                  <tbody className="font-body-md text-body-md">
                    {queue.map((request) => (
                      <tr key={request.id} className="group transition-colors">
                        <td className="py-3 pl-2">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <span
                              aria-hidden
                              className="flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary-container/10 text-[10px] font-bold text-primary-container"
                            >
                              {initials(request.employeeName)}
                            </span>
                            <span className="font-medium text-on-surface">
                              {request.employeeName ?? "Unknown employee"}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 text-on-surface-variant">
                          {request.leaveTypeName ?? "—"}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 text-on-surface-variant">
                          {formatDateRange(request.startDate, request.endDate)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 text-right tabular-nums text-on-surface-variant">
                          {formatNumber(daysCovered(request))}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 pr-2 text-right">
                          <Link
                            href={`/hr/leave/${request.id}`}
                            className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-primary-container hover:underline"
                          >
                            Open
                          </Link>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>

              {pendingLeave.length > queue.length ? (
                <p className="mt-3 border-t border-outline-variant/40 pt-3 text-[11px] text-outline">
                  Showing the first {queue.length} of{" "}
                  {formatNumber(pendingLeave.length)}.{" "}
                  <Link href="/hr/leave" className="text-primary-container hover:underline">
                    Review the rest on Leave
                  </Link>
                  .
                </p>
              ) : null}
            </>
          )}
        </BentoCard>
      </div>

      {/* ──────────────────────────────── side column ──────────────────── */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-gutter lg:col-span-4">
        {/*
          One real message, chosen by precedence: a refused biometric scan is a
          clock-in that silently did not happen and leaves no attendance row, so
          it outranks a queue that is merely waiting. Both come from real reads;
          when neither has anything, the card says so rather than manufacturing
          an alert.
        */}
        {syncFailures.length > 0 ? (
          <AlertSpotlight
            eyebrow="Attendance Alert"
            tone="error"
            title={`${formatNumber(syncFailures.length)} ${syncFailures.length === 1 ? "scan was" : "scans were"} refused`}
            message="A rejected scan leaves no attendance row, so the employee shows as never having arrived."
            description={syncFailures[0]?.reason ?? undefined}
            cta="Review Attendance"
            href="/hr/attendance"
          />
        ) : pendingLeave.length > 0 ? (
          <AlertSpotlight
            eyebrow="Leave Queue"
            tone="warning"
            title={`${formatNumber(pendingLeave.length)} ${pendingLeave.length === 1 ? "request waits" : "requests wait"} on you`}
            message="Each one has cleared its branch manager and is stopped until HR decides."
            cta="Review Requests"
            href="/hr/leave"
          />
        ) : (
          <AlertSpotlight
            eyebrow="All Clear"
            tone="info"
            title="Nothing needs you"
            message="No leave is waiting on HR and no biometric scan has been refused."
            cta="Open Attendance"
            href="/hr/attendance"
          />
        )}

        <BentoCard
          title="Headcount by Branch"
          action={
            <Icon name="more_vert" className="text-sm text-on-surface-variant" />
          }
          className="flex flex-1 flex-col"
          bodyClassName="flex flex-1 flex-col justify-center"
        >
          {headcount > 0 ? (
            <DonutChart
              segments={branchSlices}
              size={160}
              legend="value"
              centerLabel="Total"
            />
          ) : (
            <p className="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">
              No employees on file yet.
            </p>
          )}
        </BentoCard>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\app\(portal)\hr\employees\page.tsx =====
import Link from "next/link";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

import { ApiError } from "@/app/lib/api-error";
import { requirePermission } from "@/app/lib/dal";
import { BentoCard } from "@/components/shared/bento-card";
import { DataUnavailable } from "@/components/shared/data-unavailable";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/shared/empty-state";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/shared/status-badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button-variants";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { getBranches } from "@/lib/api/branch";
import { getEmployeesByBranch } from "@/lib/api/employee";
import { formatNumber } from "@/lib/format";
import type { BranchResponse, EmployeeSummaryResponse } from "@/types";

/**
 * Employee directory.
 *
 * There is **no `GET /employees`** on the backend, so this is assembled branch
 * by branch — one read per branch, concurrently. That is a real shape of the
 * API rather than a shortcut here, and it has two consequences worth knowing:
 *
 *  - The table cannot be sorted or paginated server-side, because it is not one
 *    result set. Filtering happens after the merge, over the whole company.
 *  - The rows are `EmployeeSummaryResponse`, which is deliberately thin: name,
 *    number, branch, position, status. No salary and no statutory identifiers
 *    appear in any list — only `GET /employees/{id}` returns those.
 *
 * A branch whose read fails contributes no rows rather than failing the page,
 * so one bad branch does not hide every other branch's staff.
 */
export default async function EmployeesPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ branch?: string; q?: string }>;
}) {
  await requirePermission("employee:read");

  const { branch: branchFilter, q } = await searchParams;

  let branches: BranchResponse[];

  try {
    branches = await getBranches();
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.isUnauthorized) {
      throw error;
    }

    return (
      <DataUnavailable
        title="Employees"
        description="Every employee across the company's branches."
        subject="The branch list"
        reason={
          error instanceof ApiError && error.isForbidden
            ? "Your role is not permitted to read /branches yet, and the directory is assembled branch by branch. See docs/backend-patches/HR_MANAGER_READ_ACCESS.md."
            : error instanceof ApiError
              ? error.message
              : undefined
        }
      />
    );
  }

  const visibleBranches = branchFilter
    ? branches.filter((b) => String(b.id) === branchFilter)
    : branches;

  const results = await Promise.allSettled(
    visibleBranches.map((branch) => getEmployeesByBranch(branch.id)),
  );

  // An all-branches failure is a backend problem worth reporting; a single
  // branch's failure inside a working company is not.
  const everyReadFailed =
    results.length > 0 && results.every((r) => r.status === "rejected");

  if (everyReadFailed) {
    const first = results[0];

    return (
      <DataUnavailable
        title="Employees"
        description="Every employee across the company's branches."
        subject="The employee list"
        reason={
          first.status === "rejected" && first.reason instanceof ApiError
            ? first.reason.message
            : undefined
        }
      />
    );
  }

  const employees: EmployeeSummaryResponse[] = results
    .flatMap((result) => (result.status === "fulfilled" ? result.value : []))
    .sort((a, b) => a.fullName.localeCompare(b.fullName));

  const failedBranchCount = results.filter((r) => r.status === "rejected").length;

  const search = q?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? "";
  const filtered = search
    ? employees.filter(
        (e) =>
          e.fullName.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
          e.employeeNumber.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
          (e.position ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(search),
      )
    : employees;

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Employees"
        description="Every employee across the company's branches."
        actions={
          <Link
            href="/hr/employees/new"
            className={buttonVariants({ className: "w-fit" })}
          >
            <Icon name="person_add" className="text-[18px]" />
            Add Employee
          </Link>
        }
      />

      {failedBranchCount > 0 ? (
        <p
          role="status"
          className="mb-4 rounded-lg border border-amber-main/40 bg-amber-main/5 px-4 py-3 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant"
        >
          {formatNumber(failedBranchCount)}{" "}
          {failedBranchCount === 1 ? "branch" : "branches"} could not be read, so
          the total below is incomplete.
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <FilterLink href="/hr/employees" active={!branchFilter}>
          All branches
        </FilterLink>
        {branches.map((branch) => (
          <FilterLink
            key={branch.id}
            href={`/hr/employees?branch=${branch.id}`}
            active={branchFilter === String(branch.id)}
          >
            {branch.name}
          </FilterLink>
        ))}
      </div>

      <form className="mb-4 flex gap-2" action="/hr/employees">
        {branchFilter ? (
          <input type="hidden" name="branch" value={branchFilter} />
        ) : null}
        <input
          type="search"
          name="q"
          defaultValue={q ?? ""}
          placeholder="Search by name, number or job title"
          className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-lg border border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-lowest px-3 py-2 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface focus:border-primary-container focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-container/20"
        />
        <Button type="submit" variant="secondary" size="md">
          Search
        </Button>
      </form>

      <BentoCard
        title="Directory"
        action={
          <span className="font-body-md text-[11px] text-outline">
            {formatNumber(filtered.length)}{" "}
            {filtered.length === 1 ? "employee" : "employees"}
          </span>
        }
      >
        {filtered.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            symbol="group_off"
            title={search ? "Nobody matches that search" : "No employees yet"}
            description={
              search
                ? "Try a different name, employee number or job title."
                : "Add the first employee to see them here."
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left font-body-md text-body-md">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-outline-variant/50 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                  <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Employee</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Number</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Branch</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Position</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 text-right">Status</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {filtered.map((employee) => (
                  <tr
                    key={employee.id}
                    className="border-b border-outline-variant/25 last:border-0"
                  >
                    <td className="py-3 pr-4">
                      <Link
                        href={`/hr/employees/${employee.id}`}
                        className="font-semibold text-on-surface hover:text-primary"
                      >
                        {employee.fullName}
                      </Link>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 pr-4 font-mono text-[12px] text-on-surface-variant">
                      {employee.employeeNumber}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 pr-4 text-on-surface-variant">
                      {employee.branchName ?? "—"}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 pr-4 text-on-surface-variant">
                      {employee.position ?? "—"}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 text-right">
                      <StatusBadge status={employee.employmentStatus} />
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </BentoCard>
    </>
  );
}

function FilterLink({
  href,
  active,
  children,
}: {
  href: string;
  active: boolean;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <Link
      href={href}
      className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 font-body-md text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors ${
        active
          ? "bg-primary text-on-primary"
          : "bg-surface-container text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container-high"
      }`}
    >
      {children}
    </Link>
  );
}

===== src\app\(portal)\hr\employees\new\page.tsx =====
import { ApiError } from "@/app/lib/api-error";
import { requirePermission } from "@/app/lib/dal";
import { DataUnavailable } from "@/components/shared/data-unavailable";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { getAgents } from "@/lib/api/agent";
import { getBranches } from "@/lib/api/branch";
import { getDepartmentsByBranch } from "@/lib/api/department";
import type { AgentResponse, BranchResponse, DepartmentResponse } from "@/types";

import { EmployeeForm } from "../_components/employee-form";

/**
 * Add Employee.
 *
 * The form posts to `POST /employees` through a Server Action. Everything this
 * page reads is only there to populate the dropdowns: branches (required),
 * departments per branch (filtered by branch, and the backend rejects a
 * mismatch), and agents (optional).
 *
 * HR_MANAGER is authorised for `POST /employees` — that is not in question.
 * What it needs *as well* is read access to `/branches` and `/agents`, because
 * a create call is useless if the form cannot offer a branch to choose. Those
 * two reads are granted by `docs/backend-patches/HR_MANAGER_READ_ACCESS.md`;
 * until that is applied the branch read comes back 403 and this page says so
 * rather than rendering an empty dropdown that looks like an empty company.
 */
export default async function NewEmployeePage() {
  await requirePermission("employee:write");

  let branches: BranchResponse[];

  try {
    branches = await getBranches();
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.isForbidden) {
      return (
        <DataUnavailable
          title="Add Employee"
          description="Create a new employee record."
          subject="The branch list"
          reason="Your role is not permitted to read /branches yet, so there is no branch to file the employee under. This is a backend permission that has been identified and is waiting to be applied — see docs/backend-patches/HR_MANAGER_READ_ACCESS.md."
        />
      );
    }

    return (
      <DataUnavailable
        title="Add Employee"
        description="Create a new employee record."
        subject="The branch list"
        reason={error instanceof ApiError ? error.message : undefined}
      />
    );
  }

  // Agents are optional on the form (a direct employee has none) and the
  // department read is one call per branch. Both are allowed to fail without
  // blocking the page: a missing department list narrows the user's choices,
  // whereas a missing branch list makes the form impossible.
  const [agentsResult, departmentResults] = await Promise.all([
    getAgents().catch(() => [] as AgentResponse[]),
    Promise.allSettled(branches.map((branch) => getDepartmentsByBranch(branch.id))),
  ]);

  const departmentsByBranch: Record<number, DepartmentResponse[]> = {};

  branches.forEach((branch, index) => {
    const result = departmentResults[index];

    departmentsByBranch[branch.id] =
      result?.status === "fulfilled" ? result.value : [];
  });

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Add Employee"
        description="Create a new employee record."
      />

      <EmployeeForm
        mode="create"
        options={{ branches, departmentsByBranch, agents: agentsResult }}
      />
    </>
  );
}

===== src\app\(portal)\hr\employees\[id]\page.tsx =====
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";

import { ApiError } from "@/app/lib/api-error";
import { requirePermission } from "@/app/lib/dal";
import { BentoCard } from "@/components/shared/bento-card";
import { DataUnavailable } from "@/components/shared/data-unavailable";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/shared/status-badge";
import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button-variants";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { getEmployee } from "@/lib/api/employee";
import { formatDate, formatMoney, initials } from "@/lib/format";
import type { EmployeeResponse } from "@/types";

import { TerminateEmployee } from "../_components/terminate-employee";

/**
 * One employee's full record.
 *
 * This is the only employee read that returns salary and statutory identifiers
 * — every `by-*` list returns the thin `EmployeeSummaryResponse` instead. Their
 * absence from the lists is deliberate on the backend's side, not an oversight
 * here.
 */
export default async function EmployeeDetailPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  await requirePermission("employee:read");

  const { id } = await params;
  const employeeId = Number(id);

  if (!Number.isInteger(employeeId) || employeeId <= 0) {
    notFound();
  }

  let employee: EmployeeResponse;

  try {
    employee = await getEmployee(employeeId);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError) {
      if (error.isNotFound) notFound();
      if (error.isUnauthorized) throw error;
    }

    return (
      <DataUnavailable
        title="Employee"
        subject="This employee's record"
        reason={error instanceof ApiError ? error.message : undefined}
      />
    );
  }

  const isTerminated = employee.employmentStatus === "TERMINATED";

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title={employee.fullName}
        description={`${employee.employeeNumber} · ${employee.branchName ?? "No branch"}`}
        actions={
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
            <Link
              href={`/hr/employees/${employee.id}/documents`}
              className={buttonVariants({ variant: "secondary" })}
            >
              <Icon name="folder_open" className="text-[18px]" />
              Documents
            </Link>
            <Link
              href={`/hr/employees/${employee.id}/edit`}
              className={buttonVariants()}
            >
              <Icon name="edit" className="text-[18px]" />
              Edit
            </Link>
          </div>
        }
      />

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-gutter lg:grid-cols-12">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-gutter lg:col-span-8">
          <BentoCard
            title={
              <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Icon name="person" className="text-[20px] text-primary" />
                Personal Details
              </span>
            }
          >
            <dl className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-gutter md:grid-cols-2">
              <Field label="National ID" value={employee.nationalId} />

                Employment

                label="Date Hired"
                value={formatDate(employee.dateHired)}
              />
