            title={
              <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Icon name="payments" className="text-[20px] text-primary" />
                Compensation
              </span>
            }
          >
            <dl className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-gutter md:grid-cols-2">
              <Field label="Basic Salary" value={formatMoney(employee.basicSalary)} />
              <Field label="Bank" value={employee.bankName} />
              <Field label="Account Number" value={employee.bankAccountNumber} />
            </dl>
          </BentoCard>

          <BentoCard
            title={
              <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Icon name="assured_workload" className="text-[20px] text-primary" />
                Statutory Details
              </span>
            }
          >
            <dl className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-gutter md:grid-cols-2">
              <Field label="KRA PIN" value={employee.kraPin} mono />
              <Field label="NSSF Number" value={employee.nssfNumber} mono />
              <Field label="SHIF Number" value={employee.shifNumber} mono />
              <Field label="NITA Number" value={employee.nitaNumber} mono />
            </dl>
          </BentoCard>

          <BentoCard
            title={
              <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Icon name="emergency" className="text-[20px] text-primary" />
                Emergency Contact
              </span>
            }
          >
            <dl className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-gutter md:grid-cols-2">
              <Field
                label="Contact Name"
                value={employee.emergencyContactName}
              />
              <Field
                label="Contact Phone"
                value={employee.emergencyContactPhone}
              />
            </dl>
          </BentoCard>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-gutter lg:col-span-4">
          <BentoCard className="text-center">
            <span
              aria-hidden
              className="mx-auto mb-4 flex size-20 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-4 border-white bg-primary-container/20 text-2xl font-bold text-primary-container shadow-md"
            >
              {initials(employee.fullName)}
            </span>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-on-surface">
              {employee.fullName}
            </h3>
            <p className="mb-1 font-body-md text-body-md font-medium text-secondary">
              {employee.position ?? "No job title"}
            </p>
            <p className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant">
              <Icon name="location_on" className="text-[14px]" />
              {employee.branchName ?? "No branch"}
            </p>
            <StatusBadge status={employee.employmentStatus} />
          </BentoCard>

          <BentoCard title="Employee Number">
            <p className="font-mono text-[15px] font-semibold text-on-surface">
              {employee.employeeNumber}
            </p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-outline">
              Generated by the server at creation and not editable — the update
              request has no field for it.
            </p>
          </BentoCard>

          {isTerminated ? (
            <BentoCard title="Terminated">
              <p className="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">
                This employee has been terminated. The API has no endpoint that
                reverses it, so the record stays in this state.
              </p>
            </BentoCard>
          ) : (
            <TerminateEmployee
              employeeId={employee.id}
              employeeName={employee.fullName}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

function Field({
  label,
  value,
  mono,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string | null | undefined;
  mono?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <div>
      <dt className="font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
        {label}
      </dt>
      <dd
        className={`mt-1 text-on-surface ${mono ? "font-mono text-[12px]" : "font-body-md text-body-md"}`}
      >
        {value ? value : <span className="text-outline">—</span>}
      </dd>
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\app\(portal)\hr\employees\[id]\documents\page.tsx =====
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";

import { ApiError } from "@/app/lib/api-error";
import { requirePermission } from "@/app/lib/dal";
import { DataUnavailable } from "@/components/shared/data-unavailable";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button-variants";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { getEmployeeDocuments } from "@/lib/api/document";
import { getEmployee } from "@/lib/api/employee";
import type { EmployeeDocumentResponse, EmployeeResponse } from "@/types";

import { DocumentManager } from "./_components/document-manager";

/**
 * An employee's documents.
 *
 * Reads the employee as well as the documents, because the only place the file
 * name belongs is next to whose file it is — `EmployeeDocumentResponse` carries
 * an id, not a name.
 *
 * The employee read 404s for an unknown id and the documents read 403s for a
 * role that may read the employee but not their files. Both are told apart
 * rather than collapsed into one failure card.
 */
export default async function EmployeeDocumentsPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  await requirePermission("employee:read");

  const { id } = await params;
  const employeeId = Number(id);

  if (!Number.isInteger(employeeId) || employeeId <= 0) {
    notFound();
  }

  let employee: EmployeeResponse;
  let documents: EmployeeDocumentResponse[];

  try {
    [employee, documents] = await Promise.all([
      getEmployee(employeeId),
      getEmployeeDocuments(employeeId),
    ]);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.isUnauthorized) {
      throw error;
    }

    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.isNotFound) {
      notFound();
    }

    return (
      <DataUnavailable
        title="Employee Documents"
        description="Compliance documents attached to one employee."
        subject={`The documents for employee #${employeeId}`}
        reason={error instanceof ApiError ? error.message : undefined}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title={`${employee.fullName} — Documents`}
        description={`${employee.employeeNumber} · ${
          employee.branchName ?? "No branch"
        }`}
        actions={
          <Link
            href={`/hr/employees/${employeeId}`}
            className={buttonVariants({ variant: "secondary" })}
          >
            <Icon name="arrow_back" className="text-[18px]" />
            Back to record
          </Link>
        }
      />

      <DocumentManager employeeId={employeeId} documents={documents} />
    </>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useActionState, useState } from "react";

import {
  deleteDocumentAction,
  uploadDocumentAction,
} from "@/app/actions/document";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

import type { ActionState, EmployeeDocumentResponse } from "@/types";

/**
 * Employee documents — upload, list, remove.
 *
 * All three are real endpoints, so this screen has no placeholder path. Three
 * things the old design assumed and the API does not have:
 *
 *  - **No expiry.** `EmployeeDocumentResponse` carries `uploadedAt` and nothing
 *    else date-like, so the "Expires in 12 days" chips are gone. They were the
 *    only reason the checklist looked urgent.
 *  - **No download.** `fileUrl` is a server-side storage path; there is no
 *    endpoint that serves the bytes. The view/download buttons are gone rather
 *    than being links that 404.
 *  - **No drag-and-drop.** A plain file input. Dropping a file on a div that
 *    cannot accept it is worse than a labelled input that can.
 */

const DOC_ICON: Record<string, string> = {
  CONTRACT: "description",
  NATIONAL_ID: "badge",
  KRA_PIN: "receipt_long",
  CERTIFICATE: "workspace_premium",
  CV: "article",
  OTHER: "attach_file",
};

export function DocumentManager({
  employeeId,
  documents,
}: {
  employeeId: number;
  documents: EmployeeDocumentResponse[];
}) {
  const present = new Set(documents.map((document) => document.documentType));

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-gutter lg:grid-cols-12">
      <div className="col-span-12 flex flex-col gap-gutter lg:col-span-8">
        <UploadPanel employeeId={employeeId} />

        {documents.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="rounded-card border border-dashed border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-lowest p-10 text-center">
            <Icon
              name="folder_open"
              className="mb-3 text-[40px] text-on-surface-variant"
            />
            <p className="font-body-md text-body-md font-semibold text-on-surface">
              No documents on file
            </p>
            <p className="mt-1 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">
              Upload the first one using the panel above.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-gutter sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3">
            {documents.map((document) => (
              <DocumentCard
                key={document.id}
                employeeId={employeeId}
                document={document}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="col-span-12 lg:col-span-4">
        <div className="rounded-card border border-surface-container bg-surface-container-lowest p-card-padding shadow-ambient-1">
          <h3 className="mb-1 font-body-lg text-body-lg font-bold text-on-surface">

          </h3>
          <p className="mb-5 font-body-md text-[11px] text-outline">

            the API stores an upload date, not an expiry date.
          </p>

          <div className="mb-5 h-2 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-surface-container-high">
            <div
              className="h-2 rounded-full bg-primary"
              style={{ width: `${(present.size / DOCUMENT_TYPES.length) * 100}%` }}
            />
          </div>

          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            {DOCUMENT_TYPES.map((type) => {
              const onFile = present.has(type);

              return (
                <li key={type} className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <span
                    className={`flex size-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[15px] ${
                      onFile
                        ? "bg-tertiary-container/20 text-tertiary"
                        : "bg-surface-container text-on-surface-variant"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Icon name={onFile ? "check" : "remove"} />
                  </span>
                  <span
                    className={`font-body-md text-body-md ${
                      onFile ? "font-medium text-on-surface" : "text-on-surface-variant"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {humanizeEnum(type)}
                  </span>

              );
            })}
          </ul>

          <p className="mt-5 border-t border-outline-variant/50 pt-4 text-[11px] text-outline">

            document uploaded through the API directly could carry a type not

function UploadPanel({ employeeId }: { employeeId: number }) {
  const [state, formAction] = useActionState<
    ActionState<EmployeeDocumentResponse>,
    FormData
  >(uploadDocumentAction, { status: "idle" });

  // The file input is uncontrolled and keeps its selection after a successful
  // submit, which would leave the panel looking like it still has a pending
  // upload. Keying the form on a counter clears both it and the action state.
  const [resetKey, setResetKey] = useState(0);

  useActionToast(state, {
    success: (document) => `Uploaded ${document.fileName ?? "document"}`,
    onSuccess: () => setResetKey((key) => key + 1),
  });

  const errors = state.status === "error" ? state.fieldErrors : undefined;

  return (
    <form
      key={resetKey}
      action={formAction}
      className="rounded-card border border-surface-container bg-surface-container-lowest p-card-padding shadow-ambient-1"
    >
      <input type="hidden" name="employeeId" value={employeeId} />

      <h3 className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-2 font-body-lg text-body-lg font-bold text-on-surface">
        <Icon name="cloud_upload" className="text-[22px] text-primary" />
        Upload a Document
      </h3>

      {state.status === "error" ? (
        <p role="alert" className="mb-4 text-[12px] text-error">
          {state.message}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div>
          <label
            htmlFor="document-type"
            className="mb-1 block font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline"
          >
            Document Type
          </label>
          <select
            id="document-type"
            name="documentType"
            required
            defaultValue=""
            className="w-full rounded-lg border border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-lowest px-3 py-2.5 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface focus:border-primary-container focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-container/20"
          >
            <option value="" disabled>
              Choose a type
            </option>
            {DOCUMENT_TYPES.map((type) => (
              <option key={type} value={type}>
                {humanizeEnum(type)}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          {errors?.documentType?.[0] ? (
            <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-error">
              {errors.documentType[0]}
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        <div>
          <label
            htmlFor="document-file"
            className="mb-1 block font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline"
          >
            File
          </label>
          <input
            id="document-file"
            name="file"
            type="file"
            required
            className="w-full rounded-lg border border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-lowest px-3 py-2 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface file:mr-3 file:rounded file:border-0 file:bg-surface-container file:px-3 file:py-1.5 file:font-body-md file:text-body-md file:text-on-surface-variant focus:border-primary-container focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-container/20"
          />
          {errors?.file?.[0] ? (
            <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-error">{errors.file[0]}</p>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <p className="text-[11px] text-outline">
          Up to 10 MB. The file is stored by the backend under a path this app
          cannot serve back, so an upload cannot be previewed here afterwards.
        </p>
        <Button type="submit" icon="upload" className="shrink-0">
          Upload
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

function DocumentCard({
  employeeId,
  document,
}: {
  employeeId: number;
  document: EmployeeDocumentResponse;
}) {
  const [state, formAction] = useActionState<ActionState, FormData>(
    deleteDocumentAction,
    { status: "idle" },
  );

  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);

  useActionToast(state, { success: "Document removed" });

  return (
    <div className="group relative flex flex-col rounded-card border border-surface-container bg-surface-container-lowest p-4 shadow-ambient-1">
      <span className="mb-4 flex size-12 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary-fixed text-primary">
        <Icon
          name={DOC_ICON[document.documentType] ?? "attach_file"}
          className="text-2xl"
        />
      </span>

      <h4 className="mb-1 truncate pr-8 font-body-md text-body-md font-bold text-on-surface">
        {document.fileName ?? "Untitled file"}
      </h4>
      <p className="mb-3 font-body-md text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant">
        {humanizeEnum(document.documentType)}
        {document.uploadedAt
          ? ` · uploaded ${formatDate(document.uploadedAt)}`
          : ""}
      </p>

      {/* The stored path, shown rather than linked — there is no endpoint that
          returns the bytes, so a link would go nowhere. */}
      <p className="mb-4 truncate font-mono text-[10px] text-outline" title={document.fileUrl}>
        {document.fileUrl ?? "No path recorded"}
      </p>

      {state.status === "error" ? (
        <p role="alert" className="mb-3 text-[11px] text-error">
          {state.message}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <form action={formAction} className="mt-auto">
        <input type="hidden" name="employeeId" value={employeeId} />
        <input type="hidden" name="documentId" value={document.id} />

        {confirming ? (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="rounded-lg bg-error px-3 py-1.5 font-body-md text-[11px] font-semibold text-on-error"
            >
              Remove permanently
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setConfirming(false)}
              className="font-body-md text-[11px] font-semibold text-on-surface-variant hover:text-on-surface"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setConfirming(true)}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 font-body-md text-[11px] font-semibold text-on-surface-variant transition-colors hover:text-error"
          >
            <Icon name="delete" className="text-[14px]" />
            Remove
          </button>
        )}
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\app\(portal)\hr\employees\[id]\edit\page.tsx =====
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";

import { ApiError } from "@/app/lib/api-error";
import { requirePermission } from "@/app/lib/dal";
import { DataUnavailable } from "@/components/shared/data-unavailable";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { getAgents } from "@/lib/api/agent";
import { getBranches } from "@/lib/api/branch";
import { getDepartmentsByBranch } from "@/lib/api/department";
import { getEmployee } from "@/lib/api/employee";
import type { AgentResponse, BranchResponse, DepartmentResponse } from "@/types";

import { EmployeeForm } from "../../_components/employee-form";

/**
 * Edit Employee.
 *
 * `PUT /employees/{id}` takes the same `EmployeeRequest` as create, so this
 * page reuses the create form rather than maintaining a second, drifting copy
 * of the field list. The one difference is the hidden `id` field.
 *
 * `employeeNumber` is shown but not editable — it is generated once at creation
 * and the request DTO has no field for it.
 */
export default async function EditEmployeePage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  await requirePermission("employee:write");

  const { id } = await params;
  const employeeId = Number(id);

  if (!Number.isInteger(employeeId) || employeeId <= 0) {
    notFound();
  }

  let employee;
  let branches: BranchResponse[];

  try {
    [employee, branches] = await Promise.all([
      getEmployee(employeeId),
      getBranches(),
    ]);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError) {
      if (error.isNotFound) notFound();

      if (error.isForbidden) {
        return (
          <DataUnavailable
            title="Edit Employee"
            description="Update employee records and compliance data."
            subject="This employee's record"
            reason="Your role is not permitted to read /branches yet, so the branch and department fields cannot be filled. See docs/backend-patches/HR_MANAGER_READ_ACCESS.md."
          />
        );
      }
    }

    throw error;
  }

  const [agentsResult, departmentResults] = await Promise.all([
    getAgents().catch(() => [] as AgentResponse[]),
    Promise.allSettled(branches.map((branch) => getDepartmentsByBranch(branch.id))),
  ]);

  const departmentsByBranch: Record<number, DepartmentResponse[]> = {};

  branches.forEach((branch, index) => {
    const result = departmentResults[index];

    departmentsByBranch[branch.id] =
      result?.status === "fulfilled" ? result.value : [];
  });

  // The employee's own department may not be in the list if their branch read
  // failed or they were moved since; the form's select falls back to "None"
  // rather than silently submitting a department from another branch.
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title={`Edit ${employee.fullName}`}
        description={`Employee ${employee.employeeNumber} — update records and compliance data.`}
      />

      <EmployeeForm
        mode="edit"
        initial={employee}
        options={{ branches, departmentsByBranch, agents: agentsResult }}
      />
    </>
  );
}

===== src\app\(portal)\hr\employees\_components\employee-form.tsx =====
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useActionState, useState } from "react";

import {
  createEmployeeAction,
  updateEmployeeAction,
} from "@/app/actions/employee";
import { BentoCard } from "@/components/shared/bento-card";
import { SubmitButton } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { useActionToast } from "@/hooks/use-action-toast";
import { toDateInput } from "@/lib/format";
import type {
  ActionState,
  AgentResponse,
  BranchResponse,
  DepartmentResponse,
  EmployeeResponse,
} from "@/types";

/**
 * The employee form, used by both /hr/employees/new and /hr/employees/[id]/edit.
 *
 * Its field list is `EmployeeRequest` and nothing else. Three absences are
 * deliberate and worth naming, because each one was a bug in the previous
 * version of this screen:
 *
 *  - **No employee number.** The service mints `EMP-<branchCode>-<seq>` and
 *    retries on collision. A field here would either be ignored or fight it.
 *  - **No employment status.** It is not on the request DTO. The entity
 *    defaults to ACTIVE. Only terminate changes it, and that is its own action.
 *  - **No payment method, no profile photo.** Neither endpoint exists. A
 *    control that silently discards a value is worse than no control.
 *
 * The Branch → Department cascade is not cosmetic: the service rejects a
 * department that does not belong to the chosen branch, so the department list
 * is filtered to the selected branch and cleared when the branch changes.
 */

export type EmployeeFormOptions = {
  branches: BranchResponse[];
  /** Keyed by branch id — one read per branch, done on the server. */
  departmentsByBranch: Record<number, DepartmentResponse[]>;
  agents: AgentResponse[];
};

export function EmployeeForm({
  mode,
  options,
  initial,
}: {
  mode: "create" | "edit";
  options: EmployeeFormOptions;
  initial?: EmployeeResponse;
}) {
  // Remounting on "Add another" resets both the uncontrolled inputs and the
  // useActionState result, which cannot be reset in place.
  const [instance, setInstance] = useState(0);

  return (
    <EmployeeFormInstance
      key={instance}
      mode={mode}
      options={options}
      initial={initial}
      onStartAnother={() => setInstance((n) => n + 1)}
    />
  );
}

function EmployeeFormInstance({
  mode,
  options,
  initial,
  onStartAnother,
}: {
  mode: "create" | "edit";
  options: EmployeeFormOptions;
  initial?: EmployeeResponse;
  onStartAnother: () => void;
}) {
  const action = mode === "create" ? createEmployeeAction : updateEmployeeAction;

  const [state, formAction] = useActionState<
    ActionState<EmployeeResponse>,
    FormData
  >(action, { status: "idle" });

  useActionToast(state, {
    success:
      mode === "create"
        ? (employee) => `${employee.fullName} created as ${employee.employeeNumber}`
        : "Employee updated",
  });

  const errors = state.status === "error" ? state.fieldErrors : undefined;
  const created = state.status === "success" ? state.data : undefined;

  // Branch and department are the one controlled pair on the form: the
  // department list is a function of the branch, and the service rejects a
  // department that belongs to a different branch. Every other field is
  // uncontrolled, so a failed submit leaves the user's typing in place.
  const [branchId, setBranchId] = useState(
    initial ? String(initial.branchId) : "",
  );
  const [departmentId, setDepartmentId] = useState(
    initial?.departmentId ? String(initial.departmentId) : "",
  );

  const departments = options.departmentsByBranch[Number(branchId)] ?? [];

  if (created && mode === "create") {
    return <CreatedPanel employee={created} onStartAnother={onStartAnother} />;
  }

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-gutter pb-24 lg:grid-cols-12">
      {mode === "edit" && initial ? (
        <input type="hidden" name="id" value={initial.id} />
      ) : null}

      {/* ───────────────────────────────── main column ─────────────────── */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-gutter lg:col-span-8">
        {state.status === "error" ? (
          <p
            role="alert"
            className="rounded-lg border border-error/40 bg-error/5 px-4 py-3 font-body-md text-body-md text-error"
          >
            {state.message}
          </p>
        ) : null}

        <BentoCard title="Personal Details">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-gutter md:grid-cols-2">
            <Field
              label="Full Name"
              name="fullName"
              placeholder="John Doe"
              required
              defaultValue={initial?.fullName}
              error={errors?.fullName?.[0]}
            />
            <Field
              label="Date of Birth"
              name="dateOfBirth"
              type="date"
              defaultValue={toDateInput(initial?.dateOfBirth)}
              error={errors?.dateOfBirth?.[0]}
            />
            <Select
              label="Gender"
              name="gender"
              placeholder="Select Gender"
              defaultValue={initial?.gender ?? ""}
              error={errors?.gender?.[0]}
              options={[
                { value: "MALE", label: "Male" },
                { value: "FEMALE", label: "Female" },
                { value: "OTHER", label: "Other" },
              ]}
            />
            <Select
              label="Marital Status"
              name="maritalStatus"
              placeholder="Select Marital Status"
              defaultValue={initial?.maritalStatus ?? ""}
              error={errors?.maritalStatus?.[0]}
              options={[
                { value: "SINGLE", label: "Single" },
                { value: "MARRIED", label: "Married" },
                { value: "DIVORCED", label: "Divorced" },
                { value: "WIDOWED", label: "Widowed" },
              ]}
            />
            <Field
              label="National ID"
              name="nationalId"
              placeholder="e.g. 12345678"
              defaultValue={initial?.nationalId ?? undefined}
              error={errors?.nationalId?.[0]}
            />
            <Field
              label="Phone Number"
              name="phone"
              type="tel"
              placeholder="+254 700 000000"
              defaultValue={initial?.phone ?? undefined}
              error={errors?.phone?.[0]}
            />
            <Field

            />

            />

          }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ fields */

const inputClass =
  "w-full rounded-lg border border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-lowest px-3 py-2.5 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface focus:border-primary-container focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-container/20";

const labelClass =
  "mb-1 block font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline";

function Field({
  label,
  name,
  error,
  className,
  ...props
}: React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> & {
  label: string;
  name: string;
  error?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div>
      <label className={labelClass} htmlFor={`employee-${name}`}>
        {label}
        {props.required ? <span className="ml-0.5 text-error">*</span> : null}
      </label>
      <input
        id={`employee-${name}`}
        name={name}
        aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
        aria-describedby={error ? `employee-${name}-error` : undefined}
        className={`${inputClass} ${className ?? ""}`}
        {...props}
      />
      {error ? (
        <p id={`employee-${name}-error`} className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-error">
          {error}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function Select({
  label,
  name,
  options,
  placeholder,
  error,
  ...props
}: React.SelectHTMLAttributes<HTMLSelectElement> & {
  label: string;
  name: string;
  options: { value: string; label: string }[];
  placeholder: string;
  error?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div>
      <label className={labelClass} htmlFor={`employee-${name}`}>
        {label}
        {props.required ? <span className="ml-0.5 text-error">*</span> : null}
      </label>
      <select
        id={`employee-${name}`}
        name={name}
        aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
        aria-describedby={error ? `employee-${name}-error` : undefined}
        className={inputClass}
        {...props}
      >
        <option value="">{placeholder}</option>
        {options.map((option) => (
          <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
            {option.label}
          </option>
        ))}
      </select>
      {error ? (
        <p id={`employee-${name}-error`} className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-error">
          {error}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * The department list is a function of the selected branch, not a fixed list.
 * That is a correctness requirement, not a nicety: `EmployeeServiceImpl` throws
 * when the department does not belong to the branch on the request, so a stale
 * department from a previously-selected branch would fail the whole submit.
 *
 * Every branch's departments are read once on the server and passed in as a
 * map, which costs one call per branch on page load and saves a round-trip on
 * every branch change. That is the right trade while branches number in the
 * single digits; at a hundred it would want an on-demand lookup instead.
 */

===== src\app\(portal)\hr\employees\_components\terminate-employee.tsx =====
"use client";

import { useActionState, useState } from "react";

import { terminateEmployeeAction } from "@/app/actions/employee";
import { BentoCard } from "@/components/shared/bento-card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { useActionToast } from "@/hooks/use-action-toast";
import type { ActionState } from "@/types";

/**
 * Terminate, behind a confirmation.
 *
 * This is the only way employment status changes, and it does not reverse:
 * `PUT /employees/{id}/terminate` sets the status to TERMINATED and there is no
 * endpoint that brings an employee back. The employee row is not deleted — it
 * stays, with its history, which is why the button says "terminate" rather than
 * "delete".
 *
 * The confirm step is a second click in place rather than `window.confirm`,
 * because a native dialog cannot say what is actually about to happen.
 */
export function TerminateEmployee({
  employeeId,
  employeeName,
}: {
  employeeId: number;
  employeeName: string;
}) {
  const [state, formAction] = useActionState<ActionState, FormData>(
    terminateEmployeeAction,
    { status: "idle" },
  );

  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);

  useActionToast(state, { success: `${employeeName} terminated` });

  return (
    <BentoCard
      title={
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Icon name="warning" className="text-[20px] text-error" />
          Terminate
        </span>
      }
      className="border border-error/30"
    >
      {!confirming ? (
        <>
          <p className="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">
            Marks this employee as terminated. Their record and history stay;
            they simply stop appearing as active staff.
          </p>
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            className="mt-4"
            icon="block"
            onClick={() => setConfirming(true)}
          >
            Terminate employee
          </Button>
        </>
      ) : (
        <form action={formAction}>
          <input type="hidden" name="id" value={employeeId} />

          <p className="font-body-md text-body-md font-semibold text-on-surface">
            Terminate {employeeName}?
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant">
            This cannot be undone — the API has no way to reinstate an employee.
          </p>

          {state.status === "error" ? (
            <p role="alert" className="mt-3 text-[11px] text-error">
              {state.message}
            </p>
          ) : null}

          <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <Button type="submit" variant="danger" icon="check">
              Yes, terminate
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="ghost"
              onClick={() => setConfirming(false)}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      )}
    </BentoCard>
  );
}

===== src\app\(portal)\hr\leave\page.tsx =====
import Link from "next/link";

import { ApiError } from "@/app/lib/api-error";
import { requirePermission } from "@/app/lib/dal";
import { BentoCard } from "@/components/shared/bento-card";
import { DataUnavailable } from "@/components/shared/data-unavailable";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/shared/empty-state";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { getPendingHrApprovals } from "@/lib/api/leave";
import { formatDate, formatNumber } from "@/lib/format";
import type { LeaveRequestResponse } from "@/types";

import { LeaveDecision } from "./_components/leave-decision";

/**
 * HR's leave approval queue.
 *
 * The only company-wide leave view the API offers is `/leave/pending/hr`, which
 * is by definition one stage of one status: requests the branch manager has
 * already signed off and that now need HR's decision. There is no `GET /leave`
 * list and no way to browse approved or rejected history company-wide, so this
 * screen does not pretend to offer one — approving a request removes it from
 * this queue, and nothing here can show you where it went.
 *
 * Per-employee history *is* available, on the employee's own page.
 */
export default async function HrLeavePage() {
  await requirePermission("leave:read");

  let requests: LeaveRequestResponse[];

  try {
    requests = await getPendingHrApprovals();
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.isUnauthorized) {
      throw error;
    }

    return (
      <DataUnavailable
        title="Leave Approvals"
        description="Requests the branch manager has forwarded for HR's decision."
        subject="The HR approval queue"
        reason={error instanceof ApiError ? error.message : undefined}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Leave Approvals"
        description="Requests the branch manager has forwarded for HR's decision."
      />

      <BentoCard
        title={
          <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Icon name="pending_actions" className="text-[20px] text-primary" />
            Awaiting HR
          </span>
        }
        action={
          <span className="font-body-md text-[11px] text-outline">
            {formatNumber(requests.length)}{" "}
            {requests.length === 1 ? "request" : "requests"}
          </span>
        }
      >
        {requests.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            symbol="task_alt"
            title="Nothing is waiting on you"
            description="Requests appear here once a branch manager has forwarded them."
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left font-body-md text-body-md">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-outline-variant/50 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                  <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Employee</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Type</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Dates</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Reason</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 text-right">Decision</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {requests.map((request) => (
                  <tr
                    key={request.id}
                    className="border-b border-outline-variant/25 align-top last:border-0"
                  >
                    <td className="py-4 pr-4">
                      <Link
                        href={`/hr/employees/${request.employeeId}`}
                        className="font-semibold text-on-surface hover:text-primary"
                      >
                        {request.employeeName ?? `Employee #${request.employeeId}`}
                      </Link>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-4 pr-4 text-on-surface-variant">
                      {request.leaveTypeName ?? "—"}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-4 pr-4 whitespace-nowrap text-on-surface-variant">
                      {formatDate(request.startDate)} – {formatDate(request.endDate)}
                    </td>
                    <td className="max-w-xs py-4 pr-4 text-on-surface-variant">
                      {request.reason || (
                        <span className="text-outline">No reason given</span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-4 text-right">
                      <LeaveDecision request={request} />
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </BentoCard>

      <p className="mt-4 text-[11px] text-outline">
        Leave has a two-stage approval. A request reaches this queue only after a
        branch manager has approved it; the API exposes no company-wide view of
        approved or rejected history.
      </p>
    </>
  );
}

===== src\app\(portal)\hr\leave\[id]\page.tsx =====
import Link from "next/link";

import { requirePermission } from "@/app/lib/dal";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button-variants";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";

/**
 * A leave request by id — which the API cannot serve.
 *
 * `LeaveController` exposes leave by *scope*: the HR queue (`/pending/hr`), the
 * manager queue (`/pending/manager`), one employee's history
 * (`/employee/{id}`), and the caller's own balance. There is no `GET /leave`
 * and no `GET /leave/{id}`, so a route that takes an arbitrary request id has
 * nothing to read.
 *
 * This page says so rather than being deleted or filled with invented data. The
 * two real ways to find a request are linked below, and the decision itself is
 * made inline on the queue — this screen was never on the path to approving
 * anything.
 */
export default async function LeaveDetailPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  await requirePermission("leave:read");

  const { id } = await params;

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title={`Leave Request #${id}`}
        description="Not available from this API."
      />

      <div className="rounded-card border border-dashed border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-lowest p-8">
        <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
          <Icon
            name="info"
            className="mt-0.5 text-[28px] text-on-surface-variant"
          />
          <div className="max-w-xl">
            <p className="font-body-md text-body-md font-semibold text-on-surface">
              There is no endpoint that returns a single leave request.
            </p>
            <p className="mt-2 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">
              The backend exposes leave by scope — the HR approval queue, one
              employee&rsquo;s history — and never by request id. Putting a
              placeholder here would mean showing invented dates and statuses for
              a real request, which is worse than showing nothing.
            </p>
            <p className="mt-2 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">
              Decisions are made inline on the queue, so nothing in the product
              links to this page.
            </p>

            <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              <Link href="/hr/leave" className={buttonVariants()}>
                <Icon name="pending_actions" className="text-[18px]" />
                Back to the approval queue
              </Link>
              <Link
                href="/hr/employees"
                className={buttonVariants({ variant: "secondary" })}
              >
                Find the employee
              </Link>
            </div>

            <p className="mt-6 text-[11px] text-outline">
              An employee&rsquo;s full leave history is available on their record
              page, via <code>GET /leave/employee/&#123;id&#125;</code>.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

===== src\app\(portal)\hr\leave\_components\leave-decision.tsx =====
"use client";

import { useActionState, useState } from "react";

import { decideLeaveAction } from "@/app/actions/leave";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { useActionToast } from "@/hooks/use-action-toast";
import type { ActionState, LeaveRequestResponse } from "@/types";

/**
 * Approve / reject, one row at a time.
 *
 * Both outcomes go through the same endpoint — `approve-by-hr` with
 * `approved: false` is the rejection. The form only reveals the reason box once
 * the user has chosen to reject, because the backend does not require a reason
 * and a permanently-visible optional field invites people to leave it blank.
 *
 * The reason is required *here* even though the API allows it to be omitted: a
 * rejection with no reason leaves the employee with a status change and no
 * explanation, and there is nowhere else in the product they would find one.
 */
export function LeaveDecision({
  request,
}: {
  request: LeaveRequestResponse;
}) {
  const [state, formAction] = useActionState<ActionState<LeaveRequestResponse>, FormData>(
    decideLeaveAction,
    { status: "idle" },
  );

  const [rejecting, setRejecting] = useState(false);

  useActionToast(state, {
    success:
      state.status === "success"
        ? `${request.employeeName ?? "Request"} ${state.data.status === "APPROVED" ? "approved" : "rejected"}`
        : undefined,
  });

  if (state.status === "success") {
    return (
      <span className="font-body-md text-[11px] font-semibold text-tertiary">
        {state.data.status === "APPROVED" ? "Approved" : "Rejected"}
      </span>
    );
  }

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="flex flex-col items-end gap-2">
      <input type="hidden" name="leaveRequestId" value={request.id} />
      <input
        type="hidden"
        name="decision"
        value={rejecting ? "reject" : "approve"}
      />

      {state.status === "error" ? (
        <p role="alert" className="text-right text-[11px] text-error">
          {state.message}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      {rejecting ? (
        <>
          <textarea
            name="rejectionReason"
            rows={2}
            required
            placeholder="Why is this being rejected?"
            className="w-56 rounded-lg border border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-lowest px-3 py-2 font-body-md text-[12px] text-on-surface focus:border-primary-container focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-container/20"
          />
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Button type="submit" size="sm" variant="danger">
              Confirm rejection
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              variant="ghost"
              onClick={() => setRejecting(false)}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
          </div>
        </>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button type="submit" size="sm" variant="primary" icon="check">
            Approve
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="sm"
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => setRejecting(true)}
          >
            Reject
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </form>
  );
}

===== src\app\(portal)\hr\shifts\roster\page.tsx =====
import Link from "next/link";

import { ApiError } from "@/app/lib/api-error";
import { requirePermission } from "@/app/lib/dal";
import { BentoCard } from "@/components/shared/bento-card";
import { DataUnavailable } from "@/components/shared/data-unavailable";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/shared/empty-state";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { getBranches } from "@/lib/api/branch";
import { getDepartmentsByBranch } from "@/lib/api/department";
import { getEmployeesByBranch } from "@/lib/api/employee";
import {
  getShiftAssignmentsForBranch,
  getShifts,
} from "@/lib/api/shift";
import { formatNumber } from "@/lib/format";
import { buildHref, first, parseId } from "@/lib/search-params";
import type {
  BranchResponse,
  DepartmentResponse,
  EmployeeSummaryResponse,
  ShiftAssignmentResponse,
  ShiftResponse,
} from "@/types";

import { AssignShiftForm } from "./_components/assign-shift-form";

/**
 * The roster — who is on which shift in one branch.
 *
 * Assignments are stored against a *target*, and `ShiftAssignmentRequest` lets
 * that target be an employee, a department or a whole branch. `ShiftAssignmentResponse`
 * mirrors that: three nullable id columns, only one of which is set. The table
 * below therefore resolves whichever one is present rather than assuming a row
 * means a person.
 *
 * Scope is a required choice, not decoration: `GET /shifts/assignments/branch/{id}`
 * is per-branch and there is no company-wide assignment list, so the screen picks
 * a branch before it can read anything.
 */
export default async function ShiftRosterPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ branchId?: string | string[] }>;
}) {
  await requirePermission("shift:read");

  const params = await searchParams;
  const requestedBranchId = parseId(first(params.branchId));

  let branches: BranchResponse[];

  try {
    branches = await getBranches();
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError && error.isUnauthorized) {
      throw error;
    }

    return (
      <DataUnavailable
        title="Shift Roster"
        description="Who is rostered onto which shift, branch by branch."
        subject="The branch list"
        reason={error instanceof ApiError ? error.message : undefined}
      />
    );
  }

  if (branches.length === 0) {
    return (
      <>
        <PageHeader
          title="Shift Roster"
          description="Who is rostered onto which shift, branch by branch."
        />
        <BentoCard title="No branches">
          <EmptyState
            symbol="account_tree"
            title="No branches to roster"
            description="A shift assignment is always scoped to a branch, so there is nothing to show until a branch exists."
          />
        </BentoCard>
      </>
    );
  }

  const activeBranch =
    branches.find((branch) => branch.id === requestedBranchId) ?? branches[0];

  // Everything the screen needs about the active branch, read together. The
  // assignment list is the one that matters; the other two exist to resolve its
  // ids into names, so a failure there degrades the labels, not the page.
  const [shiftsResult, assignmentsResult, departmentsResult, employeesResult] =
    await Promise.allSettled([
      getShifts(),
      getShiftAssignmentsForBranch(activeBranch.id),
      getDepartmentsByBranch(activeBranch.id),
      getEmployeesByBranch(activeBranch.id),
    ]);

  if (
    assignmentsResult.status === "rejected" &&
    assignmentsResult.reason instanceof ApiError &&
    assignmentsResult.reason.isUnauthorized
  ) {
    throw assignmentsResult.reason;
  }

  if (assignmentsResult.status === "rejected") {
    return (
      <DataUnavailable
        title="Shift Roster"
        description="Who is rostered onto which shift, branch by branch."
        subject={`The roster for ${activeBranch.name}`}
        reason={
          assignmentsResult.reason instanceof ApiError
            ? assignmentsResult.reason.message
            : undefined
        }
      />
    );
  }

  const assignments = assignmentsResult.value;
  const shifts = shiftsResult.status === "fulfilled" ? shiftsResult.value : [];
  const departments =
    departmentsResult.status === "fulfilled" ? departmentsResult.value : [];
  const employees =
    employeesResult.status === "fulfilled" ? employeesResult.value : [];

  const shiftNames = new Map(shifts.map((shift) => [shift.id, shift.name]));
  const departmentNames = new Map(
    departments.map((department) => [department.id, department.name]),
  );
  const employeeNames = new Map(
    employees.map((employee) => [employee.id, employee.fullName]),
  );

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Shift Roster"
        description="Who is rostered onto which shift, branch by branch."
        actions={
          <Link
            href="/hr/shifts"
            className="font-body-md text-body-md font-semibold text-primary hover:underline"
          >
            Back to shifts
          </Link>
        }
      />

      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {branches.map((branch) => {
          const active = branch.id === activeBranch.id;

          return (
            <Link
              key={branch.id}
              href={buildHref("/hr/shifts/roster", { branchId: branch.id })}
              className={`rounded-full border px-3 py-1.5 font-body-md text-[12px] transition-colors ${
                active
                  ? "border-primary-container bg-primary-container/10 font-semibold text-primary"
                  : "border-outline-variant text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container"
              }`}
            >
              {branch.name}
            </Link>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-gutter lg:grid-cols-12">
        <div className="lg:col-span-8">
          <BentoCard
            title={
              <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Icon name="calendar_view_week" className="text-[20px] text-primary" />
                {activeBranch.name}
              </span>
            }
            action={
              <span className="font-body-md text-[11px] text-outline">
                {formatNumber(assignments.length)}{" "}
                {assignments.length === 1 ? "assignment" : "assignments"}
              </span>
            }
          >
            {assignments.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                symbol="calendar_view_week"
                title="Nothing rostered yet"
                description="No shift has been assigned to this branch, its departments or its employees."
              />
            ) : (
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-left font-body-md text-body-md">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-outline-variant/50 font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline">
                      <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Shift</th>
                      <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Assigned To</th>
                      <th className="pb-3">Scope</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {assignments.map((assignment) => {
                      const target = describeTarget(
                        assignment,
                        { employeeNames, departmentNames },
                        activeBranch,
                      );

                      return (
                        <tr
                          key={assignment.id}
                          className="border-b border-outline-variant/25 last:border-0"
                        >
                          <td className="py-3 pr-4 font-semibold text-on-surface">
                            {assignment.shiftName ??
                              shiftNames.get(assignment.shiftId) ??
                              `Shift #${assignment.shiftId}`}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3 pr-4 text-on-surface-variant">
                            {target.name}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3">
                            <span className="rounded-full bg-surface-container px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-on-surface-variant">
                              {target.scope}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
          </BentoCard>
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-4">
          <BentoCard
            title={
              <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Icon name="assignment_ind" className="text-[20px] text-primary" />
                Assign a Shift
              </span>
            }
          >
            {shifts.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">
                There are no shifts to assign yet.{" "}
                <Link
                  href="/hr/shifts"
                  className="font-semibold text-primary hover:underline"
                >
                  Create one first
                </Link>
                .
              </p>
            ) : (
              <AssignShiftForm
                shifts={shifts}
                departments={departments}
                employees={employees}
                branchId={activeBranch.id}
                branchName={activeBranch.name}
              />
            )}
          </BentoCard>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * Which of the three target columns this row carries, and what to call it.
 *
 * A row should have exactly one; the employee branch is checked first because
 * that is the most specific assignment, but a row with more than one set is
 * reported as ambiguous rather than silently picking one.
 */
function describeTarget(
  assignment: ShiftAssignmentResponse,
  lookups: {
    employeeNames: Map<number, string>;
    departmentNames: Map<number, string>;
  },
  branch: BranchResponse,
): { name: string; scope: string } {
  const set = [
    assignment.employeeId !== null ? "employee" : null,
    assignment.departmentId !== null ? "department" : null,
    assignment.branchId !== null ? "branch" : null,
  ].filter((value): value is string => value !== null);

  if (set.length !== 1) {
    return {
      name: set.length === 0 ? "No target set" : set.join(" + "),
      scope: set.length === 0 ? "Unassigned" : "Ambiguous",
    };
  }

  if (assignment.employeeId !== null) {
    return {
      name:
        lookups.employeeNames.get(assignment.employeeId) ??
        `Employee #${assignment.employeeId}`,
      scope: "Employee",
    };
  }

  if (assignment.departmentId !== null) {
    return {
      name:
        lookups.departmentNames.get(assignment.departmentId) ??
        `Department #${assignment.departmentId}`,
      scope: "Department",
    };
  }

  return {
    name:
      assignment.branchId === branch.id
        ? branch.name
        : `Branch #${assignment.branchId}`,
    scope: "Whole branch",
  };
}

===== src\app\(portal)\hr\shifts\roster\_components\assign-shift-form.tsx =====
"use client";

import { useActionState, useState } from "react";

import { assignShiftAction } from "@/app/actions/shift";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { useActionToast } from "@/hooks/use-action-toast";
import type {
  ActionState,
  DepartmentResponse,
  EmployeeSummaryResponse,
  ShiftAssignmentResponse,
  ShiftResponse,
} from "@/types";

/**
 * Assign a shift to an employee, a department or a branch.
 *
 * `ShiftAssignmentRequest` carries three nullable target fields, exactly one of
 * which should be set. Rather than three selects — where two of them are always
 * being left blank — this uses one grouped select whose value encodes both the
 * kind of target and its id ("employee:12"), split into the three real fields
 * on submit. The payload is unchanged; only the input is.
 *
 * The backend accepts all three as null and would store an assignment to
 * nobody, so the action refuses that case.
 */
export function AssignShiftForm({
  shifts,
  departments,
  employees,
  branchId,
  branchName,
}: {
  shifts: ShiftResponse[];
  departments: DepartmentResponse[];
  employees: EmployeeSummaryResponse[];
  branchId: number;
  branchName: string;
}) {
  const [state, formAction] = useActionState<
    ActionState<ShiftAssignmentResponse>,
    FormData
  >(assignShiftAction, { status: "idle" });

  useActionToast(state, { success: "Shift assigned" });

  const [target, setTarget] = useState("");
  const errors = state.status === "error" ? state.fieldErrors : undefined;

  const [kind, id] = target.split(":");

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      {state.status === "error" ? (
        <p role="alert" className="text-[11px] text-error">
          {state.message}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <div>
        <label
          htmlFor="assignment-shift"
          className="mb-1 block font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline"
        >
          Shift
        </label>
        <select
          id="assignment-shift"
          name="shiftId"
          required
          defaultValue=""
          className="w-full rounded-lg border border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-lowest px-3 py-2.5 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface focus:border-primary-container focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-container/20"
        >
          <option value="" disabled>
            Select shift
          </option>
          {shifts.map((shift) => (
            <option key={shift.id} value={shift.id}>
              {shift.name}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        {errors?.shiftId?.[0] ? (
          <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-error">{errors.shiftId[0]}</p>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div>
        <label
          htmlFor="assignment-target"
          className="mb-1 block font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline"
        >
          Assign To
        </label>
        <select
          id="assignment-target"
          value={target}
          onChange={(event) => setTarget(event.target.value)}
          required
          className="w-full rounded-lg border border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-lowest px-3 py-2.5 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface focus:border-primary-container focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-container/20"
        >
          <option value="" disabled>
            Choose a target
          </option>
          <option value={`branch:${branchId}`}>
            Whole branch — {branchName}
          </option>
          <optgroup label="Departments">
            {departments.map((department) => (
              <option key={department.id} value={`department:${department.id}`}>
                {department.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </optgroup>
          <optgroup label="Employees">
            {employees.map((employee) => (
              <option key={employee.id} value={`employee:${employee.id}`}>
                {employee.fullName}
              </option>
            ))}
          </optgroup>
        </select>
        {errors?.employeeId?.[0] ? (
          <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-error">{errors.employeeId[0]}</p>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      {/* Exactly one of the three is populated; the other two stay absent so the
          request carries nulls for them, which is what the DTO expects. */}
      <input
        type="hidden"
        name="employeeId"
        value={kind === "employee" ? id : ""}
      />
      <input
        type="hidden"
        name="departmentId"
        value={kind === "department" ? id : ""}
      />
      <input type="hidden" name="branchId" value={kind === "branch" ? id : ""} />

      <Button type="submit" icon="assignment_ind" className="w-fit">
        Assign shift
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}

===== src\app\(portal)\hr\shifts\_components\shift-form.tsx =====
"use client";

import { useActionState } from "react";

import { createShiftAction } from "@/app/actions/shift";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { useActionToast } from "@/hooks/use-action-toast";
import type { ActionState, ShiftResponse } from "@/types";

/**
 * New shift.
 *
 * The type select offers `ShiftType` values, not shift names: a shift called
 * "Day" has the type MORNING. Offering "Day / Night / Split" here would look
 * consistent with the seeded rows and be rejected by the Java enum on submit.
 */
export function ShiftForm() {
  const [state, formAction] = useActionState<ActionState<ShiftResponse>, FormData>(
    createShiftAction,
    { status: "idle" },
  );

  useActionToast(state, {
    success: (shift) => `Shift "${shift.name}" created`,
  });

  const errors = state.status === "error" ? state.fieldErrors : undefined;

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      {state.status === "error" ? (
        <p role="alert" className="text-[11px] text-error">
          {state.message}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <Field
        label="Name"
        name="name"
        placeholder="e.g. Day"
        required
        error={errors?.name?.[0]}
      />

      <div>
        <label
          htmlFor="shift-type"
          className="mb-1 block font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline"
        >
          Type
        </label>
        <select
          id="shift-type"
          name="type"
          required
          defaultValue=""
          className="w-full rounded-lg border border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-lowest px-3 py-2.5 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface focus:border-primary-container focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-container/20"
        >
          <option value="" disabled>
            Select type
          </option>
          <option value="MORNING">Morning</option>
          <option value="EVENING">Evening</option>
          <option value="NIGHT">Night</option>
          <option value="ROTATING">Rotating</option>
          <option value="FLEXIBLE">Flexible</option>
        </select>
        {errors?.type?.[0] ? (
          <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-error">{errors.type[0]}</p>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <Field label="Starts" name="startTime" type="time" error={errors?.startTime?.[0]} />
        <Field label="Ends" name="endTime" type="time" error={errors?.endTime?.[0]} />
      </div>

      <Button type="submit" icon="add" className="w-fit">
        <Icon name="schedule" className="text-[18px]" />
        Create shift
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}

function Field({
  label,
  name,
  error,
  ...props
}: React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> & {
  label: string;
  name: string;
  error?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div>
      <label
        htmlFor={`shift-${name}`}
        className="mb-1 block font-table-header text-table-header uppercase text-outline"
      >
        {label}
        {props.required ? <span className="ml-0.5 text-error">*</span> : null}
      </label>
      <input
        id={`shift-${name}`}
        name={name}
        aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
        className="w-full rounded-lg border border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-lowest px-3 py-2.5 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface focus:border-primary-container focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-container/20"
        {...props}
      />
      {error ? <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-error">{error}</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

type DocumentBadge =
  | { kind: "EXPIRING"; label: string }

type DocumentCard = {

  displayName: string;

    uploadedDate: "05 Apr 2023",
    sizeLabel: "850 KB",
    icon: "request_quote",
    iconBgClassName: "bg-secondary-fixed/50",
    iconColorClassName: "text-primary",
    badge: { kind: "NEUTRAL", label: "Financial" },
  },
];

function DocumentBadgePill({ badge }: { badge: DocumentBadge }) {
  if (badge.kind === "EXPIRING") {
    return (
      <span className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-error-container px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-on-error-container">
        <Icon name="warning" className="text-[14px]" />
        {badge.label}
      </span>
    );
  }
  if (badge.kind === "VERIFIED") {
    return (
      <span className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-tertiary-fixed-dim/30 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-tertiary">
        <Icon name="check_circle" className="text-[14px]" />
        {badge.label}
      </span>
    );
  }
  return (
    <span className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-surface-container px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-on-surface-variant">
      {badge.label}
    </span>
  );
}

/**
 * Employee leave management overview (balances + request history).
 *
 * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * DATA IS PLACEHOLDER — shaped against `types.LeaveBalance` and
 * `types.LeaveRequest`. Balance rings render used/remaining as a simple SVG
 * arc rather than the shared DonutChart, since these need a compact inline
 * layout the donut component's fixed sizing wasn't built for — confirm
 * DonutChart's API and I can switch these over if it supports a size prop.
 * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 */

type LeaveBalance = {
  id: number;
  label: string;
  used: number;
  total: number;
  icon: string;
  ringColorClassName: string;
  valueColorClassName: string;
};

type LeaveRequestRow = {
  id: number;
  type: string;
  icon: string;
  iconBgClassName: string;
  iconColorClassName: string;
  from: string;
  to: string;
  days: number;
  status: "APPROVED" | "PENDING" | "REJECTED";
};

type Holiday = { id: number; month: string; day: string; name: string; note: string; muted?: boolean };

const BALANCES: readonly LeaveBalance[] = [
  { id: 1, label: "Annual Leave", used: 12, total: 21, icon: "flight_takeoff", ringColorClassName: "text-primary", valueColorClassName: "text-primary" },
  { id: 2, label: "Sick Leave", used: 10, total: 14, icon: "medical_services", ringColorClassName: "text-emerald-500", valueColorClassName: "text-emerald-600" },
  { id: 3, label: "Compassionate", used: 5, total: 5, icon: "volunteer_activism", ringColorClassName: "text-orange-400", valueColorClassName: "text-orange-500" },
];

const REQUESTS: readonly LeaveRequestRow[] = [
  { id: 1, type: "Annual Leave", icon: "flight_takeoff", iconBgClassName: "bg-primary/10", iconColorClassName: "text-primary", from: "Oct 12, 2023", to: "Oct 15, 2023", days: 4, status: "APPROVED" },
  { id: 2, type: "Sick Leave", icon: "medical_services", iconBgClassName: "bg-emerald-100", iconColorClassName: "text-emerald-600", from: "Sep 01, 2023", to: "Sep 02, 2023", days: 2, status: "APPROVED" },
  { id: 3, type: "Annual Leave", icon: "flight_takeoff", iconBgClassName: "bg-primary/10", iconColorClassName: "text-primary", from: "Dec 20, 2023", to: "Jan 02, 2024", days: 10, status: "PENDING" },
];

const HOLIDAYS: readonly Holiday[] = [
  { id: 1, month: "Oct", day: "20", name: "Mashujaa Day", note: "Friday - Long weekend potential" },
  { id: 2, month: "Dec", day: "12", name: "Jamhuri Day", note: "Tuesday" },
  { id: 3, month: "Dec", day: "25", name: "Christmas Day", note: "Monday", muted: true },
];

const STATUS_BADGE: Record<LeaveRequestRow["status"], string> = {
  APPROVED: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800",
  PENDING: "bg-orange-100 text-orange-800",
  REJECTED: "bg-error-container text-on-error-container",
};

function circumferenceOffset(used: number, total: number) {
  const percent = total > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((used / total) * 100)) : 0;
  return `${percent}, 100`;
}

===== src\app\(portal)\me\profile\_components\avatar-upload.tsx =====
"use client";

import { useRef, useState } from "react";

import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { toast } from "@/lib/toast";

/**
 * Avatar with a "change photo" affordance.
 *
 * Its own Client Component so the page around it stays on the server.
 *
 * The markup this replaces was a hover-only <div cursor-pointer>: invisible to
 * keyboard users, unannounced to screen readers, and undiscoverable on touch
 * where there is no hover at all. It is now a real <button> that opens the file
 * picker, so it is tabbable, announced, and always visible on small screens.
 */
export function AvatarUpload({
  src,
  alt,
}: {
  src: string;
  alt: string;
}) {
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);

  function onPick(event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = event.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    if (!file.type.startsWith("image/")) {
      toast.error("That file isn't an image", {
        description: "Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP file.",
      });
      return;
    }

    // 5 MB, matching the limit quoted on the other upload surfaces.
    if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      toast.error("That image is too large", {
        description: "Maximum size is 5 MB.",
      });
      return;
    }

    // Local preview only — there is no upload endpoint yet, so the toast says
    // so rather than letting the new picture imply it was saved.
    setPreview(URL.createObjectURL(file));
    toast.notImplemented("Photo upload");
  }

  return (
    <div className="group/avatar relative size-28 shrink-0 sm:size-32">
      <div className="size-full overflow-hidden rounded-full border-4 border-surface-container-lowest shadow-md">
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element -- avatars are
            remote/user-supplied and not served through the image optimiser. */}
        <img src={preview ?? src} alt={alt} className="size-full object-cover" />
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        data-live=""
        onClick={() => inputRef.current?.click()}
        className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/60 text-white opacity-0 backdrop-blur-sm transition-opacity duration-200 focus-visible:opacity-100 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-on-primary group-hover/avatar:opacity-100 motion-reduce:transition-none"
      >
        <Icon name="photo_camera" className="mb-1" />
        <span className="text-xs font-medium">Change Photo</span>
      </button>

      <input
        ref={inputRef}
        type="file"
        accept="image/*"
        onChange={onPick}
        className="sr-only"
        tabIndex={-1}
        aria-hidden
      />
    </div>
  );
}

 * Client Component because it owns form state and the save result; the
 * read-only employment panel beside it stays on the server.
 *
 * The fields here are the ones an employee may change about themselves.
 * Employee number, hire date, department and branch are deliberately absent —
 * those are HR-owned and render as locked text in the sibling panel.
 */

export type ProfileFormData = {
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  dateOfBirth: string;
  gender: string;
  maritalStatus: string;
  email: string;
  phone: string;
  address: string;
};

export function ProfileForm({ initial }: { initial: ProfileFormData }) {
  const [state, formAction] = useActionState<ActionState, FormData>(
    updateMyProfile,
    { status: "idle" },
  );

  useActionToast(state, { success: "Profile updated" });

  const fieldErrors = state.status === "error" ? state.fieldErrors : undefined;

  return (
    <form
      action={formAction}
      className="space-y-gutter md:col-span-8"
      data-live-region
    >
      <div className="rounded-2xl bg-surface-container-lowest p-6 shadow-ambient-1 sm:p-8">
        <h3 className="mb-6 flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-outline-variant/30 pb-2 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-secondary">
          <Icon name="person" className="text-[18px]" />
          Personal Information
        </h3>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-6 gap-y-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Field
            label="First Name"
            name="firstName"
            defaultValue={initial.firstName}
            error={fieldErrors?.firstName?.[0]}
            required
          />
          <Field
            label="Last Name"
            name="lastName"
            defaultValue={initial.lastName}
            error={fieldErrors?.lastName?.[0]}
            required
          />
          <Field
            label="Date of Birth"
            name="dateOfBirth"
            type="date"
            defaultValue={initial.dateOfBirth}
            error={fieldErrors?.dateOfBirth?.[0]}
          />
          <SelectField
            label="Gender"
            name="gender"
            defaultValue={initial.gender}
            options={["Male", "Female", "Other"]}
            error={fieldErrors?.gender?.[0]}
          />
          <SelectField
            label="Marital Status"
            name="maritalStatus"
            defaultValue={initial.maritalStatus}
            options={["Single", "Married", "Divorced", "Widowed"]}
            error={fieldErrors?.maritalStatus?.[0]}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-2xl bg-surface-container-lowest p-6 shadow-ambient-1 sm:p-8">
        <h3 className="mb-6 flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-outline-variant/30 pb-2 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-secondary">
          <Icon name="contact_mail" className="text-[18px]" />
          Contact Details
        </h3>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-6 gap-y-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Field
            label="Email"
            name="email"
            type="email"
            autoComplete="email"
            defaultValue={initial.email}
            error={fieldErrors?.email?.[0]}
            required
          />
          <Field
            label="Phone"
            name="phone"
            type="tel"
            autoComplete="tel"
            defaultValue={initial.phone}
            error={fieldErrors?.phone?.[0]}
            required
          />
          <div className="sm:col-span-2">
            <Field
              label="Address"
              name="address"
              defaultValue={initial.address}
              error={fieldErrors?.address?.[0]}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Stacks on mobile so neither button is squeezed below a usable width. */}
      <div className="flex flex-col-reverse gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end">
        <SubmitButton variant="primary" size="lg" icon="save" loadingText="Saving…">
          Save Changes
        </SubmitButton>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ fields */

function Field({
  label,
  name,
  error,
  ...props
}: React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> & {
  label: string;
  name: string;
  error?: string;
}) {
  const id = `profile-${name}`;

  return (
    <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
      <label
        htmlFor={id}
        className="mb-1.5 font-body-md text-body-md font-semibold text-on-surface"
      >
        {label}
        {props.required ? <span className="ml-0.5 text-error">*</span> : null}
      </label>
      <input
        id={id}
        name={name}
        aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
        aria-describedby={error ? `${id}-error` : undefined}
        className={`h-10 w-full min-w-0 rounded-lg border bg-surface-container-lowest px-3 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface transition-shadow placeholder:text-outline-variant focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 ${
          error
            ? "border-error focus:border-error focus:ring-error/30"
            : "border-outline-variant focus:border-primary focus:ring-primary/30"
        }`}
        {...props}
      />
      {error ? (
        <p id={`${id}-error`} className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-error">
          {error}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function SelectField({
  label,
  name,
  options,
  defaultValue,
  error,
}: {
  label: string;
  name: string;
  options: string[];
  defaultValue?: string;
  error?: string;
}) {
  const id = `profile-${name}`;

  return (
    <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
      <label
        htmlFor={id}
        className="mb-1.5 font-body-md text-body-md font-semibold text-on-surface"
      >
        {label}
      </label>
      <div className="relative">
        <select
          id={id}
          name={name}
          defaultValue={defaultValue}
          aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
          className={`h-10 w-full min-w-0 appearance-none rounded-lg border bg-surface-container-lowest px-3 pr-9 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface transition-shadow focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 ${
            error
              ? "border-error focus:border-error focus:ring-error/30"
              : "border-outline-variant focus:border-primary focus:ring-primary/30"
          }`}
        >
          {options.map((option) => (
            <option key={option} value={option}>
              {option}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <Icon
          name="expand_more"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-outline"
        />
      </div>
      {error ? <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-error">{error}</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}
