===== src\app\lib\session.ts =====
import "server-only";

import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { SignJWT, jwtVerify } from "jose";

import { env } from "@/config/env";
import { isRole, type Role } from "@/config/roles";

/**
 * Session management. Mirrors `security/JwtService`.
 *
 * The Spring API issues its own JWT. We wrap it in a second, httpOnly cookie
 * signed with SESSION_SECRET so the backend token never reaches the browser —
 * no localStorage, nothing readable from JS. `apiFetch` unwraps it server-side
 * and attaches it as `Authorization: Bearer`.
 */

const SESSION_COOKIE = "dhwarsh_session";

/**
 * Lazily derives and caches the signing key on first use, rather than at
 * module scope. Reading `env.SESSION_SECRET` eagerly at import time would
 * throw the moment anything imports this module — including `next build`
 * collecting page data — before a request context ever exists.
 */
let cachedKey: Uint8Array | undefined;
function getEncodedKey(): Uint8Array {
  if (!cachedKey) {
    cachedKey = new TextEncoder().encode(env.SESSION_SECRET);
  }
  return cachedKey;
}

export type SessionPayload = {
  userId: number;
  username: string;
  displayName: string;
  role: Role;
  employeeId: number | null;
  agentId: number | null;
  branchId: number | null;
  mustChangePassword: boolean;
  /** Backend JWT. Server-side only — never send to a Client Component. */
  accessToken: string;
  /**
   * Longer-lived backend token, exchanged for a fresh access token when the
   * access token expires mid-session. Same server-only rule as above.
   */
  refreshToken: string;
  expiresAt: string;
};

export async function encrypt(payload: SessionPayload): Promise<string> {
  return new SignJWT({ ...payload })
    .setProtectedHeader({ alg: "HS256" })
    .setIssuedAt()
    .setExpirationTime("8h")
    .sign(getEncodedKey());
}

export async function decrypt(
  session: string | undefined = "",
): Promise<SessionPayload | undefined> {
  try {
    const { payload } = await jwtVerify(session, getEncodedKey(), {
      algorithms: ["HS256"],
    });

    // Trust nothing that comes back out of the cookie without re-checking.
    if (
      typeof payload.userId !== "number" ||
      typeof payload.username !== "string" ||
      typeof payload.accessToken !== "string" ||
      typeof payload.refreshToken !== "string" ||
      !isRole(payload.role)
    ) {
      return undefined;
    }

    return payload as unknown as SessionPayload;
  } catch {
    // Expired or tampered — treat as signed out.
    return undefined;
  }
}

export async function createSession(
  payload: Omit<SessionPayload, "expiresAt">,
): Promise<void> {
  const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 8 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  const session = await encrypt({ ...payload, expiresAt: expiresAt.toISOString() });
  const cookieStore = await cookies();

  cookieStore.set(SESSION_COOKIE, session, {
    httpOnly: true,
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
    expires: expiresAt,
    sameSite: "lax",
    path: "/",
  });
}

export async function getSession(): Promise<SessionPayload | undefined> {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  return decrypt(cookieStore.get(SESSION_COOKIE)?.value);
}

/**
 * Trades the refresh token for a fresh pair via `POST /auth/refresh`.
 *
 * The backend access token lives 15 minutes while this cookie lives 8 hours,
 * so without this every session would start failing a quarter-hour in.
 * Returns the new access token, or undefined if the refresh token is itself
 * spent — the caller should then treat the session as ended.
 *
 * Deliberately uses raw `fetch` rather than `api` to avoid an import cycle:
 * api-client depends on this module for the token it attaches.
 */
export async function refreshSession(
  session: SessionPayload,
): Promise<string | undefined> {
  let payload: { data?: RefreshedTokens } | undefined;

  try {
    const response = await fetch(
      `${env.API_BASE_URL.replace(/\/$/, "")}/auth/refresh`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Accept: "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ refreshToken: session.refreshToken }),
        cache: "no-store",
      },
    );

    if (!response.ok) return undefined;

    payload = (await response.json()) as { data?: RefreshedTokens };
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }

  const tokens = payload?.data;

  if (
    typeof tokens?.accessToken !== "string" ||
    typeof tokens?.refreshToken !== "string"
  ) {
    return undefined;
  }

  try {
    await createSession({ ...session, ...tokens });
  } catch {
    // Server Components render with a read-only cookie store, so persisting
    // fails there. The caller still gets the fresh token for this request;
    // the next Server Action or Route Handler re-persists it.
  }

  return tokens.accessToken;
}

type RefreshedTokens = { accessToken: string; refreshToken: string };

export async function deleteSession(): Promise<void> {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  cookieStore.delete(SESSION_COOKIE);
}

export { SESSION_COOKIE };
===== src\components\features\attendance\attendance-filters.tsx =====
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useTransition } from "react";

import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { AttendanceBranchSummary } from "@/types";

/**
 * Branch and date filters for the attendance board.
 *
 * Navigates rather than holding local state, so the filtered view stays a URL:
 * shareable, survives a refresh, and the back button steps through filter
 * changes. This is the same contract `FilterTabs` documents, for the two
 * filters a segmented row of links cannot carry (a branch list is too long, and
 * a date is not enumerable).
 *
 * The current values arrive as props from the Server Component instead of being
 * read back out of `useSearchParams`. The page already has them — it awaits
 * `searchParams` to run its queries — and rebuilding the query string from props
 * keeps this component free of a Suspense boundary requirement.
 *
 * `basePath` is a prop because two boards render this: the admin one at
 * `/admin/attendance` and the HR one at `/hr/attendance`. Both read the same
 * endpoints and offer the same filters, so the only thing that differs is where
 * a change navigates to.
 */

export function AttendanceFilters({
  branches,
  branchId,
  date,
  filter,
  basePath = "/admin/attendance",
  className,
}: {
  branches: readonly AttendanceBranchSummary[];
  /** `undefined` means all branches. */
  branchId?: number;
  /** The business day being viewed, `yyyy-MM-dd`. */
  date: string;
  /** Preserved across a filter change — the open-only tab is not a filter reset. */
  filter?: string;
  /** Where a filter change navigates to. Defaults to the admin board. */
  basePath?: string;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const hasFilter = Boolean(branchId) || Boolean(filter);

  function navigate(next: { branchId?: number; date?: string }) {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();

    const nextBranchId = next.branchId ?? branchId;
    const nextDate = next.date ?? date;

    if (nextBranchId) params.set("branchId", String(nextBranchId));
    if (nextDate) params.set("date", nextDate);
    if (filter) params.set("filter", filter);
    // No `page`: page 3 of the unfiltered list is not a sensible landing spot
    // for a different branch or day.

    const query = params.toString();
    startTransition(() => {
      router.push(query ? `${basePath}?${query}` : basePath);
    });
  }

  return (
    <div
      data-live-region
      className={cn(
        "flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2",
        isPending && "opacity-60",
        className,
      )}
    >
      <label className="relative flex items-center">
        <span className="sr-only">Filter by branch</span>
        <Icon
          name="account_balance"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute left-2.5 text-[18px] text-primary"
        />
        <select
          value={branchId ?? ""}
          onChange={(event) =>
            navigate({
              branchId: event.target.value ? Number(event.target.value) : undefined,
            })
          }
          className="appearance-none rounded-lg border border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-lowest py-1.5 pl-9 pr-8 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface transition-colors hover:bg-surface-container-low focus:border-primary focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/20"
        >
          <option value="">All branches</option>
          {branches.map((branch) => (
            <option key={branch.branchId} value={branch.branchId}>
              {branch.branchName}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <Icon
          name="expand_more"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute right-2 text-[18px] text-outline"
        />
      </label>

      <label className="relative flex items-center">
        <span className="sr-only">Attendance date</span>
        <Icon
          name="calendar_month"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute left-2.5 text-[18px] text-primary"
        />
        <input
          type="date"
          value={date}
          onChange={(event) => navigate({ date: event.target.value })}
          className="rounded-lg border border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-lowest py-1.5 pl-9 pr-3 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface transition-colors hover:bg-surface-container-low focus:border-primary focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/20"
        />
      </label>

      {hasFilter ? (
        <Link
          href={basePath}
          className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant transition-colors hover:bg-surface-container-low"
        >
          <Icon name="close" className="text-[18px]" />
          Clear
        </Link>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\components\features\attendance\live-attendance-board.tsx =====
"use client";

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useMemo } from "react";

import { BentoCard } from "@/components/shared/bento-card";
import { SegmentStrip } from "@/components/shared/segment-strip";
import { StatCard } from "@/components/shared/stat-card";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/shared/status-badge";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { queryKeys } from "@/lib/api/query-keys";
import {
  formatNumber,
  formatPercent,
  formatTime,
  initials,
} from "@/lib/format";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type {
  AttendanceActivityItem,
  AttendanceLiveSnapshot,
  AttendanceSource,
} from "@/types";

/**
 * The live half of the admin attendance board: the KPI tiles and the clock-in /
 * clock-out ticker.
 *
 * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * WHY THIS IS A CLIENT COMPONENT, AND WHY IT POLLS
 *
 * The backend has no WebSocket or SSE channel — HrpayrollDesktop pushes a scan
 * to `POST /attendance/biometric/sync` every 15s and that is the whole
 * notification story. So "live" here means polling, at the same 15s cadence the
 * terminal syncs on, which puts a scan on screen within roughly two cycles.
 *
 * The alternative — `router.refresh()` on a timer — would re-render the entire
 * Server Component subtree, re-running the records query and the device query
 * on every tick. This polls the two projections that actually change.
 *
 * `initialSnapshot` is fetched by the Server Component and passed in as
 * `initialData`, so the first paint is already correct: no skeleton, no flash
 * of zeros, and the page is useful even before the first interval fires.
 * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 */

const POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 15_000;
/** The feed is a ticker. The records table below carries the full day. */
const FEED_LIMIT = 12;

/** Mirrors the icon map on the HR attendance screen. */
const SOURCE_ICON: Record<AttendanceSource, string> = {
  BIOMETRIC: "fingerprint",
  MANUAL: "badge",
  MOBILE: "smartphone",
  WEB: "language",
};

/**
 * Stable identity for a feed row. `attendanceId` alone is not enough: one
 * attendance record produces both a CLOCK_IN and a CLOCK_OUT entry, so the
 * record id repeats with a different meaning.
 */
function activityKey(item: AttendanceActivityItem): string {
  return `${item.attendanceId}:${item.type}:${item.occurredAt}`;
}

async function fetchSnapshot(
  branchId: number | undefined,
  signal: AbortSignal,
): Promise<AttendanceLiveSnapshot> {
  const url = new URL("/api/attendance/live", window.location.origin);
  if (branchId) url.searchParams.set("branchId", String(branchId));

  const response = await fetch(url, {
    signal,
    headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
    cache: "no-store",
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    // The route answers with `{ message }` on 401/403 and on a backend
    // failure; anything else (a proxy page, an empty body) falls back.
    const body = (await response.json().catch(() => null)) as {
      message?: string;
    } | null;

    throw new Error(
      body?.message?.trim() || "Unable to refresh attendance right now.",
    );
  }

  return (await response.json()) as AttendanceLiveSnapshot;
}

export function LiveAttendanceBoard({
  initialSnapshot,
  branchId,
  recordsHref,
}: {
  initialSnapshot: AttendanceLiveSnapshot;
  /** Undefined means "all branches". Part of the query key, so it refetches. */
  branchId?: number;
  /** Where the feed's "View all" points, carrying the current filters. */
  recordsHref: string;
}) {
  const { data, isError, error, isFetching, refetch } = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.attendance.live(branchId),
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => fetchSnapshot(branchId, signal),
    initialData: initialSnapshot,
    // Age is measured from when the server assembled the snapshot, so the
    // query is already ~0s old on mount and the first interval tick is what
    // refreshes it. Both clocks are the same machine in dev.
    initialDataUpdatedAt: Date.parse(initialSnapshot.fetchedAt),
    // Overrides the client's 30s default. A 15s interval against 30s-stale data
    // gives an inconsistent cadence, and the subtitle promises 15s — a figure
    // the board must actually keep. The cost is one refetch on mount, which is
    // the "confirm this is live" fetch the screen wants anyway.
    staleTime: 0,
    refetchInterval: POLL_INTERVAL_MS,
    // `refetchIntervalInBackground` is left at its default (false): a hidden
    // tab stops polling, which matters when a dashboard is left open all day.
  });

  const { summary, activity, fetchedAt } = data;

  // Which rows are newer than the page load. Derived from the initial snapshot
  // rather than from the wall clock, so the server and client render the same
  // markup and there is no hydration mismatch.
  const initialKeys = useMemo(
    () => new Set(initialSnapshot.activity.map(activityKey)),
    [initialSnapshot],
  );

  const feed = activity.slice(0, FEED_LIMIT);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-gutter">
      {/* ─────────────────────────────── KPI row ────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-gutter lg:grid-cols-4">
        <StatCard
          label="Expected Today"
          value={formatNumber(summary.expectedEmployees)}
          icon="group"
          badgeIcon="badge"
          hint={`${formatPercent(summary.attendanceRatePercent)} reported`}
        />
        <StatCard
          label="On Site Now"
          value={formatNumber(summary.currentlyIn)}
          icon="how_to_reg"
          badgeIcon="fingerprint"
          hint="Clocked in, not yet out"
        />
        <StatCard
          label="Clocked Out"
          value={formatNumber(summary.clockedOut)}
          icon="logout"
          badgeIcon="check_circle"
        />
        <StatCard
          label="Not Yet In"
          value={formatNumber(summary.notYetIn)}
          // Not an error tone: on a normal morning most of the workforce is
          // "not yet in" at 07:00, and colouring that red would train the user
          // to ignore the one figure that should stand out.
          icon="pending_actions"
          badgeIcon="schedule"
          hint={
            summary.notYetIn > 0
              ? `${formatNumber(summary.devicesOnline)}/${formatNumber(summary.devicesTotal)} terminals online`
              : undefined
          }
        />
      </div>

      <SegmentStrip
        segments={[
          { label: "Reported", value: formatNumber(summary.reported) },
          { label: "Rate", value: formatPercent(summary.attendanceRatePercent) },
          {
            label: "Not reported",
            value: formatNumber(summary.notYetIn),
            tone: summary.notYetIn > 0 ? "warning" : "default",
          },
          {
            label: "Terminals online",
            value: `${formatNumber(summary.devicesOnline)}/${formatNumber(summary.devicesTotal)}`,
            tone:
              summary.devicesTotal > 0 &&
              summary.devicesOnline === summary.devicesTotal
                ? "success"
                : "warning",
          },
        ]}
      />

      {/* ────────────────────────────── live feed ───────────────────────── */}
      <BentoCard
        title={
          <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="relative flex size-2" aria-hidden>
              <span
                className={cn(
                  "absolute inline-flex size-full rounded-full bg-green-main",
                  isFetching ? "animate-ping motion-reduce:animate-none" : "",
                )}
              />
              <span className="relative inline-flex size-2 rounded-full bg-green-main" />
            </span>
            Live Activity
          </span>
        }
        subtitle={`Updated ${formatTime(fetchedAt)} · refreshes every 15s · newest first`}
        action={
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              data-live=""
              onClick={() => void refetch()}
              disabled={isFetching}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-outline-variant px-3 py-1.5 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant transition-colors hover:bg-surface-container-low disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              <Icon
                name="refresh"
                className={cn(
                  "text-[18px]",
                  isFetching && "animate-spin motion-reduce:animate-none",
                )}
              />
              Refresh
            </button>

            <Link
              href={recordsHref}
              className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 font-body-md text-body-md font-semibold text-primary transition-colors hover:bg-surface-container-low"
            >
              Full log
              <Icon name="arrow_forward" className="text-[18px]" />
            </Link>
          </div>
        }
      >
        {isError ? (
          <p
            role="status"
            className="mb-3 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg bg-amber-main/10 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] text-amber-main"
          >
            <Icon name="cloud_off" className="text-[16px]" />
            {error instanceof Error
              ? error.message
              : "Unable to refresh attendance right now."}{" "}
            Displaying the last values received at {formatTime(fetchedAt)}.
          </p>
        ) : null}

        {feed.length === 0 ? (
          // Suppressed while the refresh is failing: "no clock events today" is
          // a claim about the world, and a failed poll is not evidence for it.
          isError ? null : (
            <div className="rounded-card border border-dashed border-outline-variant px-4 py-12 text-center">
              <Icon
                name="fingerprint"
                className="text-[40px] text-outline-variant"
              />
              <p className="mt-2 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">
                No clock events yet today.
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-outline">
                A scan appears here within about 15 seconds of the employee
                fingerprinting at the terminal.
              </p>
            </div>
          )
        ) : (
          <ul className="-mx-2 flex flex-col">
            {feed.map((item) => {
              const isNew = !initialKeys.has(activityKey(item));

              return (
                <li key={activityKey(item)}>
                  <div
                    className={cn(
                      "flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-2 py-2.5",
                      isNew && "bg-tertiary-container/10",
                    )}
                  >
                    <span
                      aria-hidden
                      className={cn(
                        "flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold",
                        item.type === "CLOCK_IN"
                          ? "bg-primary-container text-on-primary"
                          : "bg-surface-container-high text-on-surface-variant",
                      )}
                    >
                      {initials(item.employeeName)}
                    </span>

                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="truncate font-medium text-on-surface">
                          {item.employeeName ?? "Unknown employee"}
                        </span>
                        {isNew ? (
                          <span className="shrink-0 rounded bg-tertiary-container/15 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-tertiary">
                            New
                          </span>
                        ) : null}
                      </span>
                      <span className="mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] text-outline">
                        <span>{item.employeeNumber ?? "—"}</span>
                        <span aria-hidden>·</span>
                        <span className="truncate">
                          {item.branchName ?? "Unassigned branch"}
                        </span>
                      </span>
                    </span>

                    <span
                      className="hidden shrink-0 text-outline sm:block"
                      title={`Captured via ${item.source.toLowerCase()}`}
                    >
                      <Icon name={SOURCE_ICON[item.source]} className="text-[18px]" />
                      <span className="sr-only">
                        Captured via {item.source.toLowerCase()}
                      </span>
                    </span>

                    <span className="shrink-0 tabular-nums text-body-md text-on-surface">
                      {formatTime(item.occurredAt)}
                    </span>

                    <span className="shrink-0">
                      <StatusBadge status={item.type} />
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        )}
      </BentoCard>
    </div>
  );
}

===== src\components\features\audit\audit-log-table.tsx =====
// src/components/features/audit/audit-log-table.tsx
"use client";

import { Fragment, useState } from "react";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { toast } from "@/lib/toast";

/**
 * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Shaped as a page-local type until an `AuditLogEntry` shape exists on
 * `@/types`. Swap for the real DTO when the audit-log API is wired up.
 * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 */
export type AuditLogAction = "CREATE" | "UPDATE" | "DELETE" | "EXECUTE";

export type AuditLogDetail =
  | {
      kind: "diff";
      lines: { type: "context" | "added" | "removed"; text: string }[];
      transactionId: string;
      sessionId: string;
    }
  | { kind: "note"; message: string }
  | { kind: "error"; title: string; message: string };

export interface AuditLogEntry {
  id: number;
  timestamp: string;
  actor: string;
  role: string;
  module: string;
  action: AuditLogAction;
  entity: string;
  ipAddress: string;
  result: "success" | "error";
  detail: AuditLogDetail;
}

function actionColor(action: AuditLogAction) {
  switch (action) {
    case "UPDATE":
      return "text-tertiary";
    case "EXECUTE":
      return "text-primary-container";
    case "DELETE":
      return "text-error";
    default:
      return "text-on-surface";
  }
}

/**
 * Copies the raw diff, and says whether it worked.
 *
 * `navigator.clipboard` is undefined on insecure origins and rejects when the
 * document is not focused, so the unguarded call this replaces could throw or
 * no-op while still looking like it had copied.
 */
async function copyDiff(detail: AuditLogDetail) {
  if (detail.kind !== "diff") return;

  const raw = detail.lines.map((line) => line.text).join("\n");

  try {
    if (!navigator.clipboard) throw new Error("Clipboard unavailable");
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(raw);
    toast.success("Diff copied to clipboard");
  } catch {
    toast.error("Couldn't copy to clipboard", {
      description: "Your browser blocked clipboard access. Select the text and copy manually.",
    });
  }
}

export function AuditLogTable({ logs }: { logs: AuditLogEntry[] }) {
  const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState<number | null>(logs[0]?.id ?? null);

  return (
    <div className="flex w-full flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-ambient-1">
      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full border-collapse text-left">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-low/50">
              <th className="w-10 px-4 py-3" />
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-on-surface-variant">
                Timestamp
              </th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-on-surface-variant">
                Actor
              </th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-on-surface-variant">
                Role
              </th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-on-surface-variant">
                Module
              </th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-on-surface-variant">
                Action
              </th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-on-surface-variant">
                Entity
              </th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-on-surface-variant">
                IP Address
              </th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-center text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-on-surface-variant">
                Result
              </th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="text-xs">
            {logs.map((log) => {
              const isOpen = expandedId === log.id;
              return (
                /* The key belongs on the outermost node returned from map —
                   on a bare <> it has nowhere to go, so the row and its detail
                   panel are wrapped in a keyed Fragment instead. */
                <Fragment key={log.id}>
                  <tr
                    onClick={() => setExpandedId(isOpen ? null : log.id)}
                    data-live=""
                    aria-expanded={isOpen}
                    className={`cursor-pointer border-b border-outline-variant transition-colors hover:bg-surface ${
                      log.result === "error" ? "bg-error-container/10" : ""
                    }`}
                  >
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                      <Icon
                        name="keyboard_arrow_down"
                        className={`text-on-surface-variant transition-transform ${isOpen ? "rotate-180" : ""}`}
                      />
                    </td>
                    <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-3 text-on-surface">{log.timestamp}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-primary">{log.actor}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3">
                      <span className="rounded bg-surface-container px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-on-surface-variant">
                        {log.role}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3">{log.module}</td>
                    <td className={`px-4 py-3 font-medium ${actionColor(log.action)}`}>{log.action}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-on-surface-variant">{log.entity}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant">{log.ipAddress}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                      <Icon
                        name={log.result === "success" ? "check_circle" : "error"}
                        className={log.result === "success" ? "text-tertiary" : "text-error"}
                      />
                    </td>
                  </tr>

                  {isOpen && (
                    <tr key={`${log.id}-detail`} className="border-b border-outline-variant/50 bg-surface-container-low/30">
                      <td className="p-0" colSpan={9}>
                        <div className="px-8 py-4">
                          {log.detail.kind === "diff" && (
                            <>
                              <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
                                <h4 className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-on-surface-variant">
                                  Mutation Payload (JSON Diff)
                                </h4>
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  data-live=""
                                  onClick={() => copyDiff(log.detail)}
                                  className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-medium text-primary hover:underline"
                                >
                                  <Icon name="content_copy" className="text-[14px]" />
                                  Copy Raw
                                </button>
                              </div>
                              <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-lg bg-inverse-surface p-4 font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-inverse-on-surface shadow-inner">
                                {log.detail.lines.map((line, i) => (
                                  <div
                                    key={i}
                                    className={
                                      line.type === "added"
                                        ? "bg-tertiary-container/20 text-tertiary"
                                        : line.type === "removed"
                                          ? "bg-error-container/20 text-error line-through opacity-70"
                                          : "text-inverse-on-surface"
                                    }
                                  >
                                    {line.text}
                                  </div>
                                ))}
                              </div>
                              <div className="mt-4 flex gap-4 text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant">
                                <div>
                                  <span className="font-medium">Transaction ID:</span> {log.detail.transactionId}
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                  <span className="font-medium">Session ID:</span> {log.detail.sessionId}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </>
                          )}

                          {log.detail.kind === "note" && (
                            <p className="py-4 text-sm italic text-on-surface-variant">{log.detail.message}</p>
                          )}

                          {log.detail.kind === "error" && (
                            <div className="mb-4 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border border-error-container bg-error-container/30 p-4 text-on-surface">
                              <Icon name="warning" className="mt-0.5 text-error" />
                              <div>
                                <h5 className="mb-1 font-medium text-error">{log.detail.title}</h5>
                                <p className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant">{log.detail.message}</p>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  )}
                </Fragment>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-outline-variant px-6 py-4">
        <span className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant">Showing 1-25 of 1,492 entries</span>
        <div className="flex gap-1">
          <button className="rounded p-1 text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container-high disabled:opacity-50" disabled>
            <Icon name="chevron_left" />
          </button>
          <button className="rounded bg-primary-container px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-on-primary">1</button>
          <button className="rounded px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-on-surface hover:bg-surface-container-high">2</button>
          <button className="rounded px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-on-surface hover:bg-surface-container-high">3</button>
          <span className="px-2 py-1 text-xs text-on-surface-variant">...</span>
          <button className="rounded p-1 text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-container-high">
            <Icon name="chevron_right" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
===== src\components\features\auth\agent-login-form.tsx =====
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useActionState } from "react";

import { agentLogin } from "@/app/actions/auth";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { PasswordField } from "@/components/shared/password-field";
import { useActionToast } from "@/hooks/use-action-toast";
import type { ActionState } from "@/types";

/**
 * Agent portal sign-in: username + password.
 *
 * Auth note: the backend's login query is `SELECT ... FROM users WHERE
 * username = ?` (see UserRepository / CustomUserDetailsService) — there is
 * no separate agent-code credential, only the shared `users.username`
 * column used by every role. The Stitch screen originally asked for an
 * "Agent Code" (KES-XXX-XXX), but posting that as `agentCode` always failed
 * with InvalidCredentialsException since the backend never looks up by
 * agent code. Field renamed to `username` to match what the backend
 * actually authenticates against.
 */
export function AgentLoginForm() {
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState<ActionState, FormData>(
    agentLogin,
    { status: "idle" },
  );

  const error = state.status === "error" ? state : undefined;
  const fieldErrors = error?.fieldErrors;

  // Success redirects; only failures need announcing.
  useActionToast(state);

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="space-y-5">
      {error && !fieldErrors ? (
        <div
          role="alert"
          className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-error/30 bg-error-container/40 px-3 py-2"
        >
          <Icon name="error" className="mt-px text-[16px] text-error" />
          <p className="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-error-container">
            {error.message}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <div className="relative space-y-1.5">
        <label
          className="block font-label-rail text-label-rail uppercase tracking-wider text-on-surface-variant"
          htmlFor="username"
        >
          Username
        </label>
        <div className="relative flex items-center">
          <Icon name="person" className="absolute left-3 text-[18px] text-outline" />
          <input
            id="username"
            name="username"
            type="text"
            required
            autoComplete="username"
            placeholder="Enter your username"
            aria-invalid={fieldErrors?.username ? true : undefined}
            className={`w-full rounded-lg border bg-surface-container-lowest py-2.5 pl-10 pr-4 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface transition-all placeholder:text-outline-variant focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 ${
              fieldErrors?.username
                ? "border-error focus:border-error focus:ring-error"
                : "border-outline-variant focus:border-primary focus:ring-primary focus:shadow-[0_0_0_2px_rgba(0,85,146,0.1)]"
            }`}
          />
        </div>
        {fieldErrors?.username ? (
          <p className="text-[10px] text-error">{fieldErrors.username[0]}</p>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div className="relative space-y-1.5">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <label
            className="block font-label-rail text-label-rail uppercase tracking-wider text-on-surface-variant"
            htmlFor="password"
          >
            Password
          </label>
          <Link
            href="/forgot-password"
            className="font-label-rail text-label-rail text-primary transition-colors hover:text-on-primary-fixed-variant"
          >
            Forgot password?
          </Link>
        </div>
        <PasswordField
          required
          leadingIcon="lock"
          invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors?.password)}
          className="py-2.5"
        />
        {fieldErrors?.password ? (
          <p className="text-[10px] text-error">{fieldErrors.password[0]}</p>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-2">
        <input
          id="remember"
          name="remember"
          type="checkbox"
          className="h-4 w-4 cursor-pointer rounded border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-lowest text-primary focus:ring-primary"
        />
        <label
          htmlFor="remember"
          className="cursor-pointer select-none font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant"
        >
          Keep me signed in
        </label>
      </div>

      <button
        type="submit"
        disabled={pending}
        className="group mt-6 flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-navy px-4 py-3 font-body-md text-body-md font-bold text-white shadow-md transition-all duration-200 hover:bg-on-primary-fixed-variant hover:shadow-lg disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-70"
      >
        {pending ? (
          <>
            <Icon name="autorenew" className="spin-slow text-[16px]" />
            Signing in...
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            Sign in to Portal
            <Icon
              name="arrow_forward"
              className="text-[16px] transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-1"
            />
          </>
        )}
      </button>
    </form>
  );

===== src\components\features\auth\employee-login-form.tsx =====
"use client";

import { useActionState } from "react";

import { employeeLogin } from "@/app/actions/auth";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { PinInput } from "@/components/shared/pin-input";
import { useActionToast } from "@/hooks/use-action-toast";
import type { ActionState } from "@/types";

/**
 * Employee self-service sign-in: employee number + 4-digit PIN.
 *
 * Credential note: the number is `employees.employee_number VARCHAR(30)
 * UNIQUE`. The PIN maps to `users.password`, which is a bcrypt hash — a
 * 4-digit PIN is only 10,000 combinations, so the backend must enforce
 * attempt throttling and lockout. There is no rate limit that can live on
 * this side of the wire.
 */
export function EmployeeLoginForm() {
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState<ActionState, FormData>(
    employeeLogin,
    { status: "idle" },
  );

  const error = state.status === "error" ? state : undefined;
  const fieldErrors = error?.fieldErrors;

  // A successful sign-in redirects, so there is no success toast to show here.
  // Failures are announced as well as rendered inline: on a phone the submit
  // button sits below the fold of the error banner.
  useActionToast(state);

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="flex flex-col gap-stack-md">
      {error && !fieldErrors ? (
        <div
          role="alert"
          className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded border border-error/30 bg-error-container/40 px-3 py-2"
        >
          <Icon name="error" className="mt-px text-[16px] text-error" />
          <p className="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-error-container">
            {error.message}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <label
          className="font-table-header text-table-header uppercase tracking-wider text-on-surface-variant"
          htmlFor="employeeNumber"
        >
          Employee Number
        </label>
        <input
          id="employeeNumber"
          name="employeeNumber"
          type="text"
          required
          autoComplete="username"
          placeholder="e.g. EMP-1042"
          aria-invalid={fieldErrors?.employeeNumber ? true : undefined}
          className={`w-full rounded border bg-surface-container-lowest px-3 py-2 font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface shadow-sm transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 ${
            fieldErrors?.employeeNumber
              ? "border-error focus:border-error focus:ring-error"
              : "border-line focus:border-blue focus:ring-blue"
          }`}
        />
        {fieldErrors?.employeeNumber ? (
          <p className="text-[10px] text-error">{fieldErrors.employeeNumber[0]}</p>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div className="mt-2 flex flex-col gap-2">
        <label className="font-table-header text-table-header uppercase tracking-wider text-on-surface-variant">
          Secure PIN
        </label>
        <PinInput invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors?.pin)} disabled={pending} />
        {fieldErrors?.pin ? (
          <p className="text-[10px] text-error">{fieldErrors.pin[0]}</p>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <button
        type="submit"
        disabled={pending}
        className="mt-4 flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded bg-navy px-4 py-3 font-bold text-on-primary shadow-ambient-1 transition-colors hover:-translate-y-px hover:bg-primary hover:shadow-ambient-2 active:translate-y-0 active:shadow-ambient-1 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-70 disabled:hover:translate-y-0"
      >
        {pending ? (
          <>
            <Icon name="autorenew" className="spin-slow text-[18px]" />
            Signing in...
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            Sign in
            <Icon name="arrow_forward" className="text-[18px]" />
          </>
        )}
      </button>
    </form>
  );
}

===== src\components\features\auth\set-password-form.tsx =====
"use client";

import { useActionState, useState } from "react";

import { setPassword } from "@/app/actions/auth";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { PasswordField } from "@/components/shared/password-field";
import { useActionToast } from "@/hooks/use-action-toast";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { ActionState } from "@/types";

/**
 * First-login password rotation, gated by `users.must_change_password`.
 *
 * The strength meter mirrors the rules in `changePasswordSchema` so the
 * feedback shown here matches what the action will actually accept.
 */

const RULES = [
  { label: "At least 8 characters", test: (v: string) => v.length >= 8 },
  { label: "One uppercase letter", test: (v: string) => /[A-Z]/.test(v) },
  { label: "One lowercase letter", test: (v: string) => /[a-z]/.test(v) },
  { label: "One number", test: (v: string) => /\d/.test(v) },
];

export function SetPasswordForm() {
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState<ActionState, FormData>(
    setPassword,
    { status: "idle" },
  );
  const [password, setPasswordValue] = useState("");

  const error = state.status === "error" ? state : undefined;
  const fieldErrors = error?.fieldErrors;
  const met = RULES.filter((r) => r.test(password)).length;

  // Success redirects to the role home; only failures surface here.
  useActionToast(state);

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="flex flex-col gap-5">
      {error && !fieldErrors ? (
        <div
          role="alert"
          className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-error/30 bg-error-container/40 px-3 py-2"
        >
          <Icon name="error" className="mt-px text-[16px] text-error" />
          <p className="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-error-container">
            {error.message}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <div>
        <label
          className="mb-1 block font-body-md text-body-md font-semibold text-on-surface"
          htmlFor="currentPassword"
        >
          Current password
        </label>
        <PasswordField
          id="currentPassword"
          name="currentPassword"
          required
          autoComplete="current-password"
          leadingIcon="lock"
          invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors?.currentPassword)}
          className="h-10"
        />
        {fieldErrors?.currentPassword ? (
          <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-error">
            {fieldErrors.currentPassword[0]}
          </p>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div>
        <label
          className="mb-1 block font-body-md text-body-md font-semibold text-on-surface"
          htmlFor="newPassword"
        >
          New password
        </label>
        <div onChange={(e) => setPasswordValue((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value)}>
          <PasswordField
            id="newPassword"
            name="newPassword"
            required
            autoComplete="new-password"
            leadingIcon="key"
            invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors?.newPassword)}
            className="h-10"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Strength meter */}
        <div className="mt-2 flex gap-1">
          {RULES.map((rule, i) => (
            <span
              key={rule.label}
              className={cn(
                "h-1 flex-1 rounded-full transition-colors",
                i < met
                  ? met === RULES.length
                    ? "bg-tertiary"
                    : "bg-orange"
                  : "bg-surface-container-highest",
              )}
            />
          ))}
        </div>

        <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1">
          {RULES.map((rule) => {
            const ok = rule.test(password);
            return (
              <li
                key={rule.label}
                className={cn(
                  "flex items-center gap-1.5 font-body-md text-[10px] transition-colors",
                  ok ? "text-tertiary" : "text-on-surface-variant",
                )}
              >
                <Icon
                  name={ok ? "check_circle" : "radio_button_unchecked"}
                  filled={ok}
                  className="text-[12px]"
                />
                {rule.label}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>

        {fieldErrors?.newPassword ? (
          <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-error">{fieldErrors.newPassword[0]}</p>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div>
        <label
          className="mb-1 block font-body-md text-body-md font-semibold text-on-surface"
          htmlFor="confirmPassword"
        >
          Confirm new password
        </label>
        <PasswordField
          id="confirmPassword"
          name="confirmPassword"
          required
          autoComplete="new-password"
          leadingIcon="key"
          invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors?.confirmPassword)}
          className="h-10"
        />
        {fieldErrors?.confirmPassword ? (
          <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-error">
            {fieldErrors.confirmPassword[0]}
          </p>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <button
        type="submit"
        disabled={pending}
        className="custom-shadow-card mt-2 flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-navy font-body-md text-body-md font-bold text-white transition-all hover:-translate-y-px hover:bg-navy/90 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-navy/70 disabled:hover:translate-y-0"
      >
        {pending ? (
          <>
            <Icon name="autorenew" className="spin-slow text-[16px]" />
            Saving...
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            Set password
            <Icon name="arrow_forward" className="text-[16px]" />
          </>
        )}
      </button>
    </form>
  );
}
